sections.label: In praise of Savitar
sections.name: Hymn 1

verses.sa:
दोषो गाय बृहद् गाय द्युमद् धेहि ।
आथर्वण स्तुहि देवं सवितारम्॥
verses.tr: doṣo gāya bṛhad gāya dyumad dhehi ātharvaṇa stuhi devaṃ savitāram
verses.en: Sing, Atharvana, at eve, sing loudly, bring a splendid present: hymn God Savitar with praises.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टुहि यो अन्तः सिन्धौ सूनुः ।
सत्यस्य युवानमद्रोघवाचं सुशेवम्॥
verses.tr: tamu ṣṭuhi yo antaḥ sindhau sūnuḥ satyasya yuvānamadroghavācaṃ suśevam
verses.en: Yea, praise him whose home is in the river, Son of Truth, the youthful, gracious friend whose word is guileless.

verses.sa:
स घा नो देवः सविता साविषदमृतानि भूरि ।
उभे सुष्टुती सुगातवे॥
verses.tr: sa ghā no devaḥ savitā sāviṣadamṛtāni bhūri ubhe suṣṭutī sugātave
verses.en: Savitar our God shall send us many everlasting treasures, that both paths may well be travelled.

sections.label: In praise of Indra
sections.name: Hymn 2

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोममृत्विजः सुनोता च धावत ।
स्तोतुर्यो वचः शृणवद्धवं च मे॥
verses.tr: indrāya somamṛtvijaḥ sunotā ca dhāvata stoturyo vacaḥ śṛṇavaddhavaṃ ca me
verses.en: For Indra, ministering priests! run ye and press the Soma juice, That he may hear his praiser's word, and this my call.

verses.sa:
आ यं विशन्तीन्दवो वयो न वृक्षमन्धसः ।
विरप्शिन् विमृधो जहि रक्षस्विनीः॥
verses.tr: ā yaṃ viśantīndavo vayo na vṛkṣamandhasaḥ virapśin vimṛdho jahi rakṣasvinīḥ
verses.en: Thou into whom the drops find way as sap pours life into a tree, Drive off in thine abundant might our demon foes..

verses.sa:
सुनोता सोमपाव्ने सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
युवा जेतेशानः स पुरुष्टुतः॥
verses.tr: sunotā somapāvne somamindrāya vajriṇe yuvā jeteśānaḥ sa puruṣṭutaḥ
verses.en: For Indra, thunder-armed, who drinks the Soma press the Soma out: He, youthful, conqueror, and Lord, is praised by all.

sections.label: A prayer to various deities for protection and prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 3

verses.sa:
पातं न इन्द्रापूषणादितिः पान्तु मरुतः ।
अपां नपात् सिन्धवः सप्त पातन पातु नो विष्णुरुत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: pātaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇāditiḥ pāntu marutaḥ apāṃ napāt sindhavaḥ sapta pātana pātu no viṣṇuruta dyauḥ
verses.en: Guard us the Maruts! Guard us well, O Indra, Pushan, Aditi. Guard us, O Waters' Child, and Rivers Seven. May. Vishnu guard us, and the Sky.

verses.sa:
पातां नो द्यावापृथिवी अभिष्टये पातु ग्रावा पातु सोमो नो अंहसः ।
पातु नो देवी सुभगा सरस्वती पात्वग्निः शिवा ये अस्य पायवः॥
verses.tr: pātāṃ no dyāvāpṛthivī abhiṣṭaye pātu grāvā pātu somo no aṃhasaḥ pātu no devī subhagā sarasvatī pātvagniḥ śivā ye asya pāyavaḥ
verses.en: May Heaven and Earth take care of us for victory, may Pressing-stone and Soma save us from distress. Sarasvati, auspicious Goddess, guard us well: preserve us Agni and his kind protecting powers.

verses.sa:
पातां नो देवाश्विना शुभस्पती उषासानक्तोत न उरुष्यताम्।
अपां नपादभिह्रुती गयस्य चिद देव त्वष्टर्वर्धय सर्वतातये॥
verses.tr: pātāṃ no devāśvinā śubhaspatī uṣāsānaktota na uruṣyatām apāṃ napādabhihrutī gayasya cida deva tvaṣṭarvardhaya sarvatātaye
verses.en: Preserve us both the Asvins, Gods and Lords of Light, and let the Dawns and Night bring us deliverance. The Waters' Child protect our house from every harm. Do thou, God Tvashtar, make us strong for health and wealth.

sections.label: A prayer to various deities for protection
sections.name: Hymn 4

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा मे दैव्यं वचः पर्जन्यो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
पुत्रैर्भ्रातृभिरदितिर्नु पातु नो दुष्टरं त्रायमाणं सहः॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ vacaḥ parjanyo brahmaṇaspatiḥ putrairbhrātṛbhiraditirnu pātu no duṣṭaraṃ trāyamāṇaṃ sahaḥ
verses.en: May Tvashtar, Brahmanaspati, Parjanya hear my holy prayer. May Aditi with all her sons, the brothers, guard us, invincible, protecting power.

verses.sa:
अंशो भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमादितिः पान्तु मरुतः ।
अप तस्य द्वेषो गमेदभिह्रुतो यावयच्छत्रुमन्तितम्॥
verses.tr: aṃśo bhago varuṇo mitro aryamāditiḥ pāntu marutaḥ apa tasya dveṣo gamedabhihruto yāvayacchatrumantitam
verses.en: May Ansa, Bhaga, Varuna, and Mitra, Aryaman, Aditi, and Maruts guard us. May we be freed from that oppressors hatred. May he keep off that foeman who is near us.

verses.sa:
धिये समश्विना प्रावतं न उरुष्या ण उरुज्मन्नप्रयुछन्।
द्यौ३ष्पितर्यावय दुच्छुना या॥
verses.tr: dhiye samaśvinā prāvataṃ na uruṣyā ṇa urujmannaprayuchan dyau3ṣpitaryāvaya ducchunā yā
verses.en: May: both the Asvins further our devotion. With ceaseless care deliver us, Wide-ranger! O Father Heaven, keep from us all misfortunes.

sections.label: A prayer to Agni and Indra for the well being of a princely patron
sections.name: Hymn 5

verses.sa:
उदेनमुत्तरं नयाग्ने घृतेनाहुत ।
समेनं वर्चसा सृज प्रजया च बहुं कृधि॥
verses.tr: udenamuttaraṃ nayāgne ghṛtenāhuta samenaṃ varcasā sṛja prajayā ca bahuṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Agni, adored with sacred oil, lift up this man to high estate. Endow him with full store of strength and make him rich in progeny.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेमं प्रतरं कृधि सजातानामसद् वशी।
रायस्पोषेण सं सृज जीवातवे जरसे नय॥
verses.tr: indremaṃ prataraṃ kṛdhi sajātānāmasad vaśī rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ sṛja jīvātave jarase naya
verses.en: Advance him, Indra! Let him be ruler of all akin to him. Grant him sufficiency of wealth: guide him to life and length of days.

verses.sa:
यस्य कृण्मो हविर्गृहे तमग्ने वर्धया त्वम्।
तस्मै सोमो अधि ब्रवदयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: yasya kṛṇmo havirgṛhe tamagne vardhayā tvam tasmai somo adhi bravadayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: Prosper this man, O Agni, in whose house we offer sacrifice. May Soma bless him, and the God here present, Brahmanaspati.

sections.label: A prayer to Brahmanaspati for protection from wicked men
sections.name: Hymn 6

verses.sa:
यो३स्मान् ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽदेवो अभिमन्यते ।
सर्वं तं रन्धयासि मे यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: yo3smān brahmaṇaspate'devo abhimanyate sarvaṃ taṃ randhayāsi me yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: The godless man whoever plots against us, Brahmanaspati, Thou shalt give up as prey to me the worshipper who pour the juice.

verses.sa:
यो नः सोम सुशंसिनो दुःशंस आदिदेशति ।
वज्रेणास्य मुखे जहि स संपिष्टो अपायति॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ soma suśaṃsino duḥśaṃsa ādideśati vajreṇāsya mukhe jahi sa saṃpiṣṭo apāyati
verses.en: If, Soma, any spiteful man hath aimed at us whose thoughts are kind, Smite with thy bolt upon his face: he, crushed to pieces, vanisheth.

verses.sa:
यो नः सोमाभिदासति सनाभिर्यश्च निष्ट्यः ।
अप तस्य बलं तिर महीव द्यौर्वधत्मना॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ somābhidāsati sanābhiryaśca niṣṭyaḥ apa tasya balaṃ tira mahīva dyaurvadhatmanā
verses.en: Soma, whoever troubleth us, be he a stranger or akin, Deprive him of the strength he hath: slay him thyself like mighty Dyaus!

sections.label: A Prayer to Soma and other Gods for help and protection
sections.name: Hymn 7

verses.sa:
येन सोमादितिः पथा मित्रा वा यन्त्यद्रुहः ।
तेना नोऽवसा गहि॥
verses.tr: yena somāditiḥ pathā mitrā vā yantyadruhaḥ tenā no'vasā gahi
verses.en: Soma! what pathway Aditi and the three guileless Mitras use, come thou with help to us thereby.

verses.sa:
येन सोम साहन्त्यासुरान् रन्धयासि नः ।
तेना नो अधि वोचत॥
verses.tr: yena soma sāhantyāsurān randhayāsi naḥ tenā no adhi vocata
verses.en: Thereby thou, conquering Soma, wilt give Asuras to be our prey, thereby be ye our advocates.

verses.sa:
येन देवा असुराणामोजांस्यवृणीध्वम्।
तेना नः शर्म यच्छत॥
verses.tr: yena devā asurāṇāmojāṃsyavṛṇīdhvam tenā naḥ śarma yacchata
verses.en: Whereby ye Gods repelled and stayed the powers of the Asuras, thereby give shelter unto us.

sections.label: A charm to win a maiden's love
sections.name: Hymn 8

verses.sa:
यथा वृक्षं लिबुजा समन्तं परिषस्वजे।
एवा परि ष्वजस्व मां यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन्नापगा असः॥
verses.tr: yathā vṛkṣaṃ libujā samantaṃ pariṣasvaje evā pari ṣvajasva māṃ yathā māṃ kāminyaso yathā mannāpagā asaḥ
verses.en: Like as the creeper throws her arms on every side around the tree, So hold thou me in thine embrace that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

verses.sa:
यथा सुपर्णः प्रपतन् पक्षौ निहन्ति भूम्याम्।
एवा नि हन्मि ते मनो यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन्नापगा असः॥
verses.tr: yathā suparṇaḥ prapatan pakṣau nihanti bhūmyām evā ni hanmi te mano yathā māṃ kāminyaso yathā mannāpagā asaḥ
verses.en: As, when he mounts, the eagle strikes his pinions downward on the earth, So do I strike thy spirit down that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

verses.sa:
यथेमे द्यावापृथिवी सद्यः पर्येति सूर्यः ।
एवा पर्येमि ते मनो यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन्नापगा असः॥
verses.tr: yatheme dyāvāpṛthivī sadyaḥ paryeti sūryaḥ evā paryemi te mano yathā māṃ kāminyaso yathā mannāpagā asaḥ
verses.en: As in his rapid course the Sun encompasses the heaven and earth, So do I compass round thy mind that thou mayst be in love with me, my darling, never to depart.

sections.label: A charm to win a maiden's love
sections.name: Hymn 9

verses.sa:
वाञ्छ मे तन्वं१ पादौ वाञ्छाक्ष्यौ३वाञ्छ सक्थ्यौऽ।
अक्ष्यौऽ वृषण्यन्त्याः केशा मां ते कामेन शुष्यन्तु॥
verses.tr: vāñcha me tanvaṃ1 pādau vāñchākṣyau3vāñcha sakthyau' akṣyau' vṛṣaṇyantyāḥ keśā māṃ te kāmena śuṣyantu
verses.en: Desire my body, love my feet, love thou mine eyes, and love my legs. Let both thine eyes and hair, fond girl! be dried and parched through love of me.

verses.sa:
मम त्वा दोषणिश्रिषं कृणोमि हृदयश्रिषम्।
यथा मम क्रतावसो मम चित्तमुपायसि॥
verses.tr: mama tvā doṣaṇiśriṣaṃ kṛṇomi hṛdayaśriṣam yathā mama kratāvaso mama cittamupāyasi
verses.en: I make thee hang upon mine arm, I make thee lie upon my heart. Thou yieldest to my wish, that thou mayst be submissive to my will.

verses.sa:
यासां नाभिरारेहणं हृदि संवननं कृतम् ।
गावो घृतस्य मातरो ऽमूं सं वानयन्तु मे॥
verses.tr: yāsāṃ nābhirārehaṇaṃ hṛdi saṃvananaṃ kṛtam gāvo ghṛtasya mātaro 'mūṃ saṃ vānayantu me
verses.en: May they whose kisses are a bond, a love-charm laid within the heart, Mothers of butter, may the cows incline that maid to love of me.

sections.label: A thanksgiving for life, bearing: and sight
sections.name: Hymn 10

verses.sa: पृथिव्यै श्रोत्राय वनस्पतिभ्योऽग्नयेऽधिपतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: pṛthivyai śrotrāya vanaspatibhyo'gnaye'dhipataye svāhā
verses.en: All Hail for hearing to the Earth, to Trees, to Agni, sovran Lord! f

verses.sa: प्राणायान्तरिक्षाय वयोभ्यो वायवेऽधिपतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: prāṇāyāntarikṣāya vayobhyo vāyave'dhipataye svāhā
verses.en: All hail for breath to Air, for powers of life to Vayu, sovran Lord!

verses.sa: दिवे चक्षुषे नक्षत्रेभ्यः सूर्यायाधिपतये स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: dive cakṣuṣe nakṣatrebhyaḥ sūryāyādhipataye svāhā
verses.en: All hail for vision to the Stars, to Heaven, to Surya, sovran Lord!

sections.label: An epithalamian charm to ensure the birth of a boy
sections.name: Hymn 11

verses.sa:
शमीमश्वत्थ आरूढस्तत्र पुंसुवनं कृतम्।
तद् वै पुत्रस्य वेदनं तत् स्त्रीष्वा भरामसि॥
verses.tr: śamīmaśvattha ārūḍhastatra puṃsuvanaṃ kṛtam tad vai putrasya vedanaṃ tat strīṣvā bharāmasi
verses.en: Asvattha on the Sami-tree. There a male birth is certified. There is the finding of a son: this bring we to the women-folk.

verses.sa:
पुंसि वै रेतो भवति तत् स्त्रियामनु षिच्यते ।
तद् वै पुत्रस्य वेदनं तत् प्रजापतिरब्रवीत्॥
verses.tr: puṃsi vai reto bhavati tat striyāmanu ṣicyate tad vai putrasya vedanaṃ tat prajāpatirabravīt
verses.en: The father sows the genial seed, the woman tends and fosters it. This is the finding of a son: thus hath Prajapati declared.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिरनुमतिः सिनीवाल्यऽचीक्लृपत्।
स्त्रषूयमन्यत्र दधत् पुंमांसमु दधदिह॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiranumatiḥ sinīvālya'cīklṛpat straṣūyamanyatra dadhat puṃmāṃsamu dadhadiha
verses.en: Prajapati, Anumati, Sinivali have ordered it. Eye where may he effect the birth of maids, but here prepare a boy.

sections.label: A harm against venomous serpents
sections.name: Hymn 12

verses.sa:
परि द्यामिव सूर्योऽहीनां जनिमागमम्।
रात्री जगदिवान्यद्धंसात् तेना ते वारये विषम्॥
verses.tr: pari dyāmiva sūryo'hīnāṃ janimāgamam rātrī jagadivānyaddhaṃsāt tenā te vāraye viṣam
verses.en: I, As the Sun goes round the heaven, have travelled round the Serpents' race. I ward thy poison off, as Night parts all else living from the Sun.

verses.sa:
यद् ब्रह्मभिर्यदृषिभिर्यद् देवैर्विदितं पुरा।
यद् भूतं भव्यमासन्वत् तेना ते वारये विषम्॥
verses.tr: yad brahmabhiryadṛṣibhiryad devairviditaṃ purā yad bhūtaṃ bhavyamāsanvat tenā te vāraye viṣam
verses.en: With this, discovered in the days of old by Brahmans, Rishis, Gods, With this I ward thy poison off, thou Biter! formed and forming now.

verses.sa:
मध्वा पृञ्चे नद्यः१ पर्वता गिरयो मधु ।
मधु परुष्णी शीपाला शमास्ने अस्तु शं हृदे॥
verses.tr: madhvā pṛñce nadyaḥ1 parvatā girayo madhu madhu paruṣṇī śīpālā śamāsne astu śaṃ hṛde
verses.en: With mead I mingle flowing streams: the hills and mountains shall be mead, Parushni and Sipala mead. May it be well with mouth and heart.

sections.label: Homage to Death
sections.name: Hymn 13

verses.sa:
नमो देववधेभ्यो नमो राजवधेभ्यः ।
अथो ये विश्यानां वधास्तेभ्यो मृत्यो नमोऽस्तु ते॥
verses.tr: namo devavadhebhyo namo rājavadhebhyaḥ atho ye viśyānāṃ vadhāstebhyo mṛtyo namo'stu te
verses.en: Worship to weapons of the Gods! worship to weapons of the Kings! Then worship to the people's arms! t worship, O Death, be paid to thee!

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अधिवाकाय परावाकाय ते नमः ।
सुमत्यै मृत्यो ते नमो दुर्मत्यै त इदं नमः॥
verses.tr: namaste adhivākāya parāvākāya te namaḥ sumatyai mṛtyo te namo durmatyai ta idaṃ namaḥ
verses.en: Let worship be to thy defence and to thine accusation paid. Death! be this worship paid to thy good-will and thy malevolence!

verses.sa:
नमस्ते यातुधानेभ्यो नमस्ते भेषजेभ्यः ।
नमस्ते मृत्यो मूलेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्य इदं नमः॥
verses.tr: namaste yātudhānebhyo namaste bheṣajebhyaḥ namaste mṛtyo mūlebhyo brāhmaṇebhya idaṃ namaḥ
verses.en: Worship to thy physicians, to thy sorcerers be worship paid! Death! let this reverence be done unto thy Brahmans and thy roots.

sections.label: A charm against Consumption
sections.name: Hymn 14

verses.sa:
अस्थिस्रंसं परुस्रंसमास्थितं हृदयामयम्।
बलासं सर्वं नाशयाङ्गेष्ठा यश्च पर्वसु॥
verses.tr: asthisraṃsaṃ parusraṃsamāsthitaṃ hṛdayāmayam balāsaṃ sarvaṃ nāśayāṅgeṣṭhā yaśca parvasu
verses.en: Remove thou all Decline that lurks within the members and the joints, The firmly-settled heart-disease that racks the bones and rends the limbs.

verses.sa:
निर्बलासं बलासिनः क्षिणोमि मुष्करं यथा ।
छिनद्म्यस्य बन्धनं मूलमुर्वार्वा इव॥
verses.tr: nirbalāsaṃ balāsinaḥ kṣiṇomi muṣkaraṃ yathā chinadmyasya bandhanaṃ mūlamurvārvā iva
verses.en: From the consumptive man I pluck Decline as 'twere a severed part. I cut the bond that fetters him, even as a root of cucumber.

verses.sa:
निर्बलासेतः प्र पताशुङ्गः शिशुको यथा ।
अथो इट इव हायनोप द्राह्यवीरहा॥
verses.tr: nirbalāsetaḥ pra patāśuṅgaḥ śiśuko yathā atho iṭa iva hāyanopa drāhyavīrahā
verses.en: Begone, Consumption, hence away, like a young foal that runs at speed. Then, not pernicious to our men, flee, yearly visitant like grass!

sections.label: A charm for power and preeminence
sections.name: Hymn 15

verses.sa:
उत्तमो अस्योषधीनां तव वृक्षा उपस्तयः ।
उपस्तिरस्तु सो३स्माकं यो अस्मां अभिदासति॥
verses.tr: uttamo asyoṣadhīnāṃ tava vṛkṣā upastayaḥ upastirastu so3smākaṃ yo asmāṃ abhidāsati
verses.en: Most excellent of all the plants art thou: thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

verses.sa:
सबन्धुश्चासबन्धुश्च यो अस्मां अभिदासति ।
तेषां सा वृक्षाणामिवाहं भूयासमुत्तमः॥
verses.tr: sabandhuścāsabandhuśca yo asmāṃ abhidāsati teṣāṃ sā vṛkṣāṇāmivāhaṃ bhūyāsamuttamaḥ
verses.en: Whoever seeks to injure us, with kinsmen or no kin to aid, May I be uppermost of all, even as this Plant is queen of trees.

verses.sa:
यथा सोम ओषधीनामुत्तमो हविषां कृतः ।
तलाशा वृक्षाणामिवाहं भूयासमुत्तमः॥
verses.tr: yathā soma oṣadhīnāmuttamo haviṣāṃ kṛtaḥ talāśā vṛkṣāṇāmivāhaṃ bhūyāsamuttamaḥ
verses.en: As Soma hath been made the best of all oblations 'mid the plants, So, as Talasa is the queen of trees, may I be chief of all.

sections.label: A medicinal charm
sections.name: Hymn 16

verses.sa:
आबयो अनाबयो रसस्त उग्र आबयो ।
आ ते करम्भमद्मसि॥
verses.tr: ābayo anābayo rasasta ugra ābayo ā te karambhamadmasi
verses.en: O Asaro, non-Abayu, dire is thy juice, O Abayu: we eat the gruel made of thee.

verses.sa:
विहह्लो नाम ते पिता मदावती नाम ते माता।
स हिन त्वमसि यस्त्वमात्मानमावयः॥
verses.tr: vihahlo nāma te pitā madāvatī nāma te mātā sa hina tvamasi yastvamātmānamāvayaḥ
verses.en: Vihalha is thy fathers name, thy mother's is Mada vali. Yea, verily thou art not he, thou who hast well protected life.

verses.sa:
तौविलिकेऽवेलयावायमैलब ऐलयीत्।
बभ्रुश्च बभ्रुकर्णश्चापेहि निराल॥
verses.tr: tauvilike'velayāvāyamailaba ailayīt babhruśca babhrukarṇaścāpehi nirāla
verses.en: Go thou to rest, Tauvilika! This noisy cry hath sunk to rest. Go hence, depart, Nirala, thou! the tawny and the tawny-eared.

verses.sa:
अलसालासि पूर्व सिलाञ्जालास्युत्तरा ।
नीलागलसाला॥
verses.tr: alasālāsi pūrva silāñjālāsyuttarā nīlāgalasālā
verses.en: [Griffith: 'The fourth verse, consisting of one line, is untranslatable: Thou art Alasala in front, thou art Silanjala (a weed growing in corn) behind: Nilagalasala (probably a weed of similar kind).']

sections.label: A charm to ensure conception
sections.name: Hymn 17

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही भूतानां गर्भमादधे।
एवा ते ध्रियतां गर्भो अनु सूतुं सवितवे॥
verses.tr: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī bhūtānāṃ garbhamādadhe evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave
verses.en: Even as this mighty Earth conceived the germ of all the things that be, So may the g germ of life be laid in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधारेमान् वनस्पतीन्।
एवा ते ध्रियतां गर्भो अनु सूतुं सवितवे॥
verses.tr: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāremān vanaspatīn evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave
verses.en: Even as this mighty Earth hath borne and bears the stately forest trees, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधार पर्वतान् गिरीन्।
एवा ते ध्रियतां गर्भो अनु सूतुं सवितवे॥
यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधार विष्ठितं जगत्।
एवा ते ध्रियतां गर्भो अनु सूतुं सवितवे॥
verses.tr: yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāra parvatān girīn evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave yatheyaṃ pṛthivī mahī dādhāra viṣṭhitaṃ jagat evā te dhriyatāṃ garbho anu sūtuṃ savitave
verses.en: Even as this mighty Earth hath borne and bears the mountains and the hills, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son. Even as this mighty Earth supports the moving world that dwells thereon, So may the germ of life be borne in thee that thou mayst bear a son.

sections.label: A charm to banish jealousy
sections.name: Hymn 18

verses.sa:
ईर्ष्याया ध्राजिं प्रथमां प्रथमस्या उतापराम्।
अग्निं हृदय्यं१ शोकं तं ते निर्वापयामसि॥
verses.tr: īrṣyāyā dhrājiṃ prathamāṃ prathamasyā utāparām agniṃ hṛdayyaṃ1 śokaṃ taṃ te nirvāpayāmasi
verses.en: The first approach of Jealousy, and that which followeth the first, The pain, the fire that burns within thy heart we quench and drive away.

verses.sa:
यथा भूमिर्मृतमना मृतान्मृतमनस्तरा ।
यथोत मम्रुषो मन एवेर्ष्योर्मृतं मनः॥
verses.tr: yathā bhūmirmṛtamanā mṛtānmṛtamanastarā yathota mamruṣo mana everṣyormṛtaṃ manaḥ
verses.en: Even as the earth is dead to sense, yea, more unconscious than the dead, Even as a corpse's spirit is the spirit of the jealous man.

verses.sa:
अदो यत् ते हृदि श्रितं मनस्कं पतयिष्णुकम्।
ततस्त ईर्ष्यां मुञ्चामि निरूष्माणं दृतेरिव॥
verses.tr: ado yat te hṛdi śritaṃ manaskaṃ patayiṣṇukam tatasta īrṣyāṃ muñcāmi nirūṣmāṇaṃ dṛteriva
verses.en: The thought that harbours in thy heart, the fluttering doubt that dwells therein. Yea, all thy jealousy, like heat born of the dance, I banish thence.

sections.label: A prayer for purification
sections.name: Hymn 19

verses.sa:
पुनन्तु मा देवजनाः पुनन्तु मनवो धिया।
पुनन्तु विश्वा भूतानि पवमानः पुनातु मा॥
verses.tr: punantu mā devajanāḥ punantu manavo dhiyā punantu viśvā bhūtāni pavamānaḥ punātu mā
verses.en: Let the Gods purify me, let men purify me with a prayer. Cleanse me all creatures that exist! may Pavamana make me pure.

verses.sa:
पवमानः पुनातु मा क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे ।
अथो अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: pavamānaḥ punātu mā kratve dakṣāya jīvase atho ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: May Pavamana make me pure for wisdom and for power and life, and unassailed security.

verses.sa:
उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च ।
अस्मान् पुनीहि चक्षसे॥
verses.tr: ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca asmān punīhi cakṣase
verses.en: God Savitar, by both of these, filter and pressing out the Juice, purify us that we may see.

sections.label: A charm against fever
sections.name: Hymn 20

verses.sa:
अग्नेरिवास्य दहत एति शुष्मिण उतेव मत्तो विलपन्नपायति ।
अन्यमस्मदिच्छतु कं चिदव्रतस्तपुर्वधाय नमो अस्तु तक्मने॥
verses.tr: agnerivāsya dahata eti śuṣmiṇa uteva matto vilapannapāyati anyamasmadicchatu kaṃ cidavratastapurvadhāya namo astu takmane
verses.en: He goes away as 'twere from this fierce burning fire, inebriated and lamenting he departs. Let him, the lawless, seek another and not us. Worship be paid to Fever armed with fiery heat.

verses.sa:
नमो रुद्राय नमो अस्तु तक्मने नमो राज्ञे वरुणाय त्विषीमते ।
नमो दिवे नमः पृथिव्यै नम ओषधीभ्यः॥
verses.tr: namo rudrāya namo astu takmane namo rājñe varuṇāya tviṣīmate namo dive namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ
verses.en: To Rudra and to Fever be our worship paid: worship be paid to Varuna the splendid King! Worship to Dyaus, to Earth, worship be paid to Plants!

verses.sa:
अयं यो अभिशोचयिष्णुर्विश्वा रूपाणि हरिता कृणोषि ।
तस्मै तेऽरुणाय बभ्रवे नमः कृणोमि वन्याय तक्मने॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yo abhiśocayiṣṇurviśvā rūpāṇi haritā kṛṇoṣi tasmai te'ruṇāya babhrave namaḥ kṛṇomi vanyāya takmane
verses.en: Thou who, aglow with heat, makest all bodies green, to thee, red, brown, I bow, the Fever of the wood.

sections.label: A charm to strengthen hair and promote its growth
sections.name: Hymn 21

verses.sa:
इमा यास्तिस्रः पृथिवीस्तासां ह भूमिरुत्तमा।
तासामधि त्वचो अहं भेषजं समु जग्रभम्॥
verses.tr: imā yāstisraḥ pṛthivīstāsāṃ ha bhūmiruttamā tāsāmadhi tvaco ahaṃ bheṣajaṃ samu jagrabham
verses.en: Of all the three terrestrial realms the ground is verily the best. I from the skin that covers these gather a healing medicine.

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठमसि भेषजानां वसिष्ठं वीरुधानाम्।
सोमो भग इव यामेषु देवेषु वरुणो यथा॥
verses.tr: śreṣṭhamasi bheṣajānāṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ vīrudhānām somo bhaga iva yāmeṣu deveṣu varuṇo yathā
verses.en: Thou art the best of medicines, most excellent of Plants art thou, As Soma 'mid the wandering stars, as Varuna among the Gods.

verses.sa:
रेवतीरनाधृषः सिषासवः सिषासथ ।
उत स्थ केशदृंहणीरथो ह केशवर्धनीः॥
verses.tr: revatīranādhṛṣaḥ siṣāsavaḥ siṣāsatha uta stha keśadṛṃhaṇīratho ha keśavardhanīḥ
verses.en: Endowed with wealth, denying not, give freely fain to give your gifts! Ye stay the hair from falling off: ye strengthen and increase its growth.

sections.label: A hymn to the Maruts or Storm-Gods
sections.name: Hymn 22

verses.sa:
कृष्णं नियानं हरयः सुपर्णा अपो वसाना दिवमुत् पतन्ति ।
त आववृत्रन्त्सदनादृतस्यादिद् घृतेन पृथिवीं व्यूऽदुः॥
verses.tr: kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divamut patanti ta āvavṛtrantsadanādṛtasyādid ghṛtena pṛthivīṃ vyū'duḥ
verses.en: Dark the descent; the strong-winged birds are golden: they fly aloft to heaven, enrobed in waters. They have come hither from the seat of Order, and inundated earth with streams of fatness.

verses.sa:
पयस्वतीः कृणुथाप ओषधीः शिवा यदेजथा मरुतो रुक्मवक्षसः ।
ऊर्जं च तत्र सुमतिं च पिन्वत यत्रा नरो मरुतः सिञ्चथा मधु॥
verses.tr: payasvatīḥ kṛṇuthāpa oṣadhīḥ śivā yadejathā maruto rukmavakṣasaḥ ūrjaṃ ca tatra sumatiṃ ca pinvata yatrā naro marutaḥ siñcathā madhu
verses.en: Ye make floods rich in milk, make plants propitious, what time ye stir, O golden-breasted Maruts! Pour down your showers of vigorous strength and favour there where ye sprinkle mead, O Maruts, heroes!

verses.sa:
उदप्रुतो मरुतस्तां इयर्त वृष्टिर्या विश्वा निवतस्पृणाति ।
एजाति ग्लहा कन्येऽव तुन्नैरुं तुन्दाना पत्येव जाया॥
verses.tr: udapruto marutastāṃ iyarta vṛṣṭiryā viśvā nivataspṛṇāti ejāti glahā kanye'va tunnairuṃ tundānā patyeva jāyā
verses.en: O Maruts, send ye down, streaming with water, rain which, may, filling all the sloping valleys, Leap like a bold girl in a man's embraces, or like a 'matron tumbled by her husband.

sections.label: To the Waters
sections.name: Hymn 23

verses.sa:
सस्रुषीस्तदपसो दिवा नक्तं च सस्रुषीः ।
वरेण्यक्रतुरहमपो देवीरुप ह्वये॥
verses.tr: sasruṣīstadapaso divā naktaṃ ca sasruṣīḥ vareṇyakraturahamapo devīrupa hvaye
verses.en: Here flow the restless ones, they flow unceasing through the day and night. Most excellently wise I call the Goddess Waters hitherward.

verses.sa:
ओता आपः कर्मण्याऽमुञ्चन्त्वितः प्रणीतये ।
सद्यः कृण्वन्त्वेतवे॥
verses.tr: otā āpaḥ karmaṇyā'muñcantvitaḥ praṇītaye sadyaḥ kṛṇvantvetave
verses.en: Let the deft? Waters, summoned, give permission that we bear them off, And quickly set us on our way.

verses.sa:
देवस्य सवितुः सवे कर्म कृण्वन्तु मानुषाः ।
शं नो भवन्त्वप ओषधीः शिवाः॥
verses.tr: devasya savituḥ save karma kṛṇvantu mānuṣāḥ śaṃ no bhavantvapa oṣadhīḥ śivāḥ
verses.en: Let all the people celebrate the rite of Savitar the God. Sweet unto us be Waters, Plants propitious!

sections.label: To the Rivera
sections.name: Hymn 24

verses.sa:
हिमवतः प्र स्रवन्ति सिन्धौ समह सङ्गमः ।
आपो ह मह्यं तद् देवीर्ददन् हृद्द्योतभेषजम्॥
verses.tr: himavataḥ pra sravanti sindhau samaha saṅgamaḥ āpo ha mahyaṃ tad devīrdadan hṛddyotabheṣajam
verses.en: Forth from the Hills of Snow they stream, and meet in Sindhu here or there. To me the sacred Waters gave the balm that heals the heart's disease.

verses.sa:
यन्मे अक्ष्योरादिद्योत पार्ष्ण्योः प्रपदोश्च यत्।
आपस्तत् सर्वं निष्करन् भिषजां सुभिषक्तमाः॥
verses.tr: yanme akṣyorādidyota pārṣṇyoḥ prapadośca yat āpastat sarvaṃ niṣkaran bhiṣajāṃ subhiṣaktamāḥ
verses.en: Whatever rupture I have had that injured eyes or heels or toes, All this the Waters, skilfullest physicians, shall make well again.

verses.sa:
सिन्धुपत्नीः सिन्धुराज्ञीः सर्वा या नद्य१स्थन ।
दत्त नस्तस्य भेषजं तेना वो भुनजामहै॥
verses.tr: sindhupatnīḥ sindhurājñīḥ sarvā yā nadya1sthana datta nastasya bheṣajaṃ tenā vo bhunajāmahai
verses.en: All Rivers who have Sindhu for your Lady, Sindhu for your Queen, Give us the balm that heals this ill: this boon let us enjoy from you.

sections.label: A charm to remove pustules or scrofulous swellings (apachitas)
sections.name: Hymn 25

verses.sa:
पञ्च च याः पञ्चाशच्च संयन्ति मन्या अभि।
इतस्ताः सर्वा नश्यन्तु वाका अपचितामिव॥
verses.tr: pañca ca yāḥ pañcāśacca saṃyanti manyā abhi itastāḥ sarvā naśyantu vākā apacitāmiva
verses.en: May all the five-and-fifty which meet round the tendons of the neck Depart and vanish hence away like plaguing insects' buzz and hum!

verses.sa:
सप्त च याः सप्ततिश्च संयन्ति ग्रैव्या अभि।
इतस्ताः सर्वा नश्यन्तु वाका अपचितामिव॥
verses.tr: sapta ca yāḥ saptatiśca saṃyanti graivyā abhi itastāḥ sarvā naśyantu vākā apacitāmiva
verses.en: Those seventy-and-seven which meet round the upper vertebra, Let them all vanish hence away like plaguing insects' buzz and hum!

verses.sa:
नव च या नवतिश्च संयन्ति स्कन्ध्या अभि।
इतस्ताः सर्वा नश्यन्तु वाका अपचितामिव॥
verses.tr: nava ca yā navatiśca saṃyanti skandhyā abhi itastāḥ sarvā naśyantu vākā apacitāmiva
verses.en: Those nine-and-ninety which, combined, attack the shoulder round about, Let them all vanish hence away like plaguing insects' buzz and hum!

sections.label: To Affliction
sections.name: Hymn 26

verses.sa:
अव मा पाप्मन्त्सृज वशी सन् मृडयासि नः ।
आ मा भद्रस्य लोके पाप्मन् धेह्यविह्रुतम्॥
verses.tr: ava mā pāpmantsṛja vaśī san mṛḍayāsi naḥ ā mā bhadrasya loke pāpman dhehyavihrutam
verses.en: Let me go free, O Misery: do thou, the mighty, pity us. Set me uninjured in the world of happiness, O Misery.

verses.sa:
यो नः पाप्मन् न जहासि तमु त्वा जहिमो वयम्।
पथामनु व्यावर्तनेऽन्यं पाप्मानु पद्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ pāpman na jahāsi tamu tvā jahimo vayam pathāmanu vyāvartane'nyaṃ pāpmānu padyatām
verses.en: From thee, from thee who fliest not from us, O Misery, we fly. Then at the turning of the paths let Misery fall on someone else.

verses.sa:
अन्यत्रास्मन्न्युऽच्यतु सहस्राक्षो अमर्त्यः ।
यं द्वेषाम तमृच्छतु यमु द्विष्मस्तमिज्जहि॥
verses.tr: anyatrāsmannyu'cyatu sahasrākṣo amartyaḥ yaṃ dveṣāma tamṛcchatu yamu dviṣmastamijjahi
verses.en: May the immortal, thousand-eyed, dwell otherwhere apart from us. Let him afflict the man we hate: smite only him who is our foe.

sections.label: A charm to avert misfortune n by the coming of a dove
sections.name: Hymn 27

verses.sa:
देवाः कपोत इषितो यदिछन् दूतो निरृत्या इदमाजगाम ।
तस्मा अर्चाम कृणवाम निष्कृतिं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: devāḥ kapota iṣito yadichan dūto nirṛtyā idamājagāma tasmā arcāma kṛṇavāma niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
verses.en: Gods! whatsoe'er the Dove came hither seeking, sent to us as the envoy of Destruction, For that let us sing hymns and make atonement. Well be it with our quadrupeds and bipeds!

verses.sa:
शिवः कपोत इषितो नो अस्त्वनागा देवाः शकुनो गृहं नः ।
अग्निर्हि विप्रो जुषतां हविर्नः परि हेतिः पक्षिणी नो वृणक्तु॥
verses.tr: śivaḥ kapota iṣito no astvanāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛhaṃ naḥ agnirhi vipro juṣatāṃ havirnaḥ pari hetiḥ pakṣiṇī no vṛṇaktu
verses.en: Auspicious be the Dove that hath been sent us, a harmless bird, O Gods, that seeks our dwelling! J May Agni, Sage, be pleased with our oblation, and may the missile borne on wings avoid us.

verses.sa:
हेतिः पक्षिणी न दभात्यस्मानाष्ट्री पदं कृणुते अग्निधाने ।
शिवो गोभ्य उत पुरुषेभ्यो नो अस्तु मा नो देवा इह हिंसीत् कपोतः॥
verses.tr: hetiḥ pakṣiṇī na dabhātyasmānāṣṭrī padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne śivo gobhya uta puruṣebhyo no astu mā no devā iha hiṃsīt kapotaḥ
verses.en: Let not the arrow that hath wings distract us. Beside the fire-place, on the hearth it settles. May it bring welfare to our men and cattle: 'here let the Dove, ye Gods, forbear-to harm us.

sections.label: A charm to avert misfortune n by the coming of a dove
sections.name: Hymn 28

verses.sa:
ऋचा कपोतं नुदत प्रणोदमिषं मदन्तः परि गां नयामः ।
संलोभयन्तो दुरिता पदानि हित्वा न ऊर्जं प्र पदात् पथिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: ṛcā kapotaṃ nudata praṇodamiṣaṃ madantaḥ pari gāṃ nayāmaḥ saṃlobhayanto duritā padāni hitvā na ūrjaṃ pra padāt pathiṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: Drive forth the Dove, chase it with holy verses: rejoicing: bring we hither food and cattle, Obliterating traces of misfortune. Most fleet may it fly forth and leave us vigour.

verses.sa:
परीमे३ग्निमर्षत परीमे गामनेषत ।
देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः क इमाँ आ दधर्षति॥
verses.tr: parīme3gnimarṣata parīme gāmaneṣata deveṣvakrata śravaḥ ka imāṃ ā dadharṣati
verses.en: These men have strengthened Agni's might, these men have brought the kine to us. They have sung glory to the Gods. Who is the man that conquers them?

verses.sa:
यः प्रथमः प्रवतमाससाद बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशानः ।
यो३स्येशे द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदस्तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे॥
verses.tr: yaḥ prathamaḥ pravatamāsasāda bahubhyaḥ panthāmanupaspaśānaḥ yo3syeśe dvipado yaścatuṣpadastasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave
verses.en: Be reverence paid to him Who, while exploring the path for many, first approached the-river, Lord of this world of quadrupeds and bipeds: to him be reverence paid, to Death, to Yama!

sections.label: A charm to avert threatened misfortune
sections.name: Hymn 29

verses.sa:
अमून् हेतिः पतत्रिणी न्येऽतु यदुलूको वदति मोघमेतत्।
यद् वा कपोत पदमग्नौ कृणोति॥
verses.tr: amūn hetiḥ patatriṇī nye'tu yadulūko vadati moghametat yad vā kapota padamagnau kṛṇoti
verses.en: On those men -yonder fall the winged missile: the screeching of the Owl is ineffective, And that the. Dove beside the fire hath settled.

verses.sa:
यौ ते दूतौ निरृत इदमेतोऽप्रहितौ प्रहितौ वा गृहं नः ।
कपोतोलूकाभ्यामपदं तदस्तु॥
verses.tr: yau te dūtau nirṛta idameto'prahitau prahitau vā gṛhaṃ naḥ kapotolūkābhyāmapadaṃ tadastu
verses.en: Thine envoys who came hither, O Destruction, sent or not sent by thee unto our dwelling, The Dove and Owl, effectless be their visit!

verses.sa:
अवैरहत्यायेदमा पपत्यात् सुवीरताया इदमा ससद्यात्।
पराङेव परा वद पराचीमनु संवतम्।
यथा यमस्य त्वा गृहेऽरसं प्रतिचाकशानाभूकं प्रतिचाकशान्॥
verses.tr: avairahatyāyedamā papatyāt suvīratāyā idamā sasadyāt parāṅeva parā vada parācīmanu saṃvatam yathā yamasya tvā gṛhe'rasaṃ praticākaśānābhūkaṃ praticākaśān
verses.en: Oft may it fly to us to save our heroes from slaughter, oft perch here to bring fair offspring. Turn thee and send thy voice afar: cry to the region far away; That I may see thee in the home of Yama reft of all thy power, that I may see thee impotent.

sections.label: A charm to promote the growth of hair
sections.name: Hymn 30

verses.sa:
देवा इमं मधुना संयुतं यवं सरस्वत्यामधि मणावचर्कृषुः ।
इन्द्र आसीत् सीरपतिः शतक्रतुः कीनाशा आसन् मरुतः सुदानवः॥
verses.tr: devā imaṃ madhunā saṃyutaṃ yavaṃ sarasvatyāmadhi maṇāvacarkṛṣuḥ indra āsīt sīrapatiḥ śatakratuḥ kīnāśā āsan marutaḥ sudānavaḥ
verses.en: Over a magic stone, beside Sarasvati, the Gods ploughed in this barley that was blent with mead. Lord of the plough was Indra, strong with hundred powers: the ploughers were the Maruts, they who give rich gifts,

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदोऽवकेशो विकेशो येनाभिहस्यं पुरुषं कृणोषि ।
आरात् त्वदन्या वनानि वृक्षि त्वं शमि शतवल्शा वि रोह॥
verses.tr: yaste mado'vakeśo vikeśo yenābhihasyaṃ puruṣaṃ kṛṇoṣi ārāt tvadanyā vanāni vṛkṣi tvaṃ śami śatavalśā vi roha
verses.en: Thy joy in hair that falleth or is scattered, wherewith thou subjectest a man to laughter To other trees, far from thee will I drive it. Grow up, thou Sami, with a hundred branches.

verses.sa:
बृहत्पलाशे सुभगे वर्षवृद्ध ऋतावरि ।
मातेव पुत्रेभ्यो मृड केशेभ्यः शमि॥
verses.tr: bṛhatpalāśe subhage varṣavṛddha ṛtāvari māteva putrebhyo mṛḍa keśebhyaḥ śami
verses.en: Auspicious, bearing mighty leaves, holy one, nurtured by the rain, Even as a mother to her sons, be gracious, Sami, to one hair.

sections.label: To Surya the Sun-God
sections.name: Hymn 31

verses.sa:
आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः ।
पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः॥
verses.tr: āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirakramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ
verses.en: This spotted Bull hath come and sat before his mother in the east, Advancing to his father Heaven.

verses.sa:
अन्तश्चरति रोचना अस्य प्राणादपानतः ।
व्यऽख्यन्महिषः स्वः॥
verses.tr: antaścarati rocanā asya prāṇādapānataḥ vya'khyanmahiṣaḥ svaḥ
verses.en: As expiration from his breath his radiance penetrates within. The Bull shines out through all the sky.

verses.sa:
त्रिंशद् धामा वि राजति वाक् पतङ्गो अशिश्रियत्।
प्रति वस्तोरहर्द्युभिः॥
verses.tr: triṃśad dhāmā vi rājati vāk pataṅgo aśiśriyat prati vastorahardyubhiḥ
verses.en: He rules supreme through thirty realms—One winged with song hath made him mount—Throughout the days at break of morn.

sections.label: A charm against fiends and goblins
sections.name: Hymn 32

verses.sa:
अन्तर्दावे जुहुता स्वे३तद् यातुधानक्षयणं घृतेन ।
आराद् रक्षांसि प्रति दह त्वमग्ने न नो गृहाणामुप तीतपासि॥
verses.tr: antardāve juhutā sve3tad yātudhānakṣayaṇaṃ ghṛtena ārād rakṣāṃsi prati daha tvamagne na no gṛhāṇāmupa tītapāsi
verses.en: With butter, in his hall where fire is burning, perform that sacrifice which quells the goblins. Burn from afar against the demons. Agni! I Afflict not in thy fury us who praise thee.

verses.sa:
रुद्रो वो ग्रीवा अशरैत् पिशाचाः पृष्टीर्वोऽपि शृणातु यातुधानाः ।
वीरुद् वो विश्वतोवीर्या यमेन समजीगमत्॥
अभयं मित्रावरुणाविहास्तु नोऽर्चिषात्त्रिणो नुदतं प्रतीचः ।
मा ज्ञातारं मा प्रतिष्ठां विदन्त मिथो विघ्नाना उप यन्तु मृत्युम्॥
verses.tr: rudro vo grīvā aśarait piśācāḥ pṛṣṭīrvo'pi śṛṇātu yātudhānāḥ vīrud vo viśvatovīryā yamena samajīgamat abhayaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvihāstu no'rciṣāttriṇo nudataṃ pratīcaḥ mā jñātāraṃ mā pratiṣṭhāṃ vidanta mitho vighnānā upa yantu mṛtyum
verses.en: Let Rudra break your necks, O ye Pisachas, and split your ribs asunder, Yatudhanas! Here, Mitra-Varuna! may we dwell safely: with splendour drive the greedy demons backward. Let them not find a surety or a refuge, but torn away go down to Death together.

sections.label: A prayer to Indra for riches
sections.name: Hymn 33

verses.sa:
यस्येदमा रजो युजस्तुजे जना वनं स्वः ।
इन्द्रस्य रन्त्यं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: yasyedamā rajo yujastuje janā vanaṃ svaḥ indrasya rantyaṃ bṛhat
verses.en: He who controls this air and men who aid his strength, and wood, and heaven, the lofty seat which Indra loves.

verses.sa:
नाधृष आ दधृषते धृषाणो धृषितः शवः ।
पुरा यथा व्यथिः श्रव इन्द्रस्य नाधृषे शवः॥
verses.tr: nādhṛṣa ā dadhṛṣate dhṛṣāṇo dhṛṣitaḥ śavaḥ purā yathā vyathiḥ śrava indrasya nādhṛṣe śavaḥ
verses.en: The bold whose overpowering might the boldest never hath defied,—As erst still, unassailable is Indra's wrath, and fame, and force.

verses.sa:
स नो ददातु तां रयिमुरुं पिशङ्गसंदृशम्।
इन्द्रः पतिस्तुविष्टमो जनेष्वा॥
verses.tr: sa no dadātu tāṃ rayimuruṃ piśaṅgasaṃdṛśam indraḥ patistuviṣṭamo janeṣvā
verses.en: May he bestow on us that wealth, far-spreading, bright with yellow hue. Indra is mightiest Lord among the folk.

sections.label: A prayer to Agni for protection from enemies
sections.name: Hymn 34

verses.sa:
प्राग्नये वाचमीरय वृषभाय क्षितीनाम्।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: prāgnaye vācamīraya vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: Send forth thy voice to Agni, to the manly hero of our homes, So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa:
यो रक्षांसि निजूर्वत्यग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvatyagnistigmena śociṣā sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: That Agni who with sharpened flame: of fire consumes the Rakshasas, So may he bear us past our foes.

verses.sa:
यः परस्याः परावतस्तिरो धन्वातिरोचते ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatastiro dhanvātirocate sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: He who from distance far remote shineth across the tracts of land, May he transport us past our foes.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: He who beholds all creatures, who observes them with a careful eye, May he transport us past our foes.

verses.sa:
यो अस्य पारे रजसः शुक्रो अग्निरजायत ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः॥
verses.tr: yo asya pāre rajasaḥ śukro agnirajāyata sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ
verses.en: That brilliant Agni who was born beyond this region of the air, May he transport us past our foes!

sections.label: To Agni Vaisvanara
sections.name: Hymn 35

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरो न ऊतय आ प्र यातु परावतः ।
अग्निर्नः सुष्टुतीरुप॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ā pra yātu parāvataḥ agnirnaḥ suṣṭutīrupa
verses.en: Forth from the distance far away Vaisvanara come to succour us! Agni approach our eulogies!

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरो न आगमदिमं यज्ञं सजूरुप ।
अग्निरुक्थेष्वंहसु॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaro na āgamadimaṃ yajñaṃ sajūrupa agniruktheṣvaṃhasu
verses.en: Vaisvanara with friendly thoughts Hath come to this our sacrifice, Agni who saves from woe, to lauds.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरोऽङ्गिरसां स्तोममुक्थं च चाक्लृपत्।
ऐषु द्युम्नं स्वऽर्यमत्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaro'ṅgirasāṃ stomamukthaṃ ca cāklṛpat aiṣu dyumnaṃ sva'ryamat
verses.en: Vaisvanara hath formed the hymn and laud of the Angirases. To these may he bring glorious light.

sections.label: In praise of Agni Vaisvanara
sections.name: Hymn 36

verses.sa:
वऋतावानं वैश्वानरमृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पतिम्।
अजस्रं घर्ममीमहे॥
verses.tr: vaṛtāvānaṃ vaiśvānaramṛtasya jyotiṣaspatim ajasraṃ gharmamīmahe
verses.en: Holy Vaisvanara we seek, the Lord: of light and endless life, the burning One who fadeth not.

verses.sa:
स विश्वा प्रति चाक्लृप ऋतूंरुत् सृजते वशी।
यज्ञस्य वय उत्तिरन्॥
verses.tr: sa viśvā prati cāklṛpa ṛtūṃrut sṛjate vaśī yajñasya vaya uttiran
verses.en: He hath directed all things; he sends forth the Seasons in his might, furthering sacrifice's power.

verses.sa:
अग्निः परेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य ।
सम्राडेको वि राजति॥
verses.tr: agniḥ pareṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya samrāḍeko vi rājati
verses.en: Agni Kama in other homes shines forth the sole imperial Lord of all that is and is to be.

sections.label: A charm to divert Imprecation personified
sections.name: Hymn 37

verses.sa:
उप प्रागात् सहस्राक्षो युक्त्वा शपथो रथम्।
शप्तारमन्विछन् मम वृक इवाविमतो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: upa prāgāt sahasrākṣo yuktvā śapatho ratham śaptāramanvichan mama vṛka ivāvimato gṛham
verses.en: Hitherward, having yoked his steeds, came Imprecation, thousand-eyed, Seeking my curser, as a wolf the home of one who owneth sheep.

verses.sa:
परि णो वृङ्ग्धि शपथ ह्रदमग्निरिवा दहन्।
शप्तारमत्र नो जहि दिवो वृक्षमिवाशनिः॥
verses.tr: pari ṇo vṛṅgdhi śapatha hradamagnirivā dahan śaptāramatra no jahi divo vṛkṣamivāśaniḥ
verses.en: —Imprecation! as consuming 'fire avoids the lake. Smite thou the man who. curses: us, as the sky's lightning strikes the tree.

verses.sa:
यो नः शपादशपतः शपतो यश्च नः शपात्।
शुने पेष्ट्रमिवावक्षामं तं प्रत्यस्यामि मृत्यवे॥
verses.tr: yo naḥ śapādaśapataḥ śapato yaśca naḥ śapāt śune peṣṭramivāvakṣāmaṃ taṃ pratyasyāmi mṛtyave
verses.en: Who curses us, himself nursed; or, cursed, who curses us again, Him cast I as a sop to Death, as to a dog one throws a bone.

sections.label: A prayer for surpassing strength and energy
sections.name: Hymn 38

verses.sa:
सिंहे व्याघ्र उत या पृदाकौ त्विषिरग्नौ ब्राह्मणे सूर्ये या।
इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान सा न ऐतु वर्चसा संविदाना॥
verses.tr: siṃhe vyāghra uta yā pṛdākau tviṣiragnau brāhmaṇe sūrye yā indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā
verses.en: What energy the lion. hath, the tiger, adder, and burning fire, Brahman, or Sarya? And the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra, come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour!

verses.sa:
या हस्तिनि द्वीपिनि या हिरण्ये त्विषिरप्सु गोषु या पुरुषेषु ।
इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान सा न ऐतु वर्चसा संविदाना॥
verses.tr: yā hastini dvīpini yā hiraṇye tviṣirapsu goṣu yā puruṣeṣu indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā
verses.en: All energy of elephant and panther, all energy of gold, men, kine, and waters, And the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour.

verses.sa:
रथे अक्षेष्वृषभस्य वाजे वाते पर्जन्ये वरुणस्य शुष्मे ।
इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान सा न ऐतु वर्चसा संविदाना॥
राजन्येऽदुन्दुभावायतायामश्वस्य वाजे पुरुषस्य मायौ।
इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान सा न ऐतु वर्चसा संविदाना॥
verses.tr: rathe akṣeṣvṛṣabhasya vāje vāte parjanye varuṇasya śuṣme indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā rājanye'dundubhāvāyatāyāmaśvasya vāje puruṣasya māyau indraṃ yā devī subhagā jajāna sā na aitu varcasā saṃvidānā
verses.en: Might in car, axles, in the strong bull's courage, in Varuna's breath, in Vata, in Parjanya, In Warrior, in the war-drum stretched for battle, in the man's roar and in the horse's mettle, May the blest Goddess who gave birth to Indra come unto us conjoined with strength and vigour.

sections.label: A priest's prayer for power and glory
sections.name: Hymn 39

verses.sa:
यशो हविर्वर्धतामिन्द्रजूतं सहस्रवीर्यं सुभृतं सहस्कृतम्।
प्रसर्स्राणमनु दीर्घाय चक्षसे हविष्मन्तं मा वर्धय ज्येष्ठतातये॥
verses.tr: yaśo havirvardhatāmindrajūtaṃ sahasravīryaṃ subhṛtaṃ sahaskṛtam prasarsrāṇamanu dīrghāya cakṣase haviṣmantaṃ mā vardhaya jyeṣṭhatātaye
verses.en: Let sacrifice, like fame, thrive sped by Indra, inspired, well-ordered; with a thousand powers. To highest rank raise me who bring oblation, me who move forth to far-extended vision. A prayer for 'surpassing strength and energy. I The blest Goddess. Aditi.

verses.sa:
अच्छा न इन्द्रं यशसं यशोभिर्यशस्विनं नमसाना विधेम ।
स नो रास्व राष्ट्रमिन्द्रजूतं तस्य ते रातौ यशसः स्याम॥
verses.tr: acchā na indraṃ yaśasaṃ yaśobhiryaśasvinaṃ namasānā vidhema sa no rāsva rāṣṭramindrajūtaṃ tasya te rātau yaśasaḥ syāma
verses.en: We will pay sacrifice and serve with worship our glorious Indra, famous for his glories. Give thou us sway which Indra hath promoted, and in this boon of thine may we be famous.

verses.sa:
यशा इन्द्रो यशा अग्निर्यशाः सोमो अजायत ।
यशा विश्वस्य भूतस्याहमस्मि यशस्तमः॥
verses.tr: yaśā indro yaśā agniryaśāḥ somo ajāyata yaśā viśvasya bhūtasyāhamasmi yaśastamaḥ
verses.en: Indra was glorious at his birth; Agni, Soma were born renowned. And glorious am I, the most illustrious of all that is.

sections.label: A prayer for peace and security
sections.name: Hymn 40

verses.sa:
अभयं द्यावापृथिवी इहास्तु नोऽभयं सोमः सविता नः कृणोतु ।
अभयं नोऽस्तूर्व१न्तरिक्षं सप्तऋषीणां च हविषाभयं नो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ihāstu no'bhayaṃ somaḥ savitā naḥ kṛṇotu abhayaṃ no'stūrva1ntarikṣaṃ saptaṛṣīṇāṃ ca haviṣābhayaṃ no astu
verses.en: Here may we dwell, O Heaven and Earth, in safety. May Savitar and Soma send us safety. Our safety be the wide air: ours be safety through the oblation of the Seven Rishis.

verses.sa:
अस्मै ग्रामाय प्रदिशश्चतस्र ऊर्जं सुभूतं स्वस्ति सविता नः कृणोतु ।
अशत्र्विन्द्रो अभयं नः कृणोत्वन्यत्र राज्ञामभि यातु मन्युः॥
verses.tr: asmai grāmāya pradiśaścatasra ūrjaṃ subhūtaṃ svasti savitā naḥ kṛṇotu aśatrvindro abhayaṃ naḥ kṛṇotvanyatra rājñāmabhi yātu manyuḥ
verses.en: May the Four Quarters give this hamlet power: Savitar favour us and make us happy! May Indra make us free from foes and danger: may wrath of Kings be turned to other places.

verses.sa:
अनमित्रं नो अधरादनमित्रं न उत्तरात्।
इन्द्रानमित्रं नः पश्चादनमित्रं पुरस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: anamitraṃ no adharādanamitraṃ na uttarāt indrānamitraṃ naḥ paścādanamitraṃ puraskṛdhi
verses.en: Make thou us free from enemies both from below and from above. O Indra, give us perfect peace, peace from behind and from before.

sections.label: A prayer for protection, long life, and various blessings
sections.name: Hymn 41

verses.sa:
मनसे चेतसे धिय आकूतय उत चित्तये ।
मत्यै श्रुताय चक्षसे विधेम हविषा वयम्॥
verses.tr: manase cetase dhiya ākūtaya uta cittaye matyai śrutāya cakṣase vidhema haviṣā vayam
verses.en: For mind, for intellect, for thought, for purpose, for intelligence, For sense, for hearing, and for sight, let us adore with sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अपानाय व्यानाय प्राणाय भूरिधायसे ।
सरस्वत्या उरुव्यचे विधेम हविषा वयम्॥
verses.tr: apānāya vyānāya prāṇāya bhūridhāyase sarasvatyā uruvyace vidhema haviṣā vayam
verses.en: For expiration, vital air, and breath that amply nourishes, Let us with sacrifice adore Sarasvati whose reach is wide.

verses.sa:
मा नो हासिषुर्ऋषयो दैव्या ये तनूपा ये नस्तन्वऽस्तनूजाः ।
अमर्त्या मर्त्यां अभि नः सचध्वमायुर्धत्त प्रतरं जीवसे नः॥
verses.tr: mā no hāsiṣurṛṣayo daivyā ye tanūpā ye nastanva'stanūjāḥ amartyā martyāṃ abhi naḥ sacadhvamāyurdhatta prataraṃ jīvase naḥ
verses.en: Let not the Rishis, the divine, forsake us, our own, our very selves, our lives' protectors. Do ye, immortal, still attend us mortals, and give us vital power to live the longer.

sections.label: A charm to reconcile estranged friends
sections.name: Hymn 42

verses.sa:
अव ज्यामिव धन्वनो मन्युं तनोमि ते हृदः ।
यथा संमनसौ भूत्वा सखायाविव सचावहै॥
verses.tr: ava jyāmiva dhanvano manyuṃ tanomi te hṛdaḥ yathā saṃmanasau bhūtvā sakhāyāviva sacāvahai
verses.en: I Loose the anger from thy heart as 'twere the bowstring from a bow, That we, one-minded now, may walk together as familiar friends.

verses.sa:
सखायाविव सचावहा अव मन्युं तनोमि ते ।
अधस्ते अश्मनो मन्युमुपास्यामसि यो गुरुः॥
verses.tr: sakhāyāviva sacāvahā ava manyuṃ tanomi te adhaste aśmano manyumupāsyāmasi yo guruḥ
verses.en: Together let us walk as friends: thy wrathful feeling I remove, Beneath a heavy stone we cast thy wrath away and bury it.

verses.sa:
अभि तिष्ठामि ते मन्युं पार्ष्ण्या प्रपदेन च ।
यथावशो न वादिषो मम चित्तमुपायसि॥
verses.tr: abhi tiṣṭhāmi te manyuṃ pārṣṇyā prapadena ca yathāvaśo na vādiṣo mama cittamupāyasi
verses.en: I trample on thine anger thus, I tread it down with heel and toe: So dost thou yield thee to my will, to speak no more rebelliously.

sections.label: A charm to reconcile estranged friends
sections.name: Hymn 43

verses.sa:
अयं दर्भो विमन्युकः स्वाय चारणाय च ।
मन्योर्विमन्युकस्यायं मन्युशमन उच्यते॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ darbho vimanyukaḥ svāya cāraṇāya ca manyorvimanyukasyāyaṃ manyuśamana ucyate
verses.en: For stranger and for friend alike this Darbha-grass removeth wrath. Soother of Anger is it called because it calms the angry man.

verses.sa:
अयं यो भूरिमूलः समुद्रमवतिष्ठति ।
दर्भः पृथिव्या उत्थितो मन्युशमन उच्यते॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ yo bhūrimūlaḥ samudramavatiṣṭhati darbhaḥ pṛthivyā utthito manyuśamana ucyate
verses.en: This Plant that hath: abundant roots spreads to the place where waters meet. Soother. of Anger is the name of Darbha-grass that springs from earth.

verses.sa:
वि ते हनव्यां शरणिं वि ते मुख्यां नयामसि ।
यथावशो न वादिषो मम चित्तमुपायसि॥
verses.tr: vi te hanavyāṃ śaraṇiṃ vi te mukhyāṃ nayāmasi yathāvaśo na vādiṣo mama cittamupāyasi
verses.en: We draw thine obstinacy: forth, set in thy: mouth and in thy jaw: So dost. thou. yield thee to my. will, to speak no more rebelliously.

sections.label: A charm to remove disease
sections.name: Hymn 44

verses.sa:
अस्थाद् द्यौरस्थात् पृथिव्यस्थाद् विश्वमिदं जगत्।
अस्थुर्वृक्षा ऊर्ध्वस्वप्नास्तिष्ठाद् रोगो अयं तव॥
verses.tr: asthād dyaurasthāt pṛthivyasthād viśvamidaṃ jagat asthurvṛkṣā ūrdhvasvapnāstiṣṭhād rogo ayaṃ tava
verses.en: Firm stood the heaven, firm stood the earth, firm stood this universal world. Firm stood the trees that sleep erect: let this thy malady be still.

verses.sa:
शतं या भेषजानि ते सहस्रं संगतानि च ।
श्रेष्ठमास्रावभेषजं वसिष्ठं रोगनाशनम्॥
verses.tr: śataṃ yā bheṣajāni te sahasraṃ saṃgatāni ca śreṣṭhamāsrāvabheṣajaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ roganāśanam
verses.en: Of all thy hundred remedies, a thousand remedies combined, This is the surest cure for flux, most excellent to heal disease.

verses.sa:
रुद्रस्य मूत्रमस्यमृतस्य नाभिः ।
विषाणका नाम वा असि पितॄणां मूलादुत्थिता वातीकृतनाशनी॥
verses.tr: rudrasya mūtramasyamṛtasya nābhiḥ viṣāṇakā nāma vā asi pitṝṇāṃ mūlādutthitā vātīkṛtanāśanī
verses.en: Thou art the stream that Rudra pours, the closest kin of Amrita. Thy name is called Vishanaka: thou sprangest from the Fathers' root, removing illness caused by wind.

sections.label: A prayer for preservation from mental sin and evil promoting
sections.name: Hymn 45

verses.sa:
परोऽपेहि मनस्पाप किमशस्तानि शंससि ।
परेहि न त्वा कामये वृक्षां वनानि सं चर गृहेषु गोषु मे मनः॥
verses.tr: paro'pehi manaspāpa kimaśastāni śaṃsasi parehi na tvā kāmaye vṛkṣāṃ vanāni saṃ cara gṛheṣu goṣu me manaḥ
verses.en: Sin of the Mind, avaunt! begone! Why sayest thou what none should say? Go hence away, I love thee not. Go to the forests and the. trees. My heart is in our homes and. cows.

verses.sa:
अवशसा निःशसा यत् पराशसोपारिम जाग्रतो यत् स्वपन्तः ।
अग्निर्विश्वान्यप दुष्कृतान्यजुष्टान्यारे अस्मद् दधातु॥
verses.tr: avaśasā niḥśasā yat parāśasopārima jāgrato yat svapantaḥ agnirviśvānyapa duṣkṛtānyajuṣṭānyāre asmad dadhātu
verses.en: Whatever wrong we have committed, sleeping or waking, by ill-wish, dislike, or slander, All these offences, which deserve displeasure, may Agni take from us and keep them distant.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽपि मृषा चरामसि ।
प्रचेता न आङ्गिरसो दुरितात् पात्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yadindra brahmaṇaspate'pi mṛṣā carāmasi pracetā na āṅgiraso duritāt pātvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Brahmanaspati! whatever foolish deed we plan, May provident Angirasa preserve us from the sin and woe.

sections.label: A charm against evil dreams
sections.name: Hymn 46

verses.sa:
यो न जीवोऽसि न मृतो देवानाममृतगर्भोऽसि स्वप्न ।
वरुणानी ते माता यमः पिताररुर्नामासि॥
verses.tr: yo na jīvo'si na mṛto devānāmamṛtagarbho'si svapna varuṇānī te mātā yamaḥ pitārarurnāmāsi
verses.en: Thou, neither quick nor dead, O Sleep, art fraught with Amrit of the Gods. Thy name is Araru: thy sire is Yama; Varunani bare thee.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते स्वप्न जनित्रं देवजामीनां पुत्रोऽसि यमस्य करणः ।
अन्तकोऽसि मृत्युरसि।
तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स नः स्वप्न दुष्वप्न्यात् पाहि॥
verses.tr: vidma te svapna janitraṃ devajāmīnāṃ putro'si yamasya karaṇaḥ antako'si mṛtyurasi taṃ tvā svapna tathā saṃ vidma sa naḥ svapna duṣvapnyāt pāhi
verses.en: We know thy birth, O Sleep, thou art son of the sisters of the Gods: the minister of Yama thou, thou art Antaka, thou art Death. So well we know thee who thou art. Sleep, guard us from the evil dream.

verses.sa:
यथा कलां यथा शफं यथर्णं संनयन्ति ।
एवा दुष्वप्न्यं सर्वं द्विषते सं नयामसि॥
verses.tr: yathā kalāṃ yathā śaphaṃ yatharṇaṃ saṃnayanti evā duṣvapnyaṃ sarvaṃ dviṣate saṃ nayāmasi
verses.en: As men discharge a debt, as they pay up an eighth and half-an-eighth, So the whole evil dream do we pay and assign unto our foe.

sections.label: To accompany the three daily libations
sections.name: Hymn 47

verses.sa:
अग्निः प्रातःसवने पात्वस्मान् वैश्वानरो विश्वकृद् विश्वशंभूः ।
स नः पावको द्रविणे दधात्वायुष्मन्तः सहभक्षाः स्याम॥
verses.tr: agniḥ prātaḥsavane pātvasmān vaiśvānaro viśvakṛd viśvaśaṃbhūḥ sa naḥ pāvako draviṇe dadhātvāyuṣmantaḥ sahabhakṣāḥ syāma
verses.en: Dear to all men, all-prosperer, all-creating, may Agni, guard us at the morn's libation. May he, the bright!' pure one, give us riches: may we have life, enjoying food together.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा मरुत इन्द्रो अस्मानस्मिन् द्वितीये सवने न जह्युः ।
आयुष्मन्तः प्रियमेषां वदन्तो वयं देवानां सुमतौ स्याम॥
verses.tr: viśve devā maruta indro asmānasmin dvitīye savane na jahyuḥ āyuṣmantaḥ priyameṣāṃ vadanto vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma
verses.en: At this our second offering may Indra, Maruts, and Visve Devas never fail us. Still may the favour of the Gods be with us, blest with long life and speaking words that please them.

verses.sa:
इदं तृतीयं सवनं कवीनामृतेन ये चमसमैरयन्त ।
ते सौधन्वनाः स्वऽरानशानाः स्विऽष्टिं नो अभि वस्यो नयन्तु॥
verses.tr: idaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ kavīnāmṛtena ye camasamairayanta te saudhanvanāḥ sva'rānaśānāḥ svi'ṣṭiṃ no abhi vasyo nayantu
verses.en: We pour this third libation of the Sages who fashioned forth the cup in proper order. "Winners of heaven, may they, Sudhanvan's children, lead our fair sacrifice to happy fortune.

sections.label: Formulas to be used at the three daily libations
sections.name: Hymn 48

verses.sa:
श्येनोऽसि गायत्रच्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे ।
स्वस्ति मा सं वहास्य यज्ञस्योदृचि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: śyeno'si gāyatracchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ vahāsya yajñasyodṛci svāhā
verses.en: Thou art the Hawk, Gayatri's lord: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. All hail!

verses.sa:
ऋभुरसि जगच्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे ।
स्वस्ति मा सं वहास्य यज्ञस्योदृचि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ṛbhurasi jagacchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ vahāsya yajñasyodṛci svāhā
verses.en: Thou art the Ribhu, lord of Jagati: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. All hail!

verses.sa:
वृषासि त्रिष्टुप्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे ।
स्वस्ति मा सं वहास्य यज्ञस्योदृचि स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vṛṣāsi triṣṭupchandā anu tvā rabhe svasti mā saṃ vahāsya yajñasyodṛci svāhā
verses.en: Thou art the Bull, the Trishtup's lord: I hold thee fast. Happily bear me to the goal of this my sacrifice. All hail!

sections.label: In praise of Agni
sections.name: Hymn 49

verses.sa:
नहि ते अग्ने तन्वः क्रूरमानंश मर्त्यः ।
कपिर्बभस्ति तेजनं स्वं जरायु गौरिव॥
verses.tr: nahi te agne tanvaḥ krūramānaṃśa martyaḥ kapirbabhasti tejanaṃ svaṃ jarāyu gauriva
verses.en: O Agni, in thy body man hath never found a wounded art. The Ape devours the arrow's shaft as a cow eats her afterbirth.

verses.sa:
मेष इव वै सं च वि चोर्वऽच्यसे यदुत्तरद्रावुपरश्च खादतः ।
शीर्ष्णा शिरोऽप्ससाप्सो अर्दयन्नंशून् बभस्ति हरितेभिरासभिः॥
verses.tr: meṣa iva vai saṃ ca vi corva'cyase yaduttaradrāvuparaśca khādataḥ śīrṣṇā śiro'psasāpso ardayannaṃśūn babhasti haritebhirāsabhiḥ
verses.en: Thou like a fleece contractest and expanses thee what time the upper stone and that below devour. Closely compressing head with head and breast with breast he crunches up the tendril with his yellow jaws.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णा वाचमक्रतोप द्यव्याखरे कृष्णा इषिरा अनर्तिषुः ।
नि यन्नियन्त्युपरस्य निष्कृतिं पुरू रेतो दधिरे सूर्यश्रितः॥
verses.tr: suparṇā vācamakratopa dyavyākhare kṛṣṇā iṣirā anartiṣuḥ ni yanniyantyuparasya niṣkṛtiṃ purū reto dadhire sūryaśritaḥ
verses.en: The Eagles have sent forth their voice aloud to heaven: in the sky's vault the dark impetuous ones have danced. When they come downward to repair the lower stone, they, dwellers with the Sun, have gained abundant seed.

sections.label: A charm for the destruction of. vermin
sections.name: Hymn 50

verses.sa:
हतं तर्दं समङ्कमाखुमश्विना छिन्तं शिरो अपि पृष्टीः शृणीतम्।
यवान्नेददानपि नह्यतं मुखमथाभयं कृणुतं धान्याऽय॥
verses.tr: hataṃ tardaṃ samaṅkamākhumaśvinā chintaṃ śiro api pṛṣṭīḥ śṛṇītam yavānnedadānapi nahyataṃ mukhamathābhayaṃ kṛṇutaṃ dhānyā'ya
verses.en: Destroy the rat, the mole, the boring beetle, cut off their heads and crush their ribs, O Asvins. Bind fast their mouths; let them not eat our barley: so guard, ye twain, our growing corn from danger.

verses.sa:
तर्द है पतङ्ग है जभ्य हा उपक्वस ।
ब्रह्मेवासंस्थितं हविरनदन्त इमान् यवानहिंसन्तो अपोदित॥
verses.tr: tarda hai pataṅga hai jabhya hā upakvasa brahmevāsaṃsthitaṃ haviranadanta imān yavānahiṃsanto apodita
verses.en: Ho! boring beetle, ho! thou worm, ho! noxious grub and grasshopper! As a priest leaves the unfinished sacrifice, go hence devouring not, injuring not this corn.

verses.sa:
तर्दापते वघापते तृष्टजम्भा आ शृणोत मे ।
य आरण्या व्यऽद्वरा ये के च स्थ व्यऽद्वरास्तान्त्सर्वान् जम्भयामसि॥
verses.tr: tardāpate vaghāpate tṛṣṭajambhā ā śṛṇota me ya āraṇyā vya'dvarā ye ke ca stha vya'dvarāstāntsarvān jambhayāmasi
verses.en: Hearken to me, lord of the female borer, lord of the female grub! ye rough-toothed vermin! Whatever ye be, dwelling in woods, and piercing, we crush and mangle all those piercing insects.

sections.label: A prayer for purification and forgiveness of sins
sections.name: Hymn 51

verses.sa:
वायोः पूतः पवित्रेण प्रत्यङ् सोमो अति द्रुतः ।
इन्द्रस्य युजः सखा॥
verses.tr: vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa pratyaṅ somo ati drutaḥ indrasya yujaḥ sakhā
verses.en: Cleansed by the filter of the Wind comes Soma past all our enemies, meet friend of Indra.

verses.sa:
आपो अस्मान् मातरः सूदयन्तु घृतेन नो घृतप्वः पुनन्तु ।
विश्वं हि रिप्रं प्रवहन्ति देवीरुदिदाभ्यः शुचिरा पूत एमि॥
verses.tr: āpo asmān mātaraḥ sūdayantu ghṛtena no ghṛtapvaḥ punantu viśvaṃ hi ripraṃ pravahanti devīrudidābhyaḥ śucirā pūta emi
verses.en: May the maternal Waters make us ready: cleanse us with fatness they who cleanse with fatness! The Goddesses bear off each blob and tarnish: I come forth from the waters cleansed and stainless.

verses.sa:
यत् किं चेदं वरुण दैव्ये जनेऽभिद्रोहं मनुष्या३श्चरन्ति ।
अचित्त्या चेत् तव धर्मा युयोपिम मा नस्तस्मादेनसो देव रीरिषः॥
verses.tr: yat kiṃ cedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane'bhidrohaṃ manuṣyā3ścaranti acittyā cet tava dharmā yuyopima mā nastasmādenaso deva rīriṣaḥ
verses.en: O Varuna, whatever the offence may be, the sin which men commit against the heavenly folk—When, through our want of thought we violate thy laws, punish us not, O God, for that iniquity.

sections.label: A charm against noxious reptiles and insects
sections.name: Hymn 52

verses.sa:
उत् सूर्यो दिव एति पुरो रक्षांसि निजूर्वन्।
आदित्यः पर्वतेभ्यो विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा॥
verses.tr: ut sūryo diva eti puro rakṣāṃsi nijūrvan ādityaḥ parvatebhyo viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā
verses.en: Slaying the Rakshasas, the Sun mounts upward in the front of heaven, fx Aditya, from the mountains, seen of all, destroying things unseen.

verses.sa:
नि गावो गोष्ठे असदन् नि मृगासो अविक्षत ।
न्यू३र्मयो नदीनं न्य१दृष्टा अलिप्सत॥
verses.tr: ni gāvo goṣṭhe asadan ni mṛgāso avikṣata nyū3rmayo nadīnaṃ nya1dṛṣṭā alipsata
verses.en: The kine had settled in their pen, wild animals had sought their lairs; The wavelets of the brooks had passed away, and were beheld no more.

verses.sa:
आयुर्ददं विपश्चितं श्रुतां कण्वस्य वीरुधम्।
आभारिषं विश्वभेषजीमस्यादृष्टान् नि शमयत्॥
verses.tr: āyurdadaṃ vipaścitaṃ śrutāṃ kaṇvasya vīrudham ābhāriṣaṃ viśvabheṣajīmasyādṛṣṭān ni śamayat
verses.en: I have brought Kanva's famous Plant, life-giving, and itself inspired, The medicine that healeth all: may it suppress my hidden foes.

sections.label: A prayer for recovery and preservation of health and security
sections.name: Hymn 53

verses.sa:
द्यौश्च म इदं पृथिवी च प्रचेतसौ शुक्रो बृहन् दक्षिणया पिपर्तु ।
अनु स्वधा चिकितां सोमो अग्निर्वायुर्नः पातु सविता भगश्च॥
verses.tr: dyauśca ma idaṃ pṛthivī ca pracetasau śukro bṛhan dakṣiṇayā pipartu anu svadhā cikitāṃ somo agnirvāyurnaḥ pātu savitā bhagaśca
verses.en: May Heaven and Earth, wise pair, may lofty Sukra grant me this thing by reason of the guerdon. May Agni, Soma mark through this libation: may Vayu, Savitar, and Bhaga guard us.

verses.sa:
पुनः प्राणः पुनरात्मा न ऐतु पुनश्चक्षुः पुनरसुर्न ऐतु ।
वैश्वानरो नो अदब्धस्तनूपा अन्तस्तिष्ठाति दुरितानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: punaḥ prāṇaḥ punarātmā na aitu punaścakṣuḥ punarasurna aitu vaiśvānaro no adabdhastanūpā antastiṣṭhāti duritāni viśvā
verses.en: Again return to us our breath and spirit, again come back to us our life and vision! Vaisvanara, unscathed, our bodies' guardian, stand between us and every woe and danger!

verses.sa:
सं वर्चसा पयसा सं तनूभिरगन्महि मनसा सं शिवेन ।
त्वष्टा नो अत्र वरीयः कृणोत्वनु नो मार्ष्टु तन्वो३यद् विरिष्टम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhiraganmahi manasā saṃ śivena tvaṣṭā no atra varīyaḥ kṛṇotvanu no mārṣṭu tanvo3yad viriṣṭam
verses.en: We are again united with our bodies, with happy mind, with spirit, strength, and splendour. May Tvashtar here make room for us, and freedom, and smooth whatever is injured in our bodies.

sections.label: A benediction on a newly elected King
sections.name: Hymn 54

verses.sa:
इदं तद् युज उत्तरमिन्द्रं शुम्भाम्यष्टये ।
अस्य क्षत्रं श्रियं महीं वृष्टिरिव वर्धया तृणम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ tad yuja uttaramindraṃ śumbhāmyaṣṭaye asya kṣatraṃ śriyaṃ mahīṃ vṛṣṭiriva vardhayā tṛṇam
verses.en: I win the love of Indra that his friend may reach yet higher state. Increase, as rain the grass, this man's dominion and his lofty fame.

verses.sa:
अस्मै क्षत्रमग्नीषोमावस्मै धारयतं रयिम्।
इमं राष्ट्रस्याभीवर्गे कृणुतं युज उत्तरम्॥
verses.tr: asmai kṣatramagnīṣomāvasmai dhārayataṃ rayim imaṃ rāṣṭrasyābhīvarge kṛṇutaṃ yuja uttaram
verses.en: Confirm the princely power in him, Agni and Soma! grant him wealth. In all the circuit of his rule make him yet higher for your friend.

verses.sa:
सबन्धुश्चासबन्धुश्च यो अस्मां अभिदासति ।
सर्वं तं रन्धयासि मे यजमानाय सुन्वते॥
verses.tr: sabandhuścāsabandhuśca yo asmāṃ abhidāsati sarvaṃ taṃ randhayāsi me yajamānāya sunvate
verses.en: The man who shows us enmity, whether a stranger or akin, Thou wilt give up entire to me who sacrifice and press the juice.

sections.label: A prayer for general protection and prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 55

verses.sa:
ये पन्थानो बहवो देवयाना अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी संचरन्ति ।
तेषामज्यानिं यतमो वहाति तस्मै मा देवाः परि धत्तेह सर्वे॥
verses.tr: ye panthāno bahavo devayānā antarā dyāvāpṛthivī saṃcaranti teṣāmajyāniṃ yatamo vahāti tasmai mā devāḥ pari dhatteha sarve
verses.en: Of all the many God-frequented pathways that traverse realms between the earth and heaven, Consign me, all ye Gods, to that which leadeth to perfect and inviolable safety.

verses.sa:
ग्रीष्मो हेमन्तः शिशिरो वसन्तः शरद् वर्षाः स्विते नो दधात ।
आ नो गोषु भजता प्रजायां निवात इद् वः शरणे स्याम॥
verses.tr: grīṣmo hemantaḥ śiśiro vasantaḥ śarad varṣāḥ svite no dadhāta ā no goṣu bhajatā prajāyāṃ nivāta id vaḥ śaraṇe syāma
verses.en: Maintain us in well-being Summer, Winter, Dew-time, and Spring, Autumn, and Rainy Season. Give us our share of cattle and of children. May we enjoy your unassailed protection.

verses.sa:
इदावत्सराय परिवत्सराय संवत्सराय कृणुता बृहन्नमः ।
तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम॥
verses.tr: idāvatsarāya parivatsarāya saṃvatsarāya kṛṇutā bṛhannamaḥ teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.en: Pay to the Year your lofty adoration, to the first Year, the second, and the present. May we abide in the auspicious favour and gracious love of these who claim our worship.

sections.label: I Pace. A charm against snakes
sections.name: Hymn 56

verses.sa:
मा नो देवा अहिर्वधीत् सतोकान्त्सहपुरुषान्।
सम्यतं न वि ष्परद् व्यात्तं न सं यमन्नमो देवजनेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: mā no devā ahirvadhīt satokāntsahapuruṣān samyataṃ na vi ṣparad vyāttaṃ na saṃ yamannamo devajanebhyaḥ
verses.en: Let not the serpent slay us, O Gods, with our children and our folk. Let it not close the opened mouth nor open that which now is closed.

verses.sa:
नमोऽस्त्वसिताय नमस्तिरश्चिराजये ।
स्वजाय बभ्रवे नमो नमो देवजनेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: namo'stvasitāya namastiraścirājaye svajāya babhrave namo namo devajanebhyaḥ
verses.en: Be worship paid unto the black, worship to that with stripes across! To the brown viper reverence, reverence to the demon brood!

verses.sa:
सं ते हन्मि दता दतः समु ते हन्वा हनू ।
सं ते जिह्वया जिह्वां सम्वास्नाह आस्यऽम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ te hanmi datā dataḥ samu te hanvā hanū saṃ te jihvayā jihvāṃ samvāsnāha āsya'm
verses.en: I close together fangs with fang, I close together jaws with jaw. I close together tongue with tongue, I close together mouth with mouth.

sections.label: A charm for a wound or bruise
sections.name: Hymn 57

verses.sa:
इदमिद् वा उ भेषजमिदं रुद्रस्य भेषजम्।
येनेषुमेकतेजनां शतशल्यामपब्रवत्॥
verses.tr: idamid vā u bheṣajamidaṃ rudrasya bheṣajam yeneṣumekatejanāṃ śataśalyāmapabravat
verses.en: This is a medicine indeed, Rudra's own medicine is this, Wherewith he warns the arrow off, one-shafted, With a hundred tips.

verses.sa:
जालाषेणाभि षिञ्चत जालाषेणोप सिञ्चत ।
जालाषमुग्रं भेषजं तेन नो मृड जीवसे॥
verses.tr: jālāṣeṇābhi ṣiñcata jālāṣeṇopa siñcata jālāṣamugraṃ bheṣajaṃ tena no mṛḍa jīvase
verses.en: "e" it with anodyne, bedew it with relieving balm: Strong, soothing is the medicine: bless us therewith that we may live.

verses.sa:
शं च नो मयश्च नो मा च नः किं चनाममत्।
क्षमा रपो विश्वं नो अस्तु भेषजं सर्वं नो अस्तु भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ ca no mayaśca no mā ca naḥ kiṃ canāmamat kṣamā rapo viśvaṃ no astu bheṣajaṃ sarvaṃ no astu bheṣajam
verses.en: Let it be health and joy to us. Let nothing vex or injure us. Down with the wound! Let all to us be balm, the whole be medicine.

sections.label: A priest's prayer for power and glory
sections.name: Hymn 58

verses.sa:
यशसं मेन्द्रो मघवान् कृणोतु यशसं द्यावापृथिवी उभे इमे।
यशसं मा देवः सविता कृणोतु प्रियो दातुर्दक्षिणाया इह स्याम्॥
verses.tr: yaśasaṃ mendro maghavān kṛṇotu yaśasaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime yaśasaṃ mā devaḥ savitā kṛṇotu priyo dāturdakṣiṇāyā iha syām
verses.en: May Indra Maghavan give me name and glory. May Heaven and Earth, this couple, make me famous. May Savitar the deity make me honoured. Here may the man who gives the guerdon love me.

verses.sa:
यथेन्द्रो द्यावापृथिव्योर्यशस्वान् यथाप ओषधीषु यशस्वतीः ।
एवा विश्वेषु देवेषु वयं सर्वेषु यशसः स्याम॥
verses.tr: yathendro dyāvāpṛthivyoryaśasvān yathāpa oṣadhīṣu yaśasvatīḥ evā viśveṣu deveṣu vayaṃ sarveṣu yaśasaḥ syāma
verses.en: Indra from Heaven and Earth receiveth glory, among the plants the Waters have their glory; Even so may we be glorious 'mid all the Universal Gods.

verses.sa:
यशा इन्द्रो यशा अग्निर्यशाः सोमो अजायत ।
यशा विश्वस्य भूतस्याहमस्मि यशस्तमः॥
verses.tr: yaśā indro yaśā agniryaśāḥ somo ajāyata yaśā viśvasya bhūtasyāhamasmi yaśastamaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Agni were renowned, famous was Soma at his birth; So too am I illustrious, most glorious of all that is.

sections.label: A charm to protect cattle and men
sections.name: Hymn 59

verses.sa:
अनडुद्भ्यस्त्वं प्रथमं धेनुभ्यस्त्वमरुन्धति ।
अधेनवे वयसे शर्म यच्छ चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: anaḍudbhyastvaṃ prathamaṃ dhenubhyastvamarundhati adhenave vayase śarma yaccha catuṣpade
verses.en: First, O Arundhati, protect our oxen and our milky kine: Protect each one that is infirm, each quadruped that yields no milk.

verses.sa:
शर्म यच्छत्वोषधिः सह देवीररुन्धती।
करत् पयस्वन्तं गोष्ठमयक्ष्मां उत पूरुषान्॥
verses.tr: śarma yacchatvoṣadhiḥ saha devīrarundhatī karat payasvantaṃ goṣṭhamayakṣmāṃ uta pūruṣān
verses.en: Let the Plant give us sheltering aid, Arundhati allied with Gods; Avert Consumption from our men and make our cow-pen rich in milk.

verses.sa:
विश्वरूपां सुभगामच्छावदामि जीवलाम्।
सा नो रुद्रस्यास्तां हेतिं दूरं नयतु गोभ्यः॥
verses.tr: viśvarūpāṃ subhagāmacchāvadāmi jīvalām sā no rudrasyāstāṃ hetiṃ dūraṃ nayatu gobhyaḥ
verses.en: I welcome the auspicious Plant, life-giving, wearing every hue. Far from our cattle may it turn the deadly dart which Rudra casts. A priest's prayer for power and glory.

sections.label: The wooing of a bride
sections.name: Hymn 60

verses.sa:
अयमा यात्यर्यमा पुरस्ताद् विषितस्तुपः ।
अस्या इचछन्नग्रुवै पतिमुत जायामजानये॥
verses.tr: ayamā yātyaryamā purastād viṣitastupaḥ asyā icachannagruvai patimuta jāyāmajānaye
verses.en: With forelock loosened o'er his brow here comes the wooer of the bride, Seeking a husband for this maid, a wife for this unmarried man.

verses.sa:
अश्रमदियमर्यमन्नन्यासां समनं यती।
अङ्गो न्वऽर्यमन्नस्या अन्याः समनमायति॥
verses.tr: aśramadiyamaryamannanyāsāṃ samanaṃ yatī aṅgo nva'ryamannasyā anyāḥ samanamāyati
verses.en: Wooer! this girl hath toiled in vain, going to others' marriages. Now to her wedding, verily, wooer! another maid shall come.

verses.sa:
धाता दाधार पृथिवीं धाता द्यामुत सूर्यम्।
धातास्या अग्रुवै पतिं दधातु प्रतिकाम्यऽम्॥
verses.tr: dhātā dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dhātā dyāmuta sūryam dhātāsyā agruvai patiṃ dadhātu pratikāmya'm
verses.en: Dhatar upholds the spacious earth, upholds the sky, upholds the Sun. Dhatar bestow upon this maid a husband suited to her wish!

sections.label: A prayer for prosperity and greatness
sections.name: Hymn 61

verses.sa:
मह्यमापो मधुमदेरयन्तां मह्यं सूरो अभरज्ज्योतिषे कम्।
मह्यं देवा उत विश्वे तपोजा मह्यं देवः सविता व्यचो धात्॥
verses.tr: mahyamāpo madhumaderayantāṃ mahyaṃ sūro abharajjyotiṣe kam mahyaṃ devā uta viśve tapojā mahyaṃ devaḥ savitā vyaco dhāt
verses.en: The Waters send me what is sweet and pleasant, Sara bring all I need for light and vision! The deities, and all of pious nature, and Savitar the God afford me freedom!

verses.sa:
अहं विवेच पृथिवीमुत द्यामहमृतूंरजनयं सप्त साकम्।
अहं सत्यमनृतं यद् वदाम्यहं दैवीं परि वाचं विशश्च॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ viveca pṛthivīmuta dyāmahamṛtūṃrajanayaṃ sapta sākam ahaṃ satyamanṛtaṃ yad vadāmyahaṃ daivīṃ pari vācaṃ viśaśca
verses.en: I set the heaven and the earth asunder, I brought all seven seasons into being. My word is truth, what I deny is falsehood, above celestial Vak, above the nations.

verses.sa:
अहं जजान पृथिवीमुत द्यामहमृतूंरजनयं सप्त सिन्धून्।
अहं सत्वमनृतं यद् वदामि यो अग्नीषोमावजुषे सखाया॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ jajāna pṛthivīmuta dyāmahamṛtūṃrajanayaṃ sapta sindhūn ahaṃ satvamanṛtaṃ yad vadāmi yo agnīṣomāvajuṣe sakhāyā
verses.en: I gave existence to the earth and heaven, I made the seasons and the seven rivers. My word is truth, what I deny is falsehood, I who rejoice in Agni's, Soma's friendship.

sections.label: A prayer for purification and riches
sections.name: Hymn 62

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिर्नः पुनातु वातः प्राणेनेषिरो नभोभिः ।
द्यावापृथिवी पयसा पयस्वती ऋतावरी यज्ञिये न पुनीताम्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaro raśmibhirnaḥ punātu vātaḥ prāṇeneṣiro nabhobhiḥ dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payasvatī ṛtāvarī yajñiye na punītām
verses.en: Cleanse us Vaisvanara with rays of splendour! With breath and clouds let quickening Vayu cleanse us, And, rich in milky rain, let Earth and Heaven, worshipful, holy, cleanse us with their water.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरीं सूनृतामा रभध्वं यस्या आशास्तन्वोऽवीतपृष्ठाः ।
तया गृणन्तः सधमादेषु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीनाम्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarīṃ sūnṛtāmā rabhadhvaṃ yasyā āśāstanvo'vītapṛṣṭhāḥ tayā gṛṇantaḥ sadhamādeṣu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīnām
verses.en: Lay hold on Sunrita whose forms and regions have fair smooth backs, her who is all men's treasure. Through her may we, in sacrificial banquets singing her glory, be the lords of riches.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरीं वर्चस आ रभध्वं शुद्धा भवन्तः शुचयः पावकाः ।
इहेडया सधमादं मदन्तो ज्योक् पश्येम सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarīṃ varcasa ā rabhadhvaṃ śuddhā bhavantaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ iheḍayā sadhamādaṃ madanto jyok paśyema sūryamuccarantam
verses.en: For splendour, seize on her whom all men worship, becoming pure yourselves, and bright, and brilliant. Here, through our prayer, rejoicing in the banquet, long may we look upon the Sun ascending.

sections.label: The symbolical liberation of a sacrificial victim
sections.name: Hymn 63

verses.sa:
यत् ते देवी निरृतिराबबन्ध दाम ग्रीवास्वविमोक्यं यत्।
तत् ते वि ष्याम्यायुषे वर्चसे बलायादोमदमन्नमद्धि प्रसूतः॥
verses.tr: yat te devī nirṛtirābabandha dāma grīvāsvavimokyaṃ yat tat te vi ṣyāmyāyuṣe varcase balāyādomadamannamaddhi prasūtaḥ
verses.en: That collar round thy neck, not to be loosened, which Nirriti the Goddess bound and fastened, I loose for thy long life and strength and vigour. Eat, liberated, food that brings no sorrow.

verses.sa:
नमोऽस्तु ते निरृते तिग्मतेजोऽयस्मयान् वि चृता बन्धपाशान्।
यमो मह्यं पुनरित् त्वां ददाति तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे॥
verses.tr: namo'stu te nirṛte tigmatejo'yasmayān vi cṛtā bandhapāśān yamo mahyaṃ punarit tvāṃ dadāti tasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave
verses.en: To thee, sharp-pointed Nirriti, be homage! Loose thou the binding fetters wrought of iron. To me, in truth, again doth Yama give thee. To him, to Yama, yea, to Death, be homage!

verses.sa:
अयस्मये द्रुपदे बेधिषे इहाभिहितो मृत्युभिर्ये सहस्रम्।
यमेन त्वं पितृभिः संविदान उत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम्॥
verses.tr: ayasmaye drupade bedhiṣe ihābhihito mṛtyubhirye sahasram yamena tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāna uttamaṃ nākamadhi rohayemam
verses.en: Compassed by death which comes in thousand manners, here art thou fastened to the iron pillar. Unanimous with Yama and the Father make this man rise and reach the loftiest heaven.

verses.sa:
संसमिद् युवसे वृषन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्यृ आ।
इडस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर॥
verses.tr: saṃsamid yuvase vṛṣannagne viśvānyaryṛ ā iḍaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyā bhara
verses.en: Thou, mighty Agni, good and true, gatherest up all precious things. Bring us all treasures as thou art enkindled at libation's place.

sections.label: To promote unanimity in an assembly
sections.name: Hymn 64

verses.sa:
सं जानीध्वं सं पृच्यध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम्।
देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते॥
verses.tr: saṃ jānīdhvaṃ saṃ pṛcyadhvaṃ saṃ vo manāṃsi jānatām devā bhāgaṃ yathā pūrve saṃjānānā upāsate
verses.en: Agree and be united: let your minds be all of one accord, Even as the Gods of ancient days, unanimous, await their share.

verses.sa:
समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं व्रतं सह चित्तमेषाम्।
समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि समानं चेतो अभिसंविशध्वम्॥
verses.tr: samāno mantraḥ samitiḥ samānī samānaṃ vrataṃ saha cittameṣām samānena vo haviṣā juhomi samānaṃ ceto abhisaṃviśadhvam
verses.en: The rede is common, common the assembly, common the law, so be their thoughts united. I offer up your general oblation: together entertain one common purpose.

verses.sa:
समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः ।
समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति॥
verses.tr: samānī va ākūtiḥ samānā hṛdayāni vaḥ samānamastu vo mano yathā vaḥ susahāsati
verses.en: One and the same be your resolve, be all your hearts in harmony: One and the same be all your minds that all may happily consent.

sections.label: A sacrificial charm against enemies
sections.name: Hymn 65

verses.sa:
अव मन्युरवायताव बाहू मनोयुजा ।
पराशर त्वं तेषां पराञ्चं शुष्ममर्दयाधा नो रयिमा कृधि॥
verses.tr: ava manyuravāyatāva bāhū manoyujā parāśara tvaṃ teṣāṃ parāñcaṃ śuṣmamardayādhā no rayimā kṛdhi
verses.en: The angry spirit hath relaxed: loose are the arms that act with mind. Do thou, destroyer, overcome and drive these foemen's might away, and then bring opulence to us.

verses.sa:
निर्हस्तेभ्यो नैर्हस्तं यं देवाः शरुमस्यथ ।
वृश्चामि शत्रूणां बाहूननेन हविषाहम्॥
verses.tr: nirhastebhyo nairhastaṃ yaṃ devāḥ śarumasyatha vṛścāmi śatrūṇāṃ bāhūnanena haviṣāham
verses.en: The shaft for handless fiends which, Gods! ye cast against the handless ones,—With this; in shape of sacrifice, I rend the arms of enemies.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्चकार प्रथमं नैर्हस्तमसुरेभ्यः ।
जयन्तु सत्वानो मम स्थिरेणेन्द्रेण मेदिना॥
verses.tr: indraścakāra prathamaṃ nairhastamasurebhyaḥ jayantu satvāno mama sthireṇendreṇa medinā
verses.en: Indra made first for Asuras the shaft designed for handless foes: Victorious shall my heroes be with Indra as their constant friend.

sections.label: A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies
sections.name: Hymn 66

verses.sa:
निर्हस्तः शत्रुरभिदासन्नस्तु ये सेनाभिर्युधमायन्त्यस्मान्।
समर्पयेन्द्र महता वधेन द्रात्वेषामघहारो विविद्धः॥
verses.tr: nirhastaḥ śatrurabhidāsannastu ye senābhiryudhamāyantyasmān samarpayendra mahatā vadhena drātveṣāmaghahāro vividdhaḥ
verses.en: Handles be every foeman who assaileth, they who with missiles come to fight against us! Dash them together with great slaughter, Indra I and let their robber chief run pierced with arrows.

verses.sa:
आतन्वाना आयच्छन्तोऽस्यन्तो ये च धावथ ।
निर्हस्ताः शत्रवः स्थनेन्द्रो वोऽद्य पराशरीत्॥
verses.tr: ātanvānā āyacchanto'syanto ye ca dhāvatha nirhastāḥ śatravaḥ sthanendro vo'dya parāśarīt
verses.en: Ye who run hither bending bows, brandishing swords and casting darts, Handless be ye, O enemies! Let Indra mangle you to-day.

verses.sa:
निर्हस्ताः सन्तु शत्रवोऽङ्गैषां म्लापयामसि ।
अथैषामिन्द्र वेदांसि शतशो वि भजामहै॥
verses.tr: nirhastāḥ santu śatravo'ṅgaiṣāṃ mlāpayāmasi athaiṣāmindra vedāṃsi śataśo vi bhajāmahai
verses.en: Handless be these our enemies! We enervate their languid limbs. So let us part among ourselves, in hundreds, Indra! all their wealth.

sections.label: A charm for the destruction and plunder of enemies
sections.name: Hymn 67

verses.sa:
परि वर्त्मानि सर्वत इन्द्रः पूषा च सस्रतुः ।
मुह्यन्त्वद्यामूः सेना अमित्राणां परस्तराम्॥
verses.tr: pari vartmāni sarvata indraḥ pūṣā ca sasratuḥ muhyantvadyāmūḥ senā amitrāṇāṃ parastarām
verses.en: Indra and Pushan have gone forth along the ways on every side. To-day those hosts of enemies must flee bewildered far away.

verses.sa:
मूढा अमित्राश्चरताशीर्षाण इवाहयः ।
तेषां वो अग्निमूढानामिन्द्रो हन्तु वरंवरम्॥
verses.tr: mūḍhā amitrāścaratāśīrṣāṇa ivāhayaḥ teṣāṃ vo agnimūḍhānāmindro hantu varaṃvaram
verses.en: Ye foes, come hitherward dismayed like serpents when their heads are gone. Let Indra slay each bravest one of you whom Agni hath confused.

verses.sa:
ऐषु नह्य वृषाजिनं हरिणस्या भियं कृधि ।
पराङमित्र एषत्वर्वाची गौरुपेषतु॥
verses.tr: aiṣu nahya vṛṣājinaṃ hariṇasyā bhiyaṃ kṛdhi parāṅamitra eṣatvarvācī gaurupeṣatu
verses.en: Gird thou a bullock's hide on these, make those as timid as the deer. Let the foe flee away, and let his kine come hitherward to us.

sections.label: A charm to accompany the shave of the beard
sections.name: Hymn 68

verses.sa:
आयमगन्त्सविता क्षुरेणोष्णेन वाय उदकेनेहि ।
आदित्या रुद्रा वसव उन्दन्तु सचेतसः सोमस्य राज्ञो वपत प्रचेतसः॥
verses.tr: āyamagantsavitā kṣureṇoṣṇena vāya udakenehi ādityā rudrā vasava undantu sacetasaḥ somasya rājño vapata pracetasaḥ
verses.en: Savitar hath come hither with the razor: come thou, O Vayu, with the heated water. One-minded let Adityas, Rudras, Vasus moisten the hair: shave, ye who know King Soma.

verses.sa:
अदितिः श्मश्रु वपत्वाप उन्दन्तु वर्चसा ।
चिकित्सतु प्रजापतिर्दीर्घायुत्वाय चक्षसे॥
verses.tr: aditiḥ śmaśru vapatvāpa undantu varcasā cikitsatu prajāpatirdīrghāyutvāya cakṣase
verses.en: Let Aditi shave the beard, and let the Waters bathe it with their strength: Prajapati restore his health for sight and days of lengthened life!

verses.sa:
येनावपत् सविता क्षुरेण सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य विद्वान्।
तेन ब्रह्माणो वपतेदमस्य गोमानश्ववानयमस्तु प्रजावान्॥
verses.tr: yenāvapat savitā kṣureṇa somasya rājño varuṇasya vidvān tena brahmāṇo vapatedamasya gomānaśvavānayamastu prajāvān
verses.en: The razor used by Savitar, for shaving, who knoweth Varuna and royal Soma,—Even with this shave ye this man, O Brahman. Let him be rich in horses, kine, and children.

sections.label: A priest's prayer for power and glory
sections.name: Hymn 69

verses.sa:
गिरावरगराटेषु हिरण्ये गोषु यद् यशः ।
सुरायां सिच्यमानायां कीलाले मधु तन्मयि॥
verses.tr: girāvaragarāṭeṣu hiraṇye goṣu yad yaśaḥ surāyāṃ sicyamānāyāṃ kīlāle madhu tanmayi
verses.en: Mine be the glory in the hill, in vales, in cattle, and in gold, Mine be the sweetness that is found in nectar and in flowing wine!

verses.sa:
