अश्विना सारघेण मा मधुनाङ्क्तं शुभस्पती ।
यथा भर्गस्वतीं वाचमावदानि जनाँ अनु॥
verses.tr: aśvinā sāragheṇa mā madhunāṅktaṃ śubhaspatī yathā bhargasvatīṃ vācamāvadāni janāṃ anu
verses.en: With your delicious honey balm me, Asvins, Lords of splendid light! That clear and resonant may be the voice I utter to mankind.

verses.sa:
मयि वर्चो अथो यशोऽथो यज्ञस्य यत् पयः ।
तन्मयि प्रजापतिर्दिवि द्यामिव दृंहतु॥
verses.tr: mayi varco atho yaśo'tho yajñasya yat payaḥ tanmayi prajāpatirdivi dyāmiva dṛṃhatu
verses.en: In me be strength, in me be fame, in me the power of sacrifice: Prajapati establish this in me as firm as light in heaven!

sections.label: A benediction on cow and calf
sections.name: Hymn 70

verses.sa:
यथा मांसं यथा सुरा यथाक्षा अधिदेवने ।
यथा पुंसो वृषण्यत स्त्रियां निहन्यते मनः ।
एवा ते अघ्न्ये मनोऽधि वत्से नि हन्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yathā māṃsaṃ yathā surā yathākṣā adhidevane yathā puṃso vṛṣaṇyata striyāṃ nihanyate manaḥ evā te aghnye mano'dhi vatse ni hanyatām
verses.en: As wine associates with flesh, as dice attend the gaming-board, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upon thy calf.

verses.sa:
यथा हस्ती हस्तिन्याः पदेन पदमुद्युजे।
यथा पुंसो वृषण्यत स्त्रियां निहन्यते मनः ।
एवा ते अघ्न्ये मनोऽधि वत्से नि हन्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yathā hastī hastinyāḥ padena padamudyuje yathā puṃso vṛṣaṇyata striyāṃ nihanyate manaḥ evā te aghnye mano'dhi vatse ni hanyatām
verses.en: As the male elephant pursues with eager step his female's track, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upon thy calf.

verses.sa:
यथा प्रधिर्यथोपधिर्यथा नभ्यं प्रधावधि ।
यथा पुंसो वृषण्यत स्त्रियां निहन्यते मनः ।
एवा ते अघ्न्ये मनोऽधि वत्से नि हन्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yathā pradhiryathopadhiryathā nabhyaṃ pradhāvadhi yathā puṃso vṛṣaṇyata striyāṃ nihanyate manaḥ evā te aghnye mano'dhi vatse ni hanyatām
verses.en: Close as the felly and the spoke, fixt as the wheel-rim on the nave, As an enamoured man's desire is firmly set upon a dame, So let thy heart and soul, O Cow, be firmly set upon thy calf. A priest's prayer for power and glory.

sections.label: A priest's benediction after meat
sections.name: Hymn 71

verses.sa:
यदन्नमद्मि बहुधा विरूपं हिरण्यमश्वमुत गामजामविम्।
यदेव किं च प्रतिजग्रहाहमग्निष्टद्धोता सुहुतं कृनोतु॥
verses.tr: yadannamadmi bahudhā virūpaṃ hiraṇyamaśvamuta gāmajāmavim yadeva kiṃ ca pratijagrahāhamagniṣṭaddhotā suhutaṃ kṛnotu
verses.en: What food I eat of varied form and nature, food whether gold, or horse, sheep, goat, or bullock, Whatever gift I have received, may Agni the Hotar make it sacrifice well-offered.

verses.sa:
यन्मा हुतमहुतमाजगाम दत्तं पितृभिरनुमतं मनुष्यैः ।
यस्मान्मे मन उदिव रारजीत्यग्निष्टद्धोता सुहुतं कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: yanmā hutamahutamājagāma dattaṃ pitṛbhiranumataṃ manuṣyaiḥ yasmānme mana udiva rārajītyagniṣṭaddhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu
verses.en: Whatever, sacrificed or not, hath reached me, bestowed by men and sanctioned by the Fathers, Whereby my heart seems to leap up, may Agni the Hotar make that sacrifice well-offered.

verses.sa:
यदन्नमद्म्यनृतेन देवा दास्यन्नदास्यन्नुत संगृणामि ।
वैश्वानरस्य महतो महिम्ना शिवं मह्यं मधुमदस्त्वन्नम्॥
verses.tr: yadannamadmyanṛtena devā dāsyannadāsyannuta saṃgṛṇāmi vaiśvānarasya mahato mahimnā śivaṃ mahyaṃ madhumadastvannam
verses.en: What food I eat unjustly, Gods! or, doubtful between bestowing and refusing, swallow, Through greatness of Vaisvanara the mighty may that same food be sweet to me and blessed!

sections.label: A charm to restore or increase virile power (Appendix)
sections.name: Hymn 72

verses.sa:
यथासितः प्रथयते वशाँ अनु वपूंषि कृण्वन्नसुरस्य मायया ।
एवा ते शेपः सहसायमर्कोऽङ्गेनाङ्गं संसमकं कृणोतु॥
यथा पसस्तायादरं वातेन स्थूलभं कृतम्।
यावत् परस्वतः पसस्तावत् ते वर्धतां पसः॥
यावदङ्गीनं पारस्वतं हास्तिनं गार्दभं च यत्।
यावदश्वस्य वाजिनस्तावत् ते वर्धतां पसः॥
verses.tr: yathāsitaḥ prathayate vaśāṃ anu vapūṃṣi kṛṇvannasurasya māyayā evā te śepaḥ sahasāyamarko'ṅgenāṅgaṃ saṃsamakaṃ kṛṇotu yathā pasastāyādaraṃ vātena sthūlabhaṃ kṛtam yāvat parasvataḥ pasastāvat te vardhatāṃ pasaḥ yāvadaṅgīnaṃ pārasvataṃ hāstinaṃ gārdabhaṃ ca yat yāvadaśvasya vājinastāvat te vardhatāṃ pasaḥ
verses.en: [Griffith gives this hymn only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation.]

sections.label: A King's charm to conciliate his discontented kinsmen
sections.name: Hymn 73

verses.sa:
एह यातु वरुणः सोमो अग्निर्बृहस्पतिर्वसुभिरेह यातु ।
अस्य श्रियमुपसंयात सर्व उग्रस्य चेत्तुः संमनसः सजाताः॥
verses.tr: eha yātu varuṇaḥ somo agnirbṛhaspatirvasubhireha yātu asya śriyamupasaṃyāta sarva ugrasya cettuḥ saṃmanasaḥ sajātāḥ
verses.en: Let Varuna come hither, Soma, Agni, Brihaspati come hither with the Vasus! Unanimous, ye kinsmen, come united, come to the glory of this mighty guardian.

verses.sa:
यो वः शुष्मो हृदयेष्वन्तराकूतिर्या वो मनसि प्रविष्टा ।
तान्त्सीवयामि हविषा घृतेन मयि सजाता रमतिर्वो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: yo vaḥ śuṣmo hṛdayeṣvantarākūtiryā vo manasi praviṣṭā tāntsīvayāmi haviṣā ghṛtena mayi sajātā ramatirvo astu
verses.en: The inclination which your hearts have harboured, the purpose which hath occupied your spirits, This I annul with sacrifice and butter. In me be your sweet resting-place, O kinsmen.

verses.sa:
इहैव स्त माप याताध्यस्मत् पूषा परस्तादपथं वः कृणोतु ।
वास्तोष्पतिरनु वो जोहवीतु मयि सजाता रमतिर्वो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: ihaiva sta māpa yātādhyasmat pūṣā parastādapathaṃ vaḥ kṛṇotu vāstoṣpatiranu vo johavītu mayi sajātā ramatirvo astu
verses.en: Stand even here: forsake me not. Before us may Pushan make your path unfit to travel. Vastoshpati incessantly recall you! In me be your sweet resting-place, O kinsmen!

sections.label: A King's charm to secure the fidelity of his people
sections.name: Hymn 74

verses.sa:
सं वः पृच्यन्तां तन्वः१ सं मनांसि समु व्रता।
सं वोऽयं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्भगः सं वो अजीगमत्॥
verses.tr: saṃ vaḥ pṛcyantāṃ tanvaḥ1 saṃ manāṃsi samu vratā saṃ vo'yaṃ brahmaṇaspatirbhagaḥ saṃ vo ajīgamat
verses.en: Close gathered be your bodies: be your minds and vows in unison! Here present Brahmanaspati and Bhaga have assembled you.

verses.sa:
संज्ञपनं वो मनसोऽथो संज्ञपनं हृदः ।
अथो भगस्य यच्छ्रान्तं तेन संज्ञपयामि वः॥
verses.tr: saṃjñapanaṃ vo manaso'tho saṃjñapanaṃ hṛdaḥ atho bhagasya yacchrāntaṃ tena saṃjñapayāmi vaḥ
verses.en: Let there be union of your minds, let there be union of your hearts: All that is troubled in your lot with this I mend and harmonize. fs

verses.sa:
यथादित्या वसुभिः संबभूवुर्मरुद्भिरुग्रा अहृणीयमानाः ।
एवा त्रिणामन्नहृणीयमान इमान् जनान्त्संमनसस्कृधीह॥
verses.tr: yathādityā vasubhiḥ saṃbabhūvurmarudbhirugrā ahṛṇīyamānāḥ evā triṇāmannahṛṇīyamāna imān janāntsaṃmanasaskṛdhīha
verses.en: As, free from jealousy, the strong Adityas have been the Vasus' and the Rudras' fellows, So free from jealousy, Lord of Three Titles! cause thou these people here to be one-minded.

sections.label: A charm to effect the removal of an enemy
sections.name: Hymn 75

verses.sa:
निरमुं नुद ओकसः सपत्नो यः पृतन्यति ।
नैर्बाध्येऽन हविषेन्द्र एनं पराशरीत्॥
verses.tr: niramuṃ nuda okasaḥ sapatno yaḥ pṛtanyati nairbādhye'na haviṣendra enaṃ parāśarīt
verses.en: Forth from his dwelling drive that man, the foeman who assaileth us: Through the Expellent sacrifice hath Indra rent and mangled him.

verses.sa:
परमां तं परावतमिन्द्रो नुदतु वृत्रहा।
यतो न पुनरायति शश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: paramāṃ taṃ parāvatamindro nudatu vṛtrahā yato na punarāyati śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ
verses.en: Indra, Foe-slayer, drive him forth into the distance most remote, Whence never more shall he return in all the years that are to come.

verses.sa:
एतु तिस्रः परावत एतु पञ्च जनाँ अति ।
एतु तिस्रोऽति रोचना यतो न पुनरायति ।
शश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यो यावत् सूर्यो असद् दिवि॥
verses.tr: etu tisraḥ parāvata etu pañca janāṃ ati etu tisro'ti rocanā yato na punarāyati śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyo yāvat sūryo asad divi
verses.en: To the three distances, beyond mankind's Five Races, let him go, Beyond the three skies let him go, whence he shall never come again In all the years that are to be, long as the Sun is in the heaven.

sections.label: A benediction on a new-born Kshatriya child
sections.name: Hymn 76

verses.sa:
य एनं परिषीदन्ति समादधति चक्षसे ।
संप्रेद्धो अग्निर्जिह्वाभिरुदेतु हृदयादधि॥
verses.tr: ya enaṃ pariṣīdanti samādadhati cakṣase saṃpreddho agnirjihvābhirudetu hṛdayādadhi
verses.en: Those who are sitting round this babe prepare him to be looked upon. Let Agni thoroughly inflamed with all his tongues. rise from his heart.

verses.sa:
अग्नेः सान्तपनस्याहमायुषे पदमा रभे ।
अद्धातिर्यस्य पश्यति धूममुद्यन्तमास्यतः॥
verses.tr: agneḥ sāntapanasyāhamāyuṣe padamā rabhe addhātiryasya paśyati dhūmamudyantamāsyataḥ
verses.en: For length of life I use the name of Agni the Consuming God, Whose smoke the sage who knows the truth beholds proceeding from his mouth.

verses.sa:
यो अस्य समिधं वेद क्षत्रियेण समाहिताम्।
नाभिह्वारे पदं नि दधाति स मृत्यवे॥
verses.tr: yo asya samidhaṃ veda kṣatriyeṇa samāhitām nābhihvāre padaṃ ni dadhāti sa mṛtyave
verses.en: The man who knows his fuel laid in order by the Kshatriya: Sets not his foot upon the steep declivity that leads to Death.

verses.sa:
नैनं घ्नन्ति पर्यायिणो न सन्नाँ अव गच्छति ।
अग्नेर्यः क्षत्रियो विद्वान् नाम गृह्णात्यायुषे॥
verses.tr: nainaṃ ghnanti paryāyiṇo na sannāṃ ava gacchati agneryaḥ kṣatriyo vidvān nāma gṛhṇātyāyuṣe
verses.en: Those who encompass slay him not: he goes not near his lurking foes—The Kshatriya who, knowing well, takes Agni's name for length of life.

sections.label: A charm to bring the cattle home
sections.name: Hymn 77

verses.sa:
अस्थाद् द्यौरस्थात् पृथिव्यस्थाद् विश्वमिदं जगत्।
आस्थाने पर्वता अस्थु स्थाम्न्यश्वां अतिष्ठिपम्॥
verses.tr: asthād dyaurasthāt pṛthivyasthād viśvamidaṃ jagat āsthāne parvatā asthu sthāmnyaśvāṃ atiṣṭhipam
verses.en: Firm stands the heaven, firm stands the earth, firm stands this universal world, Firm stand the rooted mountains. I have put the horses in the stall.

verses.sa:
य उदानट् परायणं य उदानण् न्यायनम्।
आवर्तनं निवर्तनं यो गोपा अपि तं हुवे॥
verses.tr: ya udānaṭ parāyaṇaṃ ya udānaṇ nyāyanam āvartanaṃ nivartanaṃ yo gopā api taṃ huve
verses.en: I call the Herdsman, him who knows the way to drive the cattle forth, Who knows the way to drive them home, to drive them back and drive them in.

verses.sa:
जातवेदो नि वर्तय शतं ते सन्त्वावतः ।
सहस्रं त उपावृतस्तभिर्नः पुनरा कृधि॥
verses.tr: jātavedo ni vartaya śataṃ te santvāvataḥ sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtastabhirnaḥ punarā kṛdhi
verses.en: O Jatavedas, turn them back: a hundred homeward ways be thine! Thou hast a thousand avenues: by these restore our kine to us.

sections.label: A nuptial benediction
sections.name: Hymn 78

verses.sa:
तेन भूतेन हविषायमा प्यायतां पुनः ।
जायां यामस्मा आवाक्षुस्तां रसेनाभि वर्धताम्॥
verses.tr: tena bhūtena haviṣāyamā pyāyatāṃ punaḥ jāyāṃ yāmasmā āvākṣustāṃ rasenābhi vardhatām
verses.en: Let this man be again bedewed with this presented sacrifice, And comfort with the sap of life the bride whom they have brought to him.

verses.sa:
अभि वर्धतां पयसाभि राष्ट्रेण वर्धताम्।
रय्या सहस्रवर्चसेमौ स्तामनुपक्षितौ॥
verses.tr: abhi vardhatāṃ payasābhi rāṣṭreṇa vardhatām rayyā sahasravarcasemau stāmanupakṣitau
verses.en: With life's sap let him comfort her, and raise her high with princely sway. In wealth that hath a thousand powers, this pair be inexhaustible!

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा जायामजनयत् त्वष्टास्यै त्वां पतिम्।
त्वष्टा सहस्रमायूंषि दीर्घमायुः कृणोतु वाम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā jāyāmajanayat tvaṣṭāsyai tvāṃ patim tvaṣṭā sahasramāyūṃṣi dīrghamāyuḥ kṛṇotu vām
verses.en: Tvashtar formed her to be thy dame, Tvashtar made thee to be her lord. Long life let Tvashtar give you both. Let Tvashtar give a thousand lives.

sections.label: A prayer for seasonable rain and prosperity
sections.name: Hymn 79

verses.sa:
अयं नो नभसस्पतिः संस्फानो अभि रक्षतु ।
असमातिं गृहेषु नः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ no nabhasaspatiḥ saṃsphāno abhi rakṣatu asamātiṃ gṛheṣu naḥ
verses.en: May this our Lord of Cloudy Sky, bedewed with liquid drops, preserve unequalled riches in our homes.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो नभसस्पत ऊर्जं गृहेषु धारय ।
आ पुष्टमेत्वा वसु॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no nabhasaspata ūrjaṃ gṛheṣu dhāraya ā puṣṭametvā vasu
verses.en: Lord of the Cloudy Sky, bestow vigour and strength on our abodes. Let wealth and treasure come to us.

verses.sa:
देव संस्फान सहस्रापोषस्येशिषे ।
तस्य नो रास्व तस्य नो धेहि तस्य ते भक्तिवांसः स्याम॥
verses.tr: deva saṃsphāna sahasrāpoṣasyeśiṣe tasya no rāsva tasya no dhehi tasya te bhaktivāṃsaḥ syāma
verses.en: Thou, God bedewed with drops, art Lord of infinite prosperity. Grant us thereof, give us thereof: may we -enjoy this boon of thine.

sections.label: A prayer for help and protection
sections.name: Hymn 80

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षेण पतति विश्वा भूतावचाकशत्।
शुनो दिव्यस्य यन्महस्तेना ते हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā bhūtāvacākaśat śuno divyasya yanmahastenā te haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: He flieth in the firmament observing all the things that be: We with this offering will adore the greatness of the Heavenly Hound.

verses.sa:
ये त्रयः कालकाञ्जा दिवि देवा इव श्रिताः ।
तान्त्सर्वानह्व ऊतयेऽस्मा अरिष्टतातये॥
verses.tr: ye trayaḥ kālakāñjā divi devā iva śritāḥ tāntsarvānahva ūtaye'smā ariṣṭatātaye
verses.en: The three, the Kalakanjas, set aloft in heaven as they were Gods—All these I call to be our help and keep this man secure from harm.

verses.sa:
अप्सु ते जन्म दिवि ते सधस्थं समुद्रे अन्तर्महिमा ते पृथिव्याम्।
शुनो दिव्यस्य यन्महस्तेना ते हविषा विधेम॥
verses.tr: apsu te janma divi te sadhasthaṃ samudre antarmahimā te pṛthivyām śuno divyasya yanmahastenā te haviṣā vidhema
verses.en: In waters is thy birth, in heaven thy station, thy majesty on earth and in the ocean. We with this offering will adore the greatness of the Heavenly Hound,

sections.label: A charm to facilitate child-birth
sections.name: Hymn 81

verses.sa:
यन्तासि यच्छसे हस्तावप रक्षांसि सेधसि ।
प्रजां धनं च गृह्णानः परिहस्तो अभूदयम्॥
verses.tr: yantāsi yacchase hastāvapa rakṣāṃsi sedhasi prajāṃ dhanaṃ ca gṛhṇānaḥ parihasto abhūdayam
verses.en: Thou art a grasper, holding fast both hands: thou drivest fiends away. A. holder both of progeny and riches hath this Ring become.

verses.sa:
परिहस्त वि धारय योनिं गर्भाय धातवे ।
मर्यादे पुत्रमा धेहि तं त्वमा गमयागमे॥
verses.tr: parihasta vi dhāraya yoniṃ garbhāya dhātave maryāde putramā dhehi taṃ tvamā gamayāgame
verses.en: Prepare accordantly, O King, the mother for the infant's birth. On the right way bring forth the boy. Make him come hither. I am here.

verses.sa:
यं परिहस्तमबिभरदितिः पुत्रकाम्या।
त्वष्टा तमस्या आ बध्नाद् यथा पुत्रं जनादिति॥
verses.tr: yaṃ parihastamabibharaditiḥ putrakāmyā tvaṣṭā tamasyā ā badhnād yathā putraṃ janāditi
verses.en: The Amulet which Aditi wore when desirous of a son, Tvashtar hath bound upon this dame and said, Be mother of a boy.

sections.label: A charm to win a bride
sections.name: Hymn 82

verses.sa:
आगच्छत आगतस्य नाम गृह्णाम्यायतः ।
इन्द्रस्य वृत्रघ्नो वन्वे वासवस्य शतक्रतोः॥
verses.tr: āgacchata āgatasya nāma gṛhṇāmyāyataḥ indrasya vṛtraghno vanve vāsavasya śatakratoḥ
verses.en: I Call the name of him who comes, hath come, and still draws nigh to us. Foe-slaying Indra's name I love, the Vasus' friend with hundred powers.

verses.sa:
येन सूर्यां सावित्रीमश्विनोहतुः पथा।
तेन मामब्रवीद् भगो जायामा वहतादिति॥
verses.tr: yena sūryāṃ sāvitrīmaśvinohatuḥ pathā tena māmabravīd bhago jāyāmā vahatāditi
verses.en: Thus Bhaga spake to me: Let him bring thee a consort by the path Whereon the Asvins brought the bride Surya the child of Savitar.

verses.sa:
यस्तेऽङ्कुशो वसुदानो बृहन्निन्द्र हिरण्ययः ।
तेना जनीयते जायां मह्यं धेहि शचीपते॥
verses.tr: yaste'ṅkuśo vasudāno bṛhannindra hiraṇyayaḥ tenā janīyate jāyāṃ mahyaṃ dhehi śacīpate
verses.en: Great, Indra, is that hook of thine, bestowing treasure, wrought of gold: Therewith, O Lord of Might, bestow a wife on me who long to wed.

sections.label: A charm against sores and pustules (apachitas)
sections.name: Hymn 83

verses.sa:
अपचितः प्र पतत सुपर्णो वसतेरिव ।
सूर्यः कृणोतु भेषजं चन्द्रमा वोऽपोच्छतु॥
verses.tr: apacitaḥ pra patata suparṇo vasateriva sūryaḥ kṛṇotu bheṣajaṃ candramā vo'pocchatu
verses.en: Hence, Sores and Pustules, fly away even as the eagle from his home. Let Surya bring a remedy, the Moon shine forth and banish you.

verses.sa:
एन्येका श्येन्येका कृष्णैका रोहिणी द्वे।
सर्वासामग्रभं नामावीरघ्नीरपेतन॥
verses.tr: enyekā śyenyekā kṛṣṇaikā rohiṇī dve sarvāsāmagrabhaṃ nāmāvīraghnīrapetana
verses.en: One bright with variegated tints, one white, one black, a couple red:—The names of all have I declared. Begone, and injure not our men.

verses.sa:
असूतिका रामायण्यऽपचित् प्र पतिष्यति ।
ग्लरितः प्र पतिष्यति स गलुन्तो नशिष्यति॥
वीहि स्वामाहुतिं जुषाणो मनसा स्वाहा मनसा यदिदं जुहोमि॥
verses.tr: asūtikā rāmāyaṇya'pacit pra patiṣyati glaritaḥ pra patiṣyati sa galunto naśiṣyati vīhi svāmāhutiṃ juṣāṇo manasā svāhā manasā yadidaṃ juhomi
verses.en: Hence, childless, shall the Pustule flee, granddaughter of the dusky one. The Boil shall fly away from us, the morbid growth shall vanish hence. Taste, happy in thy mind, thine own oblation, as I with Svaha with my heart present it.

sections.label: A charm to accompany the symbolical loosing of sacrificial victims
sections.name: Hymn 84

verses.sa:
यस्यास्त आसनि घोरे जुहोम्येषां बद्धानामवसर्जनाय कम्।
भूमिरिति त्वाभिप्रमन्वते जना निरृतिरिति त्वाहं परि वेद सर्वतः॥
verses.tr: yasyāsta āsani ghore juhomyeṣāṃ baddhānāmavasarjanāya kam bhūmiriti tvābhipramanvate janā nirṛtiriti tvāhaṃ pari veda sarvataḥ
verses.en: Thou in whose dread mouth I present oblation, that these bound victims may obtain their freedom, The people deem that thou art Earth: I know thee thoroughly, and I say thou art Destruction.

verses.sa:
भूते हविष्मती भवैष ते भागो यो अस्मासु ।
मुञ्चेमानमूनेनसः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: bhūte haviṣmatī bhavaiṣa te bhāgo yo asmāsu muñcemānamūnenasaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Be thou enriched, O Welfare, with oblations, here, among us is thine allotted portion. Free—Hail to thee!—from sin those here and yonder.

verses.sa:
एवो ष्व१स्मन्निरृतेऽनेहा त्वमयस्मयान् वि चृता बन्धपाशान्।
यमो मह्यं पुनरित् त्वां ददाति तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे॥
verses.tr: evo ṣva1smannirṛte'nehā tvamayasmayān vi cṛtā bandhapāśān yamo mahyaṃ punarit tvāṃ dadāti tasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave
verses.en: Do thou, Destruction, thus, without a rival, release us from the iron bonds that bind us. To me doth Yama verily restore thee. To him, to Yama, yea, to Death be worship!

verses.sa:
अयस्मये द्रुपदे बेधिष इहाभिहितो मृत्युभिर्ये सहस्रम्।
यमेन त्वं पितृभिः संविदान उत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम्॥
verses.tr: ayasmaye drupade bedhiṣa ihābhihito mṛtyubhirye sahasram yamena tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāna uttamaṃ nākamadhi rohayemam
verses.en: Thou hast been fastened to an iron pillar, here compassed with a thousand deaths around thee. In full accord with Yama and the Fathers, send this man upward to the loftiest heaven.

sections.label: A charm against Consumption
sections.name: Hymn 85

verses.sa:
वरणो वारयाता अयं देवो वनस्पतिः ।
यक्ष्मो यो अस्मिन्नाविष्टस्तमु देवा अवीवरन्॥
verses.tr: varaṇo vārayātā ayaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ yakṣmo yo asminnāviṣṭastamu devā avīvaran
verses.en: Let Varana the heavenly tree here present keep disease away. The Gods have driven off Decline that entered and possessed this man.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वचसा वयं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य च ।
देवानां सर्वेषां वाचा यक्ष्मं ते वारयामहे॥
verses.tr: indrasya vacasā vayaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya ca devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vācā yakṣmaṃ te vārayāmahe
verses.en: We with the speech of Indra and of Mitra and of Varuna, We with the speech of all the Gods will drive Decline away from thee.

verses.sa:
यथा वृत्र इमा आपस्तस्तम्भ विश्वधा यतीः ।
एवा ते अग्निना यक्ष्मं वैश्वानरेण वारये॥
verses.tr: yathā vṛtra imā āpastastambha viśvadhā yatīḥ evā te agninā yakṣmaṃ vaiśvānareṇa vāraye
verses.en: Even as Vritra checked and stayed these waters flowing every way, With Agni, God of all mankind. I check and banish thy Decline.

sections.label: A glorification of a newly consecrated King
sections.name: Hymn 86

verses.sa:
वृषेन्द्रस्य वृषा दिवो वृषा पृथिव्या अयम्।
वृषा विश्वस्य भूतस्य त्वमेकवृषो भव॥
verses.tr: vṛṣendrasya vṛṣā divo vṛṣā pṛthivyā ayam vṛṣā viśvasya bhūtasya tvamekavṛṣo bhava
verses.en: This is the Lord of Indra, this the Lord of Heaven, the Lord of Earth, The Lord of all existing things: the one and only Lord be thou.

verses.sa:
समुद्र ईशे स्रवतामग्निः पृथिव्या वशी।
चन्द्रमा नक्षत्राणामीशे त्वमेकवृषो भव॥
verses.tr: samudra īśe sravatāmagniḥ pṛthivyā vaśī candramā nakṣatrāṇāmīśe tvamekavṛṣo bhava
verses.en: The Sea is regent of the floods, Agni is ruler of the land, The Moon is regent of the stars: the one and only Lord be thou.

verses.sa:
सम्राडस्यसुराणां ककुन्मनुष्याऽणाम्।
देवानामर्धभागसि त्वमेकवृषो भव॥
verses.tr: samrāḍasyasurāṇāṃ kakunmanuṣyā'ṇām devānāmardhabhāgasi tvamekavṛṣo bhava
verses.en: Thou art the King of Asuras, the crown and summit of mankind: Thou art the partner of the Gods: the one and only Lord be thou.

sections.label: A benediction addressed to a newly elected King
sections.name: Hymn 87

verses.sa:
आ त्वाहार्षमन्तरभूर्ध्रुवस्तिष्ठाविचाचलत्।
विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद् राष्ट्रमधि भ्रशत्॥
verses.tr: ā tvāhārṣamantarabhūrdhruvastiṣṭhāvicācalat viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvad rāṣṭramadhi bhraśat
verses.en: Here art thou: I have chosen thee. Stand stedfast and immovable. Let all the clans desire thee: let not thy kingdom fall away.

verses.sa:
इहैवैधि माप च्योष्ठाः पर्वत इवाविचाचलत्।
इन्द्र इवेह ध्रुवस्तिष्ठेह राष्ट्रमु धारय॥
verses.tr: ihaivaidhi māpa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvata ivāvicācalat indra iveha dhruvastiṣṭheha rāṣṭramu dhāraya
verses.en: Be even here: fall not away: be like a mountain unremoved. Stand stedfast here like Indra's self, and hold the kingship in the grasp.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र एतमदीधरत् ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषा ।
तस्मै सोमो अधि ब्रवदयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: indra etamadīdharat dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa haviṣā tasmai somo adhi bravadayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatiḥ
verses.en: This man hath Indra stablished, made secure by constant sacrifice. Soma, and Brahmanaspati here present bless and comfort him!

sections.label: A benediction addressed to a newly elected King
sections.name: Hymn 88

verses.sa:
ध्रुवा द्यौर्ध्रुवा पृथिवी ध्रुवं विश्वमिदं जगत्।
ध्रुवासः पर्वता इमे ध्रुवो राजा विशामयम्॥
verses.tr: dhruvā dyaurdhruvā pṛthivī dhruvaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime dhruvo rājā viśāmayam
verses.en: Firm is the sky, firm is the earth, and firm is all this living world; Firm are these mountains on their base, and stedfast is this King of men.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवं ते राजा वरुणो ध्रुवं देवो बृहस्पतिः ।
ध्रुवं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च राष्ट्रं धारयतां ध्रुवम्॥
verses.tr: dhruvaṃ te rājā varuṇo dhruvaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ dhruvaṃ ta indraścāgniśca rāṣṭraṃ dhārayatāṃ dhruvam
verses.en: Stedfast may Varuna the King, stedfast the God Brihaspati, Stedfast may Indra, stedfast, too, may Agni keep thy stedfast reign.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवोऽच्युतः प्र मृणीहि शत्रून्छत्रूयतोऽधरान् पादयस्व ।
सर्वा दिशः संमनसः सध्रीचीर्ध्रुवाय ते समितिः कल्पतामिह॥
verses.tr: dhruvo'cyutaḥ pra mṛṇīhi śatrūnchatrūyato'dharān pādayasva sarvā diśaḥ saṃmanasaḥ sadhrīcīrdhruvāya te samitiḥ kalpatāmiha
verses.en: Firm, never to be shaken, crush thy foemen, under thy feet lay those who strive against thee. One-minded, true to thee be all the regions: faithful to thee, the firm, be this assembly!

sections.label: A man's love charm
sections.name: Hymn 89

verses.sa:
इदं यत् प्रेण्यः शिरो दत्तं सोमेन वृष्ण्यम्।
ततः परि प्रजातेन हार्दिं ते शोचयामसि॥
verses.tr: idaṃ yat preṇyaḥ śiro dattaṃ somena vṛṣṇyam tataḥ pari prajātena hārdiṃ te śocayāmasi
verses.en: This strength that Soma hath bestowed, the head of her who gladdeneth,—With that which thence hath been produced we make thy spirit sorrowful.

verses.sa:
शोचयामसि ते हार्दिं शोचयामसि ते मनः ।
वातं धूम इव सध्र्य१ङ्मामेवान्वेतु ते मनः॥
verses.tr: śocayāmasi te hārdiṃ śocayāmasi te manaḥ vātaṃ dhūma iva sadhrya1ṅmāmevānvetu te manaḥ
verses.en: We make thy spirit sorrowful, we fill thy mind with pain and grief. As smoke accompanies the wind, so let thy fancy follow me.

verses.sa:
मह्यं त्वा मित्रावरुणौ मह्यं देवी सरस्वती ।
मह्यं त्वा मध्यं भूम्या उभावन्तौ समस्यताम्॥
verses.tr: mahyaṃ tvā mitrāvaruṇau mahyaṃ devī sarasvatī mahyaṃ tvā madhyaṃ bhūmyā ubhāvantau samasyatām
verses.en: May Varuna and Mitra, may Sarasvati the Goddess, may The centre of the earth, and both her limits bring thee close to me.

sections.label: A charm to cure a poisoned man
sections.name: Hymn 90

verses.sa:
यां ते रुद्र इषुमास्यदङ्गेभ्यो हृदयाय च ।
इदं तामद्य त्वद् वयं विषूचीं वि वृहामसि॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te rudra iṣumāsyadaṅgebhyo hṛdayāya ca idaṃ tāmadya tvad vayaṃ viṣūcīṃ vi vṛhāmasi
verses.en: The shaft that Rudra hath shot forth against thy members and thy heart, l Here do we draw from thee to-day, and turn it hence to every side.

verses.sa:
यास्ते शतं धमनयोऽङ्गान्यनु विष्ठिताः ।
तासां ते सर्वासां वयं निर्विषाणि ह्वयामसि॥
verses.tr: yāste śataṃ dhamanayo'ṅgānyanu viṣṭhitāḥ tāsāṃ te sarvāsāṃ vayaṃ nirviṣāṇi hvayāmasi
verses.en: From all the hundred vessels spread throughout the members of thy frame, From all those vessels and canals we call the poisonous matter forth.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते रुद्रास्यते नमः प्रतिहितायै ।
नमो विसृज्यमानायै नमो निपतितायै॥
verses.tr: namaste rudrāsyate namaḥ pratihitāyai namo visṛjyamānāyai namo nipatitāyai
verses.en: Worship to thee, the archer, and, O Rudra, to thy levelled shaft! Yea, worship to thine arrow when it left the bow, and when it fell!

sections.label: A charm against disease
sections.name: Hymn 91

verses.sa:
इमं यवमष्टायोगैः षड्योगेभिरचर्कृषुः ।
तेना ते तन्वो३रपो ऽपाचीनमप व्यये॥
verses.tr: imaṃ yavamaṣṭāyogaiḥ ṣaḍyogebhiracarkṛṣuḥ tenā te tanvo3rapo 'pācīnamapa vyaye
verses.en: They made this barley ready with a team of eight, a team of six. With this I drive to westward, far away, thy bodily disease.

verses.sa:
न्य१ग्वातो वाति न्यऽक् तपति सूर्यः ।
नीचीनमघ्न्या दुहे न्यऽग् भवतु ते रपः॥
verses.tr: nya1gvāto vāti nya'k tapati sūryaḥ nīcīnamaghnyā duhe nya'g bhavatu te rapaḥ
verses.en: Vata breathes downward from above, and downward Surya sends his heat; Downward is drawn the milch-cow's milk: so downward go thy malady!

verses.sa:
आप इद् वा उ भेषजीरापो अमीवचातनीः ।
आपो विश्वस्य भेषजीस्तास्ते कृण्वन्तु भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: āpa id vā u bheṣajīrāpo amīvacātanīḥ āpo viśvasya bheṣajīstāste kṛṇvantu bheṣajam
verses.en: The Waters verily bring health, the Waters drive disease away. The Waters cure all malady: may they bring medicine for thee.

sections.label: A charm to strengthen and inspirit a war-horse
sections.name: Hymn 92

verses.sa:
वातरम्हा भव वाजिन् युज्यमान इन्द्रस्य याहि प्रसवे मनोजवाः ।
युञ्जन्तु त्वा मरुतो विश्ववेदस आ ते त्वष्टा पत्सु जवं दधातु॥
verses.tr: vātaramhā bhava vājin yujyamāna indrasya yāhi prasave manojavāḥ yuñjantu tvā maruto viśvavedasa ā te tvaṣṭā patsu javaṃ dadhātu
verses.en: Be fleet as wind, Strong Steed, when thou art harnessed; go forth as swift as thought at Indra's sending. Let the possessors of all wealth, the Maruts, yoke thee, and Tvashtar in thy feet lay swiftness.

verses.sa:
जवस्ते अर्वन् निहितो गुहा यः श्येने वात उत योऽचरत् परीत्तः ।
तेन त्वं वाजिन् बलवान् बलेनाजिं जय समने पारयिष्णुः॥
verses.tr: javaste arvan nihito guhā yaḥ śyene vāta uta yo'carat parīttaḥ tena tvaṃ vājin balavān balenājiṃ jaya samane pārayiṣṇuḥ
verses.en: That speed, that lies concealed in thee, O Charger, speed granted to the hawk or wind that wandered,—Therewith, Strong Steed, saving in shock of battle, endowed with might by might win thou the contest.

verses.sa:
तनूष्टे वाजिन् तन्वं१ नयन्ती वाममस्मभ्यं धावतु शर्म तुभ्यम्।
अह्रुतो महो धरुणाय देवो दिवीऽव ज्योतिः स्वमा मिमीयात्॥
verses.tr: tanūṣṭe vājin tanvaṃ1 nayantī vāmamasmabhyaṃ dhāvatu śarma tubhyam ahruto maho dharuṇāya devo divī'va jyotiḥ svamā mimīyāt
verses.en: Bearing thy body, Charger, may thy body run blessing us and winning thee protection. May he, unswerving, to uphold the mighty, stablish his lustre as a God in heaven.

sections.label: A prayer for protection from poison
sections.name: Hymn 93

verses.sa:
यमो मृत्युरघमारो निरृथो बभ्रुः शर्वोऽस्ता नीलशिखण्डः ।
देवजनाः सेनयोत्तस्थिवांसस्ते अस्माकं परि वृञ्जन्तु वीरान्॥
verses.tr: yamo mṛtyuraghamāro nirṛtho babhruḥ śarvo'stā nīlaśikhaṇḍaḥ devajanāḥ senayottasthivāṃsaste asmākaṃ pari vṛñjantu vīrān
verses.en: Yama, Death direly fatal, the Destroyer, with his black crest, Sarva the tawny archer, And all the Gods uprisen with their army, may these on every side avoid our heroes.

verses.sa:
मनसा होमैर्हरसा घृतेन शर्वायास्त्र उत राज्ञे भवाय ।
नमस्येऽभ्यो नम एभ्यः कृणोम्यन्यत्रास्मदघविषा नयन्तु॥
verses.tr: manasā homairharasā ghṛtena śarvāyāstra uta rājñe bhavāya namasye'bhyo nama ebhyaḥ kṛṇomyanyatrāsmadaghaviṣā nayantu
verses.en: With mind, burnt-offerings, butter, and libation, to royal Bhava and the archer Sarva, To these the worshipful I pay my worship: may they turn elsewhere things with deadly venom.

verses.sa:
त्रायध्वं नो अघविषाभ्यो वधाद् विश्वे देवा मरुतो विश्ववेदसः ।
अग्नीषोमा वरुणः पूतदक्षा वातापर्जन्ययोः सुमतौ स्याम॥
verses.tr: trāyadhvaṃ no aghaviṣābhyo vadhād viśve devā maruto viśvavedasaḥ agnīṣomā varuṇaḥ pūtadakṣā vātāparjanyayoḥ sumatau syāma
verses.en: Save us, All-gods and all-possessing Maruts, from murderous stroke and things that slay with poison. Pure is the might of Varuna, Agni, Soma. May Vata's and Parjanya's favour bless us.

sections.label: A charm to reconcile a King's discontented people
sections.name: Hymn 94

verses.sa:
सं वो मनांसि सं व्रता समाकूतीर्नमामसि ।
अमी ये विव्रता स्थन तान् वः सं नमयामसि॥
verses.tr: saṃ vo manāṃsi saṃ vratā samākūtīrnamāmasi amī ye vivratā sthana tān vaḥ saṃ namayāmasi
verses.en: We bend your minds in union, bend in harmony your hopes and plans: You there, who turn to sundered ways, we bend and bow in unison.

verses.sa:
अहं गृभ्णामि मनसा मनांसि मम चित्तमनु चित्तेभिरेत ।
मम वशेषु हृदयानि वः कृणोमि मम यातमनुवर्त्मान एत॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ gṛbhṇāmi manasā manāṃsi mama cittamanu cittebhireta mama vaśeṣu hṛdayāni vaḥ kṛṇomi mama yātamanuvartmāna eta
verses.en: I with my spirit make your spirits captive: these with their thoughts follow my thought and wishes. I make your hearts submissive to mine order: closely attending go where I precede you.

verses.sa:
ओते मे द्यावापृथिवी ओता देवी सरस्वती ।
ओतौ म इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्चर्ध्यास्मेदं सरस्वति॥
verses.tr: ote me dyāvāpṛthivī otā devī sarasvatī otau ma indraścāgniścardhyāsmedaṃ sarasvati
verses.en: I have invoked both Heaven and Earth, invoked divine Sarasvati, Indra and Agni have I called: Sarasvati, so may we thrive!

sections.label: A charm to remove disease
sections.name: Hymn 95

verses.sa:
अश्वत्थो देवसदनस्तृतीयस्यामितो दिवि।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं देवाः कुष्ठमवन्वत॥
verses.tr: aśvattho devasadanastṛtīyasyāmito divi tatrāmṛtasya cakṣaṇaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭhamavanvata
verses.en: In the third heaven above us stands the Asvattha tree, the seat of Gods. There the Gods gained the Kushtha plant, embodiment of endless life.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययी नौरचरद्धिरण्यबन्धना दिवि।
तत्रामृतस्य पुष्पं देवाः कुष्ठमवन्वत॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyayī nauracaraddhiraṇyabandhanā divi tatrāmṛtasya puṣpaṃ devāḥ kuṣṭhamavanvata
verses.en: There moved through heaven a golden ship, a ship with cordage wrought of gold. There Gods obtained the Kushtha plant, the flower of immortality.

verses.sa:
गर्भो अस्योषधीनां गर्भो हिमवतामुत।
गर्भो विश्वस्य भूतस्येमं मे अगदं कृधि॥
verses.tr: garbho asyoṣadhīnāṃ garbho himavatāmuta garbho viśvasya bhūtasyemaṃ me agadaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Thou art the infant of the plants, the infant of the Snowy Hills: The germ of every thing that is: free this my friend from his disease.

sections.label: A prayer for deliverance from sin and sorrow
sections.name: Hymn 96

verses.sa:
या ओषधयः सोमराज्ञीर्बह्वीः शतविचक्षणाः ।
बृहस्पतिप्रसूतास्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yā oṣadhayaḥ somarājñīrbahvīḥ śatavicakṣaṇāḥ bṛhaspatiprasūtāstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: The many plants of hundred shapes and forms that Soma rules as King, Commanded by Brihaspati, deliver us from grief and woe!

verses.sa:
मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्या३दथो वरुण्याऽदुत।
अथो यमस्य पड्वीशाद् विश्वस्माद् देवकिल्बिषात्॥
verses.tr: muñcantu mā śapathyā3datho varuṇyā'duta atho yamasya paḍvīśād viśvasmād devakilbiṣāt
verses.en: Let them release me from the curse and from the noose of Varuna, Free me from Yama's fetter, and from every sin against the Gods!

verses.sa:
यच्चक्षुषा मनसा यच्च वाचोपारिम जाग्रतो यत् स्वपन्तः ।
सोमस्तानि स्वधया नः पुनातु॥
verses.tr: yaccakṣuṣā manasā yacca vācopārima jāgrato yat svapantaḥ somastāni svadhayā naḥ punātu
verses.en: From every fault in look, in word, inspirit that we, awake or sleeping, have committed May Soma, with his godlike nature, cleanse us.

sections.label: A prayer for the success and prosperity of a King
sections.name: Hymn 97

verses.sa:
अभिभूर्यज्ञो अभिभूरग्निरभिभूः सोमो अभिभूरिन्द्रः ।
अभ्यहं विश्वाः पृतना यथासान्येवा विधेमाग्निहोत्रा इदं हविः॥
verses.tr: abhibhūryajño abhibhūragnirabhibhūḥ somo abhibhūrindraḥ abhyahaṃ viśvāḥ pṛtanā yathāsānyevā vidhemāgnihotrā idaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: The sacrifice is victor, Agni victor, victorious is Soma, Indra conquers: So will we bring oblation unto Agni, this sacrifice that I may win all battles.

verses.sa:
स्वधास्तु मित्रावरुणा विपश्चिता प्रजावत् क्षत्रं मधुनेह पिन्वतम्।
बाधेथां दूरं निरृतिं पराचैः कृतं चिदेनः प्र मुमुक्तमस्मत्॥
verses.tr: svadhāstu mitrāvaruṇā vipaścitā prajāvat kṣatraṃ madhuneha pinvatam bādhethāṃ dūraṃ nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ kṛtaṃ cidenaḥ pra mumuktamasmat
verses.en: Praise to you, Mitra-Varuna, hymn-singers! Here swell with meath dominion blest with children. Far into distant regions drive Destruction, and even from committed sin absolve us.

verses.sa:
इमं वीरमनु हर्षध्वमुग्रमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम्।
ग्रामजितं गोजितं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा॥
verses.tr: imaṃ vīramanu harṣadhvamugramindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam grāmajitaṃ gojitaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā
verses.en: In this strong hero be ye glad and joyful: cleave ye to him even as ye cleave to Indra, Victorious, j kine- winner, thunder-wielder, who quells a host and with his might destroys it.

sections.label: Praise of Indra
sections.name: Hymn 98

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो जयाति न परा जयाता अधिराजो राजसु राजयातै ।
चर्कृत्य ईड्यो वन्द्यश्चोपसद्यो नमस्योऽभवेह॥
verses.tr: indro jayāti na parā jayātā adhirājo rājasu rājayātai carkṛtya īḍyo vandyaścopasadyo namasyo'bhaveha
verses.en: Indra be victor, never to be vanquished, to reign among the Kings as sovran ruler! Here be thou meet for praise and supplication, to be revered and waited on and worshipped.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्राधिराजः श्रवस्युस्त्वं भूरभिभूतिर्जनानाम्।
त्वं दैवीर्विश इमा वि राजायुष्मत् क्षत्रमजरं ते अस्तु॥
verses.tr: tvamindrādhirājaḥ śravasyustvaṃ bhūrabhibhūtirjanānām tvaṃ daivīrviśa imā vi rājāyuṣmat kṣatramajaraṃ te astu
verses.en: Thou fain for glory, an imperial ruler, hast worm dominion over men, O Indra. Of these celestial tribes be thou the sovran: r long-lasting be thy sway and undecaying! f

verses.sa:
प्राच्या दिशस्त्वमिन्द्रासि राजोतोदीच्या दिशो वृत्रहन्छत्रुहोऽसि ।
यत्र यन्ति स्रोत्यास्तज्जितं ते दक्षिणतो वृषभ एषि हव्यः॥
verses.tr: prācyā diśastvamindrāsi rājotodīcyā diśo vṛtrahanchatruho'si yatra yanti srotyāstajjitaṃ te dakṣiṇato vṛṣabha eṣi havyaḥ
verses.en: Thou governest the north and eastern regions, Indra t fiend-slayer! t thou destroyest foemen. Thou hast won all, far as the rivers wander. Bull, called to help, on our right hand thou goest.

sections.label: A prayer for protection in battle
sections.name: Hymn 99

verses.sa:
अभि त्वेन्द्र वरिमतः पुरा त्वांहूरणाद्धुवे ।
ह्वयाम्युग्रं चेत्तारं पुरुणामानमेकजम्॥
verses.tr: abhi tvendra varimataḥ purā tvāṃhūraṇāddhuve hvayāmyugraṃ cettāraṃ puruṇāmānamekajam
verses.en: Indra, before affliction comes, I call thee from the-wide expanse. o The mighty guardian, born alone, wearer of many names, I call.

verses.sa:
यो अद्य सेन्यो वधो जिघांसन् न उदीरते ।
इन्द्रस्य तत्र बाहू समन्तं परि दद्मः॥
verses.tr: yo adya senyo vadho jighāṃsan na udīrate indrasya tatra bāhū samantaṃ pari dadmaḥ
verses.en: Whatever deadly missile launched to-day flies forth to slaughter us, We take both arms of Indra to encompass us on every side.

verses.sa:
परि दद्म इन्द्रस्य बाहू समन्तं त्रातुस्त्रायतां नः ।
देव सवितः सोम राजन्त्सुमनसं मा कृणु स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: pari dadma indrasya bāhū samantaṃ trātustrāyatāṃ naḥ deva savitaḥ soma rājantsumanasaṃ mā kṛṇu svastaye
verses.en: We draw about us both the arms of Indra, our deliverer. May they protect us thoroughly. O Savitar, thou God, O royal Soma, make thou me pious-minded for my welfare. A hymn of praise to Indra.

sections.label: A charm against poison
sections.name: Hymn 100

verses.sa:
देवा अदुः सूर्यो अदाद् द्यौरदात् पृथिव्यऽदात्।
तिस्रः सरस्वतिरदुः सचित्ता विषदूषणम्॥
verses.tr: devā aduḥ sūryo adād dyauradāt pṛthivya'dāt tisraḥ sarasvatiraduḥ sacittā viṣadūṣaṇam
verses.en: The Gods and Surya gave the gift, the Earth and Heaven bestowed the boon. The three Sarasvatis in full accord bestowed the antidote.

verses.sa:
यद् वो देवा उपजीका आसिञ्चन् धन्वन्युदकम्।
तेन देवप्रसूतेनेदं दूषयता विषम्॥
verses.tr: yad vo devā upajīkā āsiñcan dhanvanyudakam tena devaprasūtenedaṃ dūṣayatā viṣam
verses.en: That water, Upajikas! which Gods poured for you on thirsty land, With that same water sent by Gods, drive ye away this poison here.

verses.sa:
असुराणां दुहितासि सा देवानामसि स्वसा ।
दिवस्पृथिव्याः संभूता सा चकर्थारसं विषम्॥
verses.tr: asurāṇāṃ duhitāsi sā devānāmasi svasā divaspṛthivyāḥ saṃbhūtā sā cakarthārasaṃ viṣam
verses.en: The daughter of the Asuras art thou, and sister of the Gods. Thou who hast sprung from heaven and earth hast robbed the poison of its power.

sections.label: A charm to promote virile vigour (Appendix)
sections.name: Hymn 101

verses.sa:
आ वृषायस्व श्वसिहि वर्धस्व प्रथयस्व च ।
यथाङ्गं वर्धतां शेपस्तेन योषितमिज्जहि॥
येन कृषं वाजयन्ति येन हिन्वन्त्यातुरम्।
तेनास्य ब्रह्मणस्पते धनुरिवा तानया पसः॥
आहं तनोमि ते पसो अधि ज्यामिव धन्वनि ।
क्रमस्वर्श इव रोहितमनवग्लायता सदा॥
verses.tr: ā vṛṣāyasva śvasihi vardhasva prathayasva ca yathāṅgaṃ vardhatāṃ śepastena yoṣitamijjahi yena kṛṣaṃ vājayanti yena hinvantyāturam tenāsya brahmaṇaspate dhanurivā tānayā pasaḥ āhaṃ tanomi te paso adhi jyāmiva dhanvani kramasvarśa iva rohitamanavaglāyatā sadā
verses.en: [Griffith gives this hymn only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation.]

sections.label: A man's love-charm
sections.name: Hymn 102

verses.sa:
यथायं वाहो अश्विना समैति सं च वर्तते ।
एवा मामभि ते मनः समैतु सं च वर्तताम्॥
verses.tr: yathāyaṃ vāho aśvinā samaiti saṃ ca vartate evā māmabhi te manaḥ samaitu saṃ ca vartatām
verses.en: Even as this ox, O Asvins, steps and turns together with his mate, So let thy fancy turn itself, come nearer, and unite with me.

verses.sa:
आहं खिदामि ते मनो राजाश्वः पृष्ट्यामिव ।
रेष्मच्छिन्नं यथा तृणं मयि ते वेष्टतां मनः॥
verses.tr: āhaṃ khidāmi te mano rājāśvaḥ pṛṣṭyāmiva reṣmacchinnaṃ yathā tṛṇaṃ mayi te veṣṭatāṃ manaḥ
verses.en: I, as the shaft-horse draws the mare beside him, draw thee to myself. Like grass that storm and wind have rent, so be thy mind attached to me!

verses.sa:
आञ्जनस्य मदुघस्य कुष्ठस्य नलदस्य च ।
तुरो भगस्य हस्ताभ्यामनुरोधनमुद् भरे॥
verses.tr: āñjanasya madughasya kuṣṭhasya naladasya ca turo bhagasya hastābhyāmanurodhanamud bhare
verses.en: Swiftly from Bhaga's hands I bear away a love-compelling charm Of ointment and of sugar-cane, of Spikenard and the Kushtha plant.

sections.label: A charm to check the approach of a "hostile army
sections.name: Hymn 103

verses.sa:
संदानं वो बृहस्पतिः संदानं सविता करत्।
संदानं मित्रो अर्यमा संदानं भगो अश्विना॥
verses.tr: saṃdānaṃ vo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃdānaṃ savitā karat saṃdānaṃ mitro aryamā saṃdānaṃ bhago aśvinā
verses.en: Brihaspati and Savitar prepare a rope to bind you fast! Let Bhaga, Mitra, Aryaman, and both the Asvins make the bond.

verses.sa:
सं परमान्त्समवमानथो सं द्यामि मध्यमान्।
इन्द्रस्तान् पर्यहार्दाम्ना तानग्ने सं द्या त्वम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ paramāntsamavamānatho saṃ dyāmi madhyamān indrastān paryahārdāmnā tānagne saṃ dyā tvam
verses.en: I bind together all of them, the first, the last, the middlemost. Indra hath girded these with cord: bind them together, Agni, thou!

verses.sa:
अमी ये युधमायन्ति केतून् कृत्वानीकशः ।
इन्द्रस्तान् पर्यहार्दाम्न तानग्ने सं द्या त्वम्॥
verses.tr: amī ye yudhamāyanti ketūn kṛtvānīkaśaḥ indrastān paryahārdāmna tānagne saṃ dyā tvam
verses.en: Those yonder who approach to fight, with banners raised along their ranks, Indra hath girded these with cord: bind them together, Agni, thou!

sections.label: A charm to check the approach of a "hostile army
sections.name: Hymn 104

verses.sa:
आदानेन संदानेनामित्राना द्यामसि ।
अपाना ये चैषां प्राणा असुनासून्त्समच्छिदन्॥
verses.tr: ādānena saṃdānenāmitrānā dyāmasi apānā ye caiṣāṃ prāṇā asunāsūntsamacchidan
verses.en: We bind our foemen with a bond that binds them close and holds them fast. Their breath and respiration I dissever, and their lives from life.

verses.sa:
इदमादानमकरं तपसेन्द्रेण संशितम्।
अमित्रा येऽत्र नः सन्ति तानग्न आ द्या त्वम्॥
verses.tr: idamādānamakaraṃ tapasendreṇa saṃśitam amitrā ye'tra naḥ santi tānagna ā dyā tvam
verses.en: This bond, made keen by Indra, I have formed with heat of holy zeal. Securely bind our enemies, O Agni, who are standing here.

verses.sa:
ऐनान् द्यतामिन्द्राग्नी सोमो राजा च मेदिनौ ।
इन्द्रो मरुत्वानादानममित्रेभ्यः कृणोतु नः॥
verses.tr: ainān dyatāmindrāgnī somo rājā ca medinau indro marutvānādānamamitrebhyaḥ kṛṇotu naḥ
verses.en: Indra and Agni bind them fast, Soma the King, and both the Friends! May Indra, girt by Maruts, make a bond to bind our enemies,

sections.label: A charm to cure cough
sections.name: Hymn 105

verses.sa:
यथा मनो मनस्केतः परापतत्याशुमत्।
एवा त्वं कासे प्र पत मनसोऽनु प्रवाय्यऽम्॥
verses.tr: yathā mano manasketaḥ parāpatatyāśumat evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata manaso'nu pravāyya'm
verses.en: Rapidly as the fancy flies forth with conceptions of the mind, So following the fancy's flight, O Cough, flee rapidly away.

verses.sa:
यथा बाणः सुसंशितः परापतत्याशुमत्।
एवा त्वं कासे प्र पत पृथिव्या अनु संवतम्॥
verses.tr: yathā bāṇaḥ susaṃśitaḥ parāpatatyāśumat evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata pṛthivyā anu saṃvatam
verses.en: Rapidly as an arrow flies away with keenly-sharpened point, So swiftly flee away, O Cough, over the region of the earth!

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यस्य रश्मयः परापतन्त्याशुमत्।
एवा त्वं कासे प्र पत समुद्रस्यानु विक्षरम्॥
verses.tr: yathā sūryasya raśmayaḥ parāpatantyāśumat evā tvaṃ kāse pra pata samudrasyānu vikṣaram
verses.en: Rapidly as the beams of light, the rays of Surya, fly away, So, Cough! fly rapidly away over the current of the sea!

sections.label: A charm to protect a house from fire
sections.name: Hymn 106

verses.sa:
आयने ते परायणे दूर्वा रोहतु पुष्पिणीः ।
उत्सो वा तत्र जायतां ह्रदो वा पुण्डरीकवान्॥
verses.tr: āyane te parāyaṇe dūrvā rohatu puṣpiṇīḥ utso vā tatra jāyatāṃ hrado vā puṇḍarīkavān
verses.en: Let flowery Dar va grass grow up about thine exit and approach. There let a spring of water rise, or lake with blooming lotuses.

verses.sa:
अपामिदं न्ययनं समुद्रस्य निवेशनम्।
मध्ये ह्रदस्य नो गृहाः पराचीना मुखा कृधि॥
verses.tr: apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam madhye hradasya no gṛhāḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi
verses.en: This is the place where waters meet, here is the gathering of the flood. Our home is set amid the lake: turn thou thy jaws away from it.

verses.sa:
हिमस्य त्वा जरायुणा शाले परि व्ययामसि ।
शीतह्रदा हि नो भुवोऽग्निष्कृणोतु भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: himasya tvā jarāyuṇā śāle pari vyayāmasi śītahradā hi no bhuvo'gniṣkṛṇotu bheṣajam
verses.en: O House, we compass thee about with coolness to envelop thee. Cool as a lake be thou to us. Let Agni bring us healing balm!

sections.label: A charm to protect men and cattle
sections.name: Hymn 107

verses.sa:
विश्वजित् त्रायमाणायै मा परि देहि ।
त्रायमाणे द्विपाच्च सर्वं नो रक्ष चतुष्पाद् यच्च नः स्वम्॥
verses.tr: viśvajit trāyamāṇāyai mā pari dehi trāyamāṇe dvipācca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yacca naḥ svam
verses.en: Entrust me, Visvajit, to Trayamana. Guard, Trayamana, all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.

verses.sa:
त्रायमाणे विश्वजिते मा परि देहि ।
विश्वजिद् द्विपाच्च सर्वं नो रक्ष चतुष्पाद् यच्च नः स्वम्॥
verses.tr: trāyamāṇe viśvajite mā pari dehi viśvajid dvipācca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yacca naḥ svam
verses.en: To Visvajit entrust me, Trayamana. O Visvajit, guard all our men, etc.

verses.sa:
विश्वजित् कल्याण्यैऽ मा परि देहि ।
कल्याणि द्विपाच्च सर्वं नो रक्ष चतुष्पाद् यच्च नः स्वम्॥
verses.tr: viśvajit kalyāṇyai' mā pari dehi kalyāṇi dvipācca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yacca naḥ svam
verses.en: To Visvajit entrust me, O Kalyani. Guard, O Kalyani, all our men, etc.

verses.sa:
कल्याणि सर्वविदे मा परि देहि ।
सर्वविद् द्विपाच्च सर्वं नो रक्ष चतुष्पाद् यच्च नः स्वम्॥
verses.tr: kalyāṇi sarvavide mā pari dehi sarvavid dvipācca sarvaṃ no rakṣa catuṣpād yacca naḥ svam
verses.en: To Sarvavid entrust me, O O Sarvavid, guard all our men, guard all our wealth of quadrupeds.

sections.label: A prayer for wisdom
sections.name: Hymn 108

verses.sa:
त्वं नो मेधे प्रथमा गोभिरश्वेभिरा गहि ।
त्वं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिस्त्वं नो असि यज्ञिया॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no medhe prathamā gobhiraśvebhirā gahi tvaṃ sūryasya raśmibhistvaṃ no asi yajñiyā
verses.en: Intelligence, come first to as with store of horses and of kine! Thou with the rays of Surya art our worshipful and holy one.

verses.sa:
मेधामहं प्रथमां ब्रह्मण्वतीं ब्रह्मजूतामृषिष्टुताम्।
प्रपीतां ब्रह्मचारिभिर्देवानामवसे हुवे॥
verses.tr: medhāmahaṃ prathamāṃ brahmaṇvatīṃ brahmajūtāmṛṣiṣṭutām prapītāṃ brahmacāribhirdevānāmavase huve
verses.en: The first, devout Intelligence, lauded by sages, sped by prayer, Trusted by Brahmacharis, for the favour of the Gods I call.

verses.sa:
यां मेधामृभवो विदुर्यां मेधामसुरा विदुः ।
ऋषयो भद्रां मेधां यां विदुस्तां मय्या वेशयामसि॥
verses.tr: yāṃ medhāmṛbhavo viduryāṃ medhāmasurā viduḥ ṛṣayo bhadrāṃ medhāṃ yāṃ vidustāṃ mayyā veśayāmasi
verses.en: That excellent Intelligence which Ribhus know, and Asuras, Intelligence which sages know, we cause to enter into me.

verses.sa:
यामृषयो भूतकृतो मेधां मेधाविनो विदुः ।
तया मामद्य मेधयाग्ने मेधाविनं कृणु॥
verses.tr: yāmṛṣayo bhūtakṛto medhāṃ medhāvino viduḥ tayā māmadya medhayāgne medhāvinaṃ kṛṇu
verses.en: Do thou, O Agni, make me wise this day with that Intelligence. Which the creative Rishis, which the men endowed with wisdom knew.

verses.sa:
मेधां सायं मेधां प्रातर्मेधां मध्यन्दिनं परि ।
मेधां सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्वचसा वेशयामहे॥
verses.tr: medhāṃ sāyaṃ medhāṃ prātarmedhāṃ madhyandinaṃ pari medhāṃ sūryasya raśmibhirvacasā veśayāmahe
verses.en: Intelligence at eve, at morn, Intelligence at noon of day, With the Sun's beams, and by our speech we plant in us Intelligence.

sections.label: A charm to heal juncture wounds
sections.name: Hymn 109

verses.sa:
पिप्पली क्षिप्तभेषज्यू३तातिविद्धभेषजी।
तां देवाः समकल्पयन्नियं जीवितवा अलम्॥
verses.tr: pippalī kṣiptabheṣajyū3tātividdhabheṣajī tāṃ devāḥ samakalpayanniyaṃ jīvitavā alam
verses.en: The Berry heals the missile's rent, it heals the deeply-piercing wound. The Gods prepared and fashioned it. This hath sufficient power for life.

verses.sa:
पिप्पल्यः१ समवदन्तायतीर्जननादधि ।
यं जीवमश्नवामहै न स रिष्याति पूरुषः॥
verses.tr: pippalyaḥ1 samavadantāyatīrjananādadhi yaṃ jīvamaśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ
verses.en: When from their origin they came, the Berries spake among themselves: The man whom we shall find alive shall never suffer injury.

verses.sa:
असुरास्त्वा न्यऽखनन् देवास्त्वोदवपन् पुनः ।
वातीकृतस्य भेषजीमथो क्षिप्तस्य भेषजीम्॥
verses.tr: asurāstvā nya'khanan devāstvodavapan punaḥ vātīkṛtasya bheṣajīmatho kṣiptasya bheṣajīm
verses.en: Asuras buried thee in earth: the Gods again uplifted thee, Healer of sickness caused by wounds and healer of the missile's rent.

sections.label: A benediction on a new-born child
sections.name: Hymn 110

verses.sa:
प्रत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि ।
स्वां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रायस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व॥
verses.tr: pratno hi kamīḍyo adhvareṣu sanācca hotā navyaśca satsi svāṃ cāgne tanvaṃ piprāyasvāsmabhyaṃ ca saubhagamā yajasva
verses.en: Yea, ancient, meet for praise at sacrifices, ever and now thou sittest down as Hotar. And now, O Agni, make thy person friendly, and win felicity for us by worship.

verses.sa:
ज्येष्ठघ्न्यं जातो विचृतोर्यमस्य मूलबर्हणात् परि पाह्येनम्।
अत्येनं नेषद् दुरितानि विश्वा दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: jyeṣṭhaghnyaṃ jāto vicṛtoryamasya mūlabarhaṇāt pari pāhyenam atyenaṃ neṣad duritāni viśvā dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
verses.en: 'Neath Jyaishthaghni and Yama's Two Releasers this child was born: preserve him from uprooting. He shall conduct him safe past all misfortunes to lengthened life that lasts a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
व्याघ्रेऽह्न्यजनिष्ट वीरो नक्षत्रजा जायमानः सुवीरः ।
स मा वधीत् पितरं वर्धमानो मा मातरं प्र मिनीज्जनित्रीम्॥
verses.tr: vyāghre'hnyajaniṣṭa vīro nakṣatrajā jāyamānaḥ suvīraḥ sa mā vadhīt pitaraṃ vardhamāno mā mātaraṃ pra minījjanitrīm
verses.en: Born on the Tigers day was he, a hero, the Constellations' child, born brave and manly. Let him not wound, when grown in strength, his father, nor disregard his mother, her who bare him.

sections.label: A charm for insanity
sections.name: Hymn 111

verses.sa:
इमं मे अग्ने पुरुषं मुमुग्ध्ययं यो बद्धः सुयतो लालपीति ।
अतोऽधि ते कृणवद् भागधेयं यदानुन्मदितोऽसति॥
verses.tr: imaṃ me agne puruṣaṃ mumugdhyayaṃ yo baddhaḥ suyato lālapīti ato'dhi te kṛṇavad bhāgadheyaṃ yadānunmadito'sati
verses.en: Unbind and loose for me this man, O Agni, who bound and well restrained is chattering folly. Afterward he will offer thee thy portion when he hath been delivered from his madness.

verses.sa:
अग्निष्टे नि शमयतु यदि ते मन उद्युतम्।
कृणोमि विद्वान् भेषजं यदानुन्मदितोऽससि॥
verses.tr: agniṣṭe ni śamayatu yadi te mana udyutam kṛṇomi vidvān bheṣajaṃ yadānunmadito'sasi
verses.en: Let Agni gently soothe thy mind when fierce excitement troubles it. Well-skilled I make a medicine that thou no longer mayst be mad,

verses.sa:
देवैनसादुन्मदितमुन्मत्तं रक्षसस्परि ।
कृणोमि विद्वान् भेषजं यदानुन्मदितोऽसति॥
verses.tr: devainasādunmaditamunmattaṃ rakṣasaspari kṛṇomi vidvān bheṣajaṃ yadānunmadito'sati
verses.en: Insane through sin against the Gods, or maddened by a demon's power—Well-skilled I make a medicine to free thee from insanity.

verses.sa:
पुनस्त्वा दुरप्सरसः पुनरिन्द्रः पुनर्भगः ।
पुनस्त्वा दुर्विश्वे देवा यथानुन्मदितोऽससि॥
verses.tr: punastvā durapsarasaḥ punarindraḥ punarbhagaḥ punastvā durviśve devā yathānunmadito'sasi
verses.en: May the Apsarases release, Indra and Bhaga let o thee go. May all the Gods deliver thee that thou no longer mayst be mad.

sections.label: A health-charm for man, woman, and son
sections.name: Hymn 112

verses.sa:
मा ज्येष्ठं वधीदयमग्न एषां मूलबर्हणात् परि पाह्येनम्।
स ग्राह्याः पाशान् वि चृत प्रजानन् तुभ्यं देवा अनु जानन्तु विश्वे॥
verses.tr: mā jyeṣṭhaṃ vadhīdayamagna eṣāṃ mūlabarhaṇāt pari pāhyenam sa grāhyāḥ pāśān vi cṛta prajānan tubhyaṃ devā anu jānantu viśve
verses.en: Let not this one, O Agni, wound the highest of these: preserve thou him from utter ruin. Knowing the way do thou untie the nooses of the she-fiend: let all the Gods approve thee.

verses.sa:
उन्मुञ्च पाशांस्त्वमग्न एषां त्रयस्त्रिभिरुत्सिता येभिरासन्।
स ग्राह्याः पाशान् वि चृत प्रजानन् पितापुत्रौ मातरं मुञ्च सर्वान्॥
verses.tr: unmuñca pāśāṃstvamagna eṣāṃ trayastribhirutsitā yebhirāsan sa grāhyāḥ pāśān vi cṛta prajānan pitāputrau mātaraṃ muñca sarvān
verses.en: Rend thou the bonds of these asunder, Agni! the threefold noose whereby the three were fastened. Knowing the way untie the she-fiend's nooses: free all, the son, the father, and the mother. a

verses.sa:
येभिः पाशैः परिवित्तो विबद्धोऽङ्गेअङ्ग आर्पित उत्सितश्च ।
वि ते मुच्यन्तं विमुचो हि सन्ति भ्रूणघ्नि पूषन् दुरितानि मृक्ष्व॥
verses.tr: yebhiḥ pāśaiḥ parivitto vibaddho'ṅgeaṅga ārpita utsitaśca vi te mucyantaṃ vimuco hi santi bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛkṣva
verses.en: The elder brother's bonds, still left unwedded, fettered in every limb and bound securely, Loose these, for they are bonds for loosing: Pushan, turn woes away upon the babe-destroyer.

sections.label: A charm to banish the fiend Grahi
sections.name: Hymn 113

verses.sa:
त्रिते देवा अमृजतैतदेनस्त्रित एनन्मनुष्येऽषु ममृजे ।
ततो यदि त्वा ग्राहिरानशे तां ते देवा ब्रह्मणा नाशयन्तु॥
verses.tr: trite devā amṛjataitadenastrita enanmanuṣye'ṣu mamṛje tato yadi tvā grāhirānaśe tāṃ te devā brahmaṇā nāśayantu
verses.en: This sin the Gods wiped off and laid on Trita, and Trita wiped it off on human beings. Thence if the female fiend hath made thee captive, the Gods by prayer shall banish her and free thee.

verses.sa:
मरीचीर्धूमान् प्र विशानु पाप्मन्नुदारान् गच्छोत वा नीहारान्।
नदीनां फेनाँ अनु तान् वि नश्य भ्रूणघ्नि पूषन् दुरितानि मृक्ष्व॥
verses.tr: marīcīrdhūmān pra viśānu pāpmannudārān gacchota vā nīhārān nadīnāṃ phenāṃ anu tān vi naśya bhrūṇaghni pūṣan duritāni mṛkṣva
verses.en: Enter the particles of light and vapours, go to the rising fogs or mists, O Evil! Hence! vanish in the foams of rivers. Pushan, wipe woes away upon the babe-destroyer!

verses.sa:
द्वादशधा निहितं त्रितस्यापमृष्टं मनुष्यैनसानि ।
ततो यदि त्वा ग्राहिरानशे तां ते देवा ब्रह्मणा नाशयन्तु॥
verses.tr: dvādaśadhā nihitaṃ tritasyāpamṛṣṭaṃ manuṣyainasāni tato yadi tvā grāhirānaśe tāṃ te devā brahmaṇā nāśayantu
verses.en: Stored in twelve separate places lies what Trita hath wiped away, the sins of human beings. Thence if the female fiend hath made thee captive, the Gods by prayer shall banish her and free thee.

sections.label: A prayer for pardon of faults and errors in sacrificing
sections.name: Hymn 114

verses.sa:
यद् देवा देवहेडनं देवासश्चकृमा वयम्।
आदित्यास्तस्मान्नो यूयमृतस्यर्तेन मुञ्चत॥
verses.tr: yad devā devaheḍanaṃ devāsaścakṛmā vayam ādityāstasmānno yūyamṛtasyartena muñcata
verses.en: Whatever God-provoking wrong we priests have done, O Deities, Therefrom do ye deliver us, Adityas! by the right of Law.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्यर्तेनादित्या यजत्रा मुञ्चतेह नः ।
यज्ञं यद् यज्ञवाहसः शिक्षन्तो नोपशेकिम॥
verses.tr: ṛtasyartenādityā yajatrā muñcateha naḥ yajñaṃ yad yajñavāhasaḥ śikṣanto nopaśekima
verses.en: Here set us free, O holy ones, Adityas, by the right of Law, When striving, bringing sacrifice, we failed to offer it aright.

verses.sa:
मेदस्वता यजमानाः स्रुचाज्यानि जुह्वतः ।
अकामा विश्वे वो देवाः शिक्षन्तो नोप शेकिम॥
verses.tr: medasvatā yajamānāḥ srucājyāni juhvataḥ akāmā viśve vo devāḥ śikṣanto nopa śekima
verses.en: With ladle full of fatness we, worshippers, pouring holy oil, Striving, have failed, O all ye Gods, against our will, to offer it.

sections.label: A prayer for forgiveness of sins
sections.name: Hymn 115

verses.sa:
यद् विद्वांसो यदविद्वांस एनांसि चकृमा वयम्।
यूयं नस्तस्मान्मुञ्चत विश्वे देवाः सजोषसः॥
verses.tr: yad vidvāṃso yadavidvāṃsa enāṃsi cakṛmā vayam yūyaṃ nastasmānmuñcata viśve devāḥ sajoṣasaḥ
verses.en: Whatever wrong we wittingly or in our ignorance have done, Do ye deliver us therefrom, O all ye Gods, of one accord.

verses.sa:
यदि जाग्रद् यदि स्वपन्नेन एनस्योऽकरम्।
भूतं मा तस्माद् भव्यं च द्रुपदादिव मुञ्चताम्॥
verses.tr: yadi jāgrad yadi svapannena enasyo'karam bhūtaṃ mā tasmād bhavyaṃ ca drupadādiva muñcatām
verses.en: If I, a sinner, when awake or sleeping have committed sin, Free me therefrom as from a stake, from present and from future guilt.

verses.sa:
द्रुपदादिव मुमुचानः स्विन्नः स्नात्वा मलादिव ।
पूतं पवित्रेणेवाज्यं विश्वे शुम्भन्तु मैनसः॥
verses.tr: drupadādiva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snātvā malādiva pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyaṃ viśve śumbhantu mainasaḥ
verses.en: As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath cleansed, so all shall purge me from the sin.

sections.label: A prayer for pardon of sin against mother, father, son, or brother
sections.name: Hymn 116

verses.sa:
यद् यामं चक्रुर्निखनन्तो अग्रे कार्षीवणा अन्नविदो न विद्यया ।
वैवस्वते राजनि तज्जुहोम्यथ यज्ञियं मधुमदस्तु नोऽन्नम्॥
verses.tr: yad yāmaṃ cakrurnikhananto agre kārṣīvaṇā annavido na vidyayā vaivasvate rājani tajjuhomyatha yajñiyaṃ madhumadastu no'nnam
verses.en: The wealth which husbandmen aforetime, digging, like men who find their food with knowledge, buried, This to the King, Vivasvan's son, I offer. Sweet be our food and fit for sacrificing!

verses.sa:
वैवस्वतः कृणवद् भागधेयं मधुभागो मधुना सं सृजाति ।
मातुर्यदेन इषितं न आगन् यद् वा पितापराद्धो जिहीडे॥
verses.tr: vaivasvataḥ kṛṇavad bhāgadheyaṃ madhubhāgo madhunā saṃ sṛjāti māturyadena iṣitaṃ na āgan yad vā pitāparāddho jihīḍe
verses.en: May he, Vaivasvata, prepare our portion. May he whose share is mead with mead besprinkle. Our sin in hasty mood against our mother, or guilt whereby a sire is wronged and angered.

verses.sa:
यदीदं मातुर्यदि पितुर्नः परि भ्रातुः पुत्राच्चेतस एन आगन्।
यावन्तो अस्मान् पितरः सचन्ते तेषां सर्वेषां शिवो अस्तु मन्युः॥
verses.tr: yadīdaṃ māturyadi piturnaḥ pari bhrātuḥ putrāccetasa ena āgan yāvanto asmān pitaraḥ sacante teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ śivo astu manyuḥ
verses.en: Whether this sin into our heart hath entered regarding mother, father, son or brother, Auspicious be to us the zeal and spirit of all the fathers who are here among us.

sections.label: A prayer for freedom from debt
sections.name: Hymn 117

verses.sa:
अपमित्यमप्रतीत्तं यदस्मि यमस्य येन बलिना चरामि ।
इदं तदग्ने अनृणो भवामि त्वं पाशान् विचृतं वेत्थ सर्वान्॥
verses.tr: apamityamapratīttaṃ yadasmi yamasya yena balinā carāmi idaṃ tadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi tvaṃ pāśān vicṛtaṃ vettha sarvān
verses.en: That which I eat, a debt which still is owing, the tribute due to Yama, which supports me, Thereby may I be free from debt, O Agni. Thou knowest how to rend all bonds asunder.

verses.sa:
इहैव सन्तः प्रति दद्म एनज्जीवा जीवेभ्यो नि हराम एनत्।
अपमित्य धान्यं१ यज्जघसाहमिदं तदग्ने अनृणो भवामि॥
verses.tr: ihaiva santaḥ prati dadma enajjīvā jīvebhyo ni harāma enat apamitya dhānyaṃ1 yajjaghasāhamidaṃ tadagne anṛṇo bhavāmi
verses.en: Still dwelling here we give again this present; we send it forth, the living from the living. Throwing away the grain whence I have eaten, thereby shall I be free from debt, O Agni.

verses.sa:
अनृणा अस्मिन्ननृणाः परस्मिन् तृतीये लोके अनृणाः स्याम ।
ये देवयानाः पितृयाणाश्च लोकाः सर्वान् पथो अनृणा आ क्षियेम॥
verses.tr: anṛṇā asminnanṛṇāḥ parasmin tṛtīye loke anṛṇāḥ syāma ye devayānāḥ pitṛyāṇāśca lokāḥ sarvān patho anṛṇā ā kṣiyema
verses.en: May we be free in this world and that yonder, in the third world may we be unindebted. May we, debt-free, abide in all the pathways, in all the worlds which Gods and Fathers visit.

sections.label: A prayer for pardon of cheating at play
sections.name: Hymn 118

verses.sa:
यद्धस्ताभ्यां चकृम किल्बिषाण्यक्षानां गत्नुमुपलिप्समानाः ।
उग्रंपश्ये उग्रजितौ तदद्याप्सरसावनु दत्तामृणं नः॥
verses.tr: yaddhastābhyāṃ cakṛma kilbiṣāṇyakṣānāṃ gatnumupalipsamānāḥ ugraṃpaśye ugrajitau tadadyāpsarasāvanu dattāmṛṇaṃ naḥ
verses.en: If we have sinned with both our hands, desiring to-take the host of dice for our possession, May both Apsarases to-day forgive us that debt, the fiercely-conquering, fiercely-looking.

verses.sa:
उग्रंपश्ये राष्ट्रभृत् किल्बिषाणि यदक्षवृत्तमनु दत्तं न एतत्।
ऋणान्नो नर्णमेर्त्समानो यमस्य लोके अधिरज्जुरायत्॥
verses.tr: ugraṃpaśye rāṣṭrabhṛt kilbiṣāṇi yadakṣavṛttamanu dattaṃ na etat ṛṇānno narṇamertsamāno yamasya loke adhirajjurāyat
verses.en: Stern viewers of their sins who rule the people, forgive us what hath happened as we gambled Not urging us to pay the debt we owed him, he with a cord hath gone to Yama's kingdom.

verses.sa:
यस्मा ऋणं यस्य जायामुपैमि यं याचमानो अभ्यैमि देवाः ।
ते वाचं वादिषुर्मोत्तरां मद्देवपत्नी अप्सरसावधीतम्॥
verses.tr: yasmā ṛṇaṃ yasya jāyāmupaimi yaṃ yācamāno abhyaimi devāḥ te vācaṃ vādiṣurmottarāṃ maddevapatnī apsarasāvadhītam
verses.en: My creditor, the man whose wife I visit, he, Gods! f whom I approach with supplication,—Let not these men dominate me in speaking. Mind this, ye two Apsarases Gods' Consorts!

sections.label: A prayer for release from debts incurred without intention of payment
sections.name: Hymn 119

verses.sa:
यददीव्यन्नृणमहं कृणोम्यदास्यन्नग्न उत संगृणामि ।
वैश्वानरो नो अधिपा वसिष्ठ उदिन्नयाति सुकृतस्य लोकम्॥
verses.tr: yadadīvyannṛṇamahaṃ kṛṇomyadāsyannagna uta saṃgṛṇāmi vaiśvānaro no adhipā vasiṣṭha udinnayāti sukṛtasya lokam
verses.en: The debt which I incur, not gaming, Agni! and, not intending to repay, acknowledge, That may Vaisvanara, the best, our sovran, carry away into the world of virtue.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानराय प्रति वेदयामि यद्यृणं संगरो देवतासु ।
स एतान् पाशान् विचृतं वेद सर्वानथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarāya prati vedayāmi yadyṛṇaṃ saṃgaro devatāsu sa etān pāśān vicṛtaṃ veda sarvānatha pakvena saha saṃ bhavema
verses.en: I cause Vaisvanara to know, confessing the debt whose payment to the Gods is promised. He knows to tear asunder all these nooses: so may we dwell with him the gentle-minded.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरः पविता मा पुनातु यत् संगरमभिधावाम्याशाम्।
अनाजानन् मनसा याचमानो यत् तत्रैनो अप तत् सुवामि॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaraḥ pavitā mā punātu yat saṃgaramabhidhāvāmyāśām anājānan manasā yācamāno yat tatraino apa tat suvāmi
verses.en: Vaisvanara the Purifier purge me when I oppose their hope and break my promise, Unknowing in my heart. With supplication, whatever guilt there is in that, I banish.

sections.label: A prayer for pardon of sins and felicity hereafter
sections.name: Hymn 120

verses.sa:
यदन्तरिक्षं पृथिवीमुत द्यां यन्मातरं पितरं वा जिहिंसिम।
अयं तस्माद् गार्हपत्यो नो अग्निरुदिन्नयाति सुकृतस्य लोकम्॥
verses.tr: yadantarikṣaṃ pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ yanmātaraṃ pitaraṃ vā jihiṃsima ayaṃ tasmād gārhapatyo no agnirudinnayāti sukṛtasya lokam
verses.en: If we have injured Air, or Earth, or Heaven, if we have wronged our Mother or our Father, May Agni Garhapatya here absolve us, and bear us up into the world of virtue.

verses.sa:
भूमिर्मातादितिर्नो जनित्रं भ्रातान्तरिक्षमभिशस्त्या नः ।
द्यौर्नः पिता पित्र्याच्छं भवाति जामिमृत्वा माव पत्सि लोकात्॥
verses.tr: bhūmirmātāditirno janitraṃ bhrātāntarikṣamabhiśastyā naḥ dyaurnaḥ pitā pitryācchaṃ bhavāti jāmimṛtvā māva patsi lokāt
verses.en: Earth is our Mother, Aditi our birth-place: our brother Air save us from imprecation! Dyaus, Father, save us, from the world of Fathers! My world not lost, may I approach my kindred.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुहार्दः सुकृतो मदन्ति विहाय रोगं तन्वः१ स्वायाः ।
अश्लोणा अङ्गैरह्रुताः स्वर्गे तत्र पश्येम पितरौ च पुत्रान्॥
verses.tr: yatrā suhārdaḥ sukṛto madanti vihāya rogaṃ tanvaḥ1 svāyāḥ aśloṇā aṅgairahrutāḥ svarge tatra paśyema pitarau ca putrān
verses.en: There where our virtuous friends, who left behind them their bodily infirmities, are happy, Free from distortion of the limbs and lameness, may we behold, in heaven, our sons and parents.

sections.label: A prayer for happiness in heaven
sections.name: Hymn 121

verses.sa:
विषाणा पाशान् वि ष्याध्यस्मद् य उत्तमा अधमा वारुणा ये।
दुष्वप्न्यं दुरितं नि ष्वास्मदथ गच्छेम सुकृतस्य लोकम्॥
verses.tr: viṣāṇā pāśān vi ṣyādhyasmad ya uttamā adhamā vāruṇā ye duṣvapnyaṃ duritaṃ ni ṣvāsmadatha gacchema sukṛtasya lokam
verses.en: Spreading them out, untie the snares that hold us, Varuna's bonds, the upper and the lower. Drive from us evil dream, drive off misfortune; then let us go into the world of virtue.

verses.sa:
यद् दारुणि बध्यसे यच्च रज्ज्वां यद् भूम्यां बध्यसे यच्च वाचा।
अयं तस्माद् गार्हपत्यो नो अग्निरुदिन्नयाति सुकृतस्य लोकम्॥
verses.tr: yad dāruṇi badhyase yacca rajjvāṃ yad bhūmyāṃ badhyase yacca vācā ayaṃ tasmād gārhapatyo no agnirudinnayāti sukṛtasya lokam
verses.en: If thou art bound with cord, or tied to timber, fixt in the earth, or by a word imprisoned, Our Agni Garhapatya here shall free thee, and lead thee up into the world of virtue.

verses.sa:
उदगातां भगवती विचृतौ नाम तारके ।
प्रेहामृतस्य यच्छतां प्रैतु बद्धकमोचनम्॥
verses.tr: udagātāṃ bhagavatī vicṛtau nāma tārake prehāmṛtasya yacchatāṃ praitu baddhakamocanam
verses.en: The two auspicious stars whose name is called Releasers have gone up. Send Amrit hither, let it come freeing the captive from his bonds!

verses.sa:
वि जिहीष्व लोकं कृणु बन्धान्मुञ्चासि बद्धकम्।
योन्या इव प्रच्युतो गर्भः पथः सर्वां अनु क्षिय॥
verses.tr: vi jihīṣva lokaṃ kṛṇu bandhānmuñcāsi baddhakam yonyā iva pracyuto garbhaḥ pathaḥ sarvāṃ anu kṣiya
verses.en: Open thyself, make room: from bonds thou shalt release the prisoner. Freed, like an infant newly born, dwell in all pathways where thou wilt.

sections.label: The
sections.name: Hymn 122

verses.sa:
एतं भागं परि ददामि विद्वान् विश्वकर्मन् प्रथमजा ऋतस्य ।
अस्माभिर्दत्तं जरसः परस्तादच्छिन्नं तन्तुमनु सं तरेम॥
verses.tr: etaṃ bhāgaṃ pari dadāmi vidvān viśvakarman prathamajā ṛtasya asmābhirdattaṃ jarasaḥ parastādacchinnaṃ tantumanu saṃ tarema
verses.en: This portion I who understand deliver to Visvakarman first-born son of Order. So may we follow to the end, unbroken, beyond old age, the thread which we have given.

verses.sa:
ततं तन्तुमन्वेके तरन्ति येषां दत्तं पित्र्यमायनेन ।
अबन्ध्वेके ददतः प्रयच्छन्तो दातुं चेच्छिक्षान्त्स स्वर्ग एव॥
verses.tr: tataṃ tantumanveke taranti yeṣāṃ dattaṃ pitryamāyanena abandhveke dadataḥ prayacchanto dātuṃ cecchikṣāntsa svarga eva
verses.en: This long-drawn thread some follow who have offered in ordered course oblation to the Fathers: Some, offering and giving to the friendless, if they can give: herein they find their heaven.

verses.sa:
अन्वारभेथामनुसंरभेथामेतं लोकं श्रद्दधानाः सचन्ते ।
यद् वां पक्वं परिविष्टमग्नौ तस्य गुप्तये दम्पती सं श्रयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: anvārabhethāmanusaṃrabhethāmetaṃ lokaṃ śraddadhānāḥ sacante yad vāṃ pakvaṃ pariviṣṭamagnau tasya guptaye dampatī saṃ śrayethām
verses.en: Stand on my side and range yourselves in order, ye two! The faithful reach this world of Svarga. When your dressed food hath been bestowed on Agni, to guard it, wife and husband, come together!

verses.sa:
यज्ञं यन्तं मनसा बृहन्तमन्वारोहामि तपसा सयोनिः ।
उपहूता अग्ने जरसः परस्तात् तृतीये नाके सधमादं मदेम॥
verses.tr: yajñaṃ yantaṃ manasā bṛhantamanvārohāmi tapasā sayoniḥ upahūtā agne jarasaḥ parastāt tṛtīye nāke sadhamādaṃ madema
verses.en: Dwelling with zeal I mount in spirit after the lofty sacrifice as it departeth, Agni, may we, beyond decay, invited, in the third heaven, feast and enjoy the banquet.

verses.sa:
शुद्धाः पूता योषितो यज्ञिया इमा ब्रह्मणां हस्तेषु प्रपृथक् सादयामि ।
यत्काम इदमभिषिञ्चामि वोऽहमिन्द्रो मरुत्वान्त्स ददातु तन्मे॥
verses.tr: śuddhāḥ pūtā yoṣito yajñiyā imā brahmaṇāṃ hasteṣu prapṛthak sādayāmi yatkāma idamabhiṣiñcāmi vo'hamindro marutvāntsa dadātu tanme
verses.en: These women here, cleansed, purified, and holy, I place at rest, singly, in hands of Brahman May Indra, Marut-girt, grant me the blessing I long for as I pour you this libation,

sections.label: Theme
sections.name: Hymn 123

verses.sa:
एतं सधस्थाः परि वो ददामि यं शेवधिमावहाज्जातवेदाः ।
अन्वागन्ता यजमानः स्वस्ति तं स्म जानीत परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: etaṃ sadhasthāḥ pari vo dadāmi yaṃ śevadhimāvahājjātavedāḥ anvāgantā yajamānaḥ svasti taṃ sma jānīta parame vyo'man
verses.en: 'Ye who are present, unto you I offer this treasure brought to us by Jatavedas. Happily will the sacrificer follow: do ye acknowledge him in highest heaven.

verses.sa:
जानीत स्मैनं परमे व्योऽमन् देवाः सधस्था विद लोकमत्र ।
अन्वागन्ता यजमानः स्वस्तीऽष्टापूर्तं स्म कृणुताविरस्मै॥
verses.tr: jānīta smainaṃ parame vyo'man devāḥ sadhasthā vida lokamatra anvāgantā yajamānaḥ svastī'ṣṭāpūrtaṃ sma kṛṇutāvirasmai
verses.en: Do ye acknowledge him in highest heaven: ye know. the world here present in assembly. In peace will he who sacrifices follow: show him the joy which comes from pious actions.

verses.sa:
देवाः पितरः पितरो देवाः ।
यो अस्मि सो अस्मि॥
verses.tr: devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaro devāḥ yo asmi so asmi
verses.en: Gods are the Fathers, and the Fathers Gods. Iam the very man I am.

verses.sa:
स पचामि स ददामि ।
स यजे स दत्तान्मा यूषम्॥
verses.tr: sa pacāmi sa dadāmi sa yaje sa dattānmā yūṣam
verses.en: I cook, I give, I offer up oblation. From what I gave let me not be disparted.

verses.sa:
नाके राजन् प्रति तिष्ठ तत्रैतत् प्रति तिष्ठतु ।
विद्धि पूर्तस्य नो राजन्त्स देव सुमना भव॥
verses.tr: nāke rājan prati tiṣṭha tatraitat prati tiṣṭhatu viddhi pūrtasya no rājantsa deva sumanā bhava
verses.en: O King, take thou thy stand in heaven, there also let that gift be placed. Recognize, King, the gift which we have given, and be gracious, God!

sections.label: An Omen from the sky
sections.name: Hymn 124

verses.sa:
दिवो नु मां बृहतो अन्तरिक्षादपां स्तोको अभ्यऽपप्तद् रसेन ।
समिन्द्रियेण पयसाहमग्ने छन्दोभिर्यज्ञैः सुकृतां कृतेन॥
verses.tr: divo nu māṃ bṛhato antarikṣādapāṃ stoko abhya'paptad rasena samindriyeṇa payasāhamagne chandobhiryajñaiḥ sukṛtāṃ kṛtena
verses.en: From the high firmament, yea, out of heaven a water-drop with dew on me hath fallen. I, Agni! share the merit of the pious, with vigour, milk, and hymns and sacrifices,

verses.sa:
यदि वृक्षादभ्यपप्तत् फलं तद् यद्यन्तरिक्षात् स उ वायुरेव।
यत्रास्पृक्षत् तन्वो३यच्च वासस आपो नुदन्तु निरृतिं पराचैः॥
verses.tr: yadi vṛkṣādabhyapaptat phalaṃ tad yadyantarikṣāt sa u vāyureva yatrāspṛkṣat tanvo3yacca vāsasa āpo nudantu nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ
verses.en: It is a fruit if any tree hath dropped it, a breath, if from the sky it hath descended. Where it hath touched my body or my garment, thence may the Waters drive Destruction backward.

verses.sa:
अभ्यञ्जनं सुरभि सा समृद्धिर्हिरण्यं वर्चस्तदु पूत्रिममेव।
सर्वा पवित्रा वितताध्यस्मत् तन्मा तारीन्निरृतिर्मो अरातिः॥
verses.tr: abhyañjanaṃ surabhi sā samṛddhirhiraṇyaṃ varcastadu pūtrimameva sarvā pavitrā vitatādhyasmat tanmā tārīnnirṛtirmo arātiḥ
verses.en: It is a fragrant ointment, happy fortune, sheen all of gold, yea, purified from blemish. Spread over us are all purifications. Death and Malignity shall not subdue us.

sections.label: Glorification of a war-chariot
sections.name: Hymn 125

verses.sa:
वनस्पते वीड्वऽङ्गो हि भूया अस्मत्सखा प्रतरणः सुवीरः ।
गोभिः संनद्धो असि वीडयस्वास्थाता ते जयतु जेत्वानि॥
verses.tr: vanaspate vīḍva'ṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ gobhiḥ saṃnaddho asi vīḍayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni
verses.en: Mayst thou, O Tree, be firm indeed in body, our friend that furthers us, a goodly hero. Put forth thy strength, compact with thongs of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्योज उद्भृतं वनस्पतिभ्यः पर्याभृतं सहः ।
अपामोज्मानं परि गोभिरावृतमिन्द्रस्य वज्रं हविषा रथं यज॥
verses.tr: divaspṛthivyāḥ paryoja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ paryābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ apāmojmānaṃ pari gobhirāvṛtamindrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja
verses.en: Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth: its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with sacrifice the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car girt round with straps, the vigour of the floods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौजो मरुतामनीकं मित्रस्य गर्भो वरुणस्य नाभिः ।
स इमां नो हव्यदातिं जुषाणो देव रथ प्रति हव्या गृभाय॥
verses.tr: indrasyaujo marutāmanīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ sa imāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya
verses.en: Thou bolt of Indra, vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and child of Mitra,—As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O godlike Chariot, these oblations.

sections.label: Glorification of the war-drum
sections.name: Hymn 126

verses.sa:
उप श्वासय पृथिवीमुत द्यां पुरुत्रा ते वन्वतां विष्ठितं जगत्।
स दुन्दुभे सजूरिन्द्रेण देवैर्दूराद् दवीयो अप सेध शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: upa śvāsaya pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ purutrā te vanvatāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat sa dundubhe sajūrindreṇa devairdūrād davīyo apa sedha śatrūn
verses.en: Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee. O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.

verses.sa:
आ क्रन्दय बलमोजो न आ धा अभि ष्टन दुरिता बाधमानः ।
अप सेध दुन्दुभे दुच्छुनामित इन्द्रस्य मुष्टिरसि वीडयस्व॥
verses.tr: ā krandaya balamojo na ā dhā abhi ṣṭana duritā bādhamānaḥ apa sedha dundubhe ducchunāmita indrasya muṣṭirasi vīḍayasva
verses.en: Thunder out strength and fill us full of vigour, yea, thunder forth and drive away misfortunes. Drive hence, O Drum, drive thou away mischances. Thou art the fist of Indra, show thy firmness.

verses.sa:
प्रामूं जयाभी३मे जयन्तु केतुमद् दुन्दुभिर्वावदीतु ।
समश्वपर्णाः पतन्तु नो नरोऽस्माकमिन्द्र रथिनो जयन्तु॥
verses.tr: prāmūṃ jayābhī3me jayantu ketumad dundubhirvāvadītu samaśvaparṇāḥ patantu no naro'smākamindra rathino jayantu
verses.en: Conquer those yonder and let these be victors, Let the Drum speak aloud as battle's signal. Let our men, winged with horses, fly together. Let our car-warriors, Indra! be triumphant.

sections.label: A charm to banish various diseases
sections.name: Hymn 127

verses.sa:
विद्रधस्य बलासस्य लोहितस्य वनस्पते ।
विसल्पकस्योषधे मोच्छिषः पिशितं चन॥
verses.tr: vidradhasya balāsasya lohitasya vanaspate visalpakasyoṣadhe mocchiṣaḥ piśitaṃ cana
verses.en: Of abscess, of decline, of inflammation of the eyes, O Plant, Of penetrating pain, thou Herb, let not a particle remain.

verses.sa:
यौ ते बलास तिष्ठतः कक्षे मुष्कावपश्रितौ ।
वेदाहं तस्य भेषजं चीपुद्रुरभिचक्षणम्॥
verses.tr: yau te balāsa tiṣṭhataḥ kakṣe muṣkāvapaśritau vedāhaṃ tasya bheṣajaṃ cīpudrurabhicakṣaṇam
verses.en: Those nerves of thine, Consumption! which stand closely hidden in thy groin—I know the balm for that disease: the magic cure is Sipudru.

verses.sa:
यो अङ्ग्यो यः कर्ण्यो यो अक्ष्योर्विसल्पकः ।
वि वृहामो विसल्पकं विद्रधं हृदयामयम्।
परा तमज्ञातं यक्ष्ममधराञ्चं सुवामसि॥
verses.tr: yo aṅgyo yaḥ karṇyo yo akṣyorvisalpakaḥ vi vṛhāmo visalpakaṃ vidradhaṃ hṛdayāmayam parā tamajñātaṃ yakṣmamadharāñcaṃ suvāmasi
verses.en: We draw from thee the piercing pain that penetrates and racks thy lim be, That pierces ears, that pierces eyes, the abscess, and the heart's disease. Downward and far away from thee we banish that unknown decline.

sections.label: A charm for fair weather
sections.name: Hymn 128

verses.sa:
शकधूमं नक्षत्राणि यद् राजानमकुर्वत ।
भद्राहमस्मै प्रायच्छन्निदं राष्ट्रमसादिति॥
verses.tr: śakadhūmaṃ nakṣatrāṇi yad rājānamakurvata bhadrāhamasmai prāyacchannidaṃ rāṣṭramasāditi
verses.en: What time the heavenly bodies chose the Weather Prophet as their King, They brought him favouring weather, and, Let this be his domain, they said.

verses.sa:
भद्राहं नो मध्यंदिने भद्राहं सायमस्तु नः ।
भद्राहं नो अह्नां प्राता रात्री भद्राहमस्तु नः॥
verses.tr: bhadrāhaṃ no madhyaṃdine bhadrāhaṃ sāyamastu naḥ bhadrāhaṃ no ahnāṃ prātā rātrī bhadrāhamastu naḥ
verses.en: May we have weather fair at noon, may we have weather fair at eve, Fair weather when the morning breaks, fair weather when the night is come.

verses.sa:
अहोरात्राभ्यां नक्षत्रेभ्यः सूर्याचन्द्रमसाभ्याम्।
भद्राहमस्मभ्यं राजन्छकधूम त्वं कृधि॥
verses.tr: ahorātrābhyāṃ nakṣatrebhyaḥ sūryācandramasābhyām bhadrāhamasmabhyaṃ rājanchakadhūma tvaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Fair weather to the day and night, and to the stars and sun and moon, Give favourable weather thou, King, Weather Prophet, unto us.

verses.sa:
यो नो भद्राहमकरः सायं नक्तमथो दिवा ।
तस्मै ते नक्षत्रराज शकधूम सदा नमः॥
verses.tr: yo no bhadrāhamakaraḥ sāyaṃ naktamatho divā tasmai te nakṣatrarāja śakadhūma sadā namaḥ
verses.en: Be worship ever paid to thee, O Weather Prophet, King of Stars, Who gavest us good weather in the evening and by night and day!

sections.label: A charm for success and happiness
sections.name: Hymn 129

verses.sa:
भगेन मा शांशपेन साकमिन्द्रेण मेदिना ।
कृणोमि भगिनं माप द्रान्त्वरातयः॥
verses.tr: bhagena mā śāṃśapena sākamindreṇa medinā kṛṇomi bhaginaṃ māpa drāntvarātayaḥ
verses.en: With fortune of the Sisu tree—with Indra as my friend to aid—I give myself a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities I

verses.sa:
येन वृक्षाँ अभ्यभवो भगेन वर्चसा सह।
तेन मा भगिनं कृण्वप द्रान्त्वरातयः॥
verses.tr: yena vṛkṣāṃ abhyabhavo bhagena varcasā saha tena mā bhaginaṃ kṛṇvapa drāntvarātayaḥ
verses.en: That splendour and felicity wherewith thou hast excelled the trees Give me therewith a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities!

verses.sa:
यो अन्धो यः पुनःसरो भगो वृक्षेष्वाहितः ।
तेन मा भगिनं कृण्वप द्रान्त्वरातयः॥
verses.tr: yo andho yaḥ punaḥsaro bhago vṛkṣeṣvāhitaḥ tena mā bhaginaṃ kṛṇvapa drāntvarātayaḥ
verses.en: Blind fortune, with reverted leaves that is deposited in trees—Give me therewith a happy fate. Fly and begone, Malignities.

sections.label: A woman's love-charm
sections.name: Hymn 130

verses.sa:
रथजितां राथजितेयीनामप्सरसामयं स्मरः ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु॥
verses.tr: rathajitāṃ rāthajiteyīnāmapsarasāmayaṃ smaraḥ devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu
verses.en: This is the Apsarases love-spell, the conquering. resistless ones'. Send the spell forth, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me. i

verses.sa:
असौ मे स्मरतादिति प्रियो मे स्मरतादिति ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु॥
verses.tr: asau me smaratāditi priyo me smaratāditi devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu
verses.en: I pray, may he remember me, think of me, loving O and beloved. Send forth the spell, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

verses.sa:
यथा मम स्मरादसौ नामुष्याहं कदा चन।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु॥
verses.tr: yathā mama smarādasau nāmuṣyāhaṃ kadā cana devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu
verses.en: That he may think of me, that I may never, never think of him, Send forth the spell, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

verses.sa:
उन्मादयत मरुत उदन्तरिक्ष मादय ।
अग्न उन्मादया त्वमसौ मामनु शोचतु॥
verses.tr: unmādayata maruta udantarikṣa mādaya agna unmādayā tvamasau māmanu śocatu
verses.en: Madden him, Maruts, madden him. Madden him, madden him, O Air. Madden him, Agni, madden him. Let him consume with love of me,

sections.label: A woman's love-charm
sections.name: Hymn 131

verses.sa:
नि शीर्षतो नि पत्तत आध्यो३ नि तिरामि ते ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु॥
verses.tr: ni śīrṣato ni pattata ādhyo3 ni tirāmi te devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu
verses.en: Down upon thee, from head to foot, I draw the pangs of longing love. Send forth the charm, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

verses.sa:
अनुमतेऽन्विदं मन्यस्वाकूते समिदं नमः ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु॥
verses.tr: anumate'nvidaṃ manyasvākūte samidaṃ namaḥ devāḥ pra hiṇuta smaramasau māmanu śocatu
verses.en: Assent to this, O Heavenly Grace! Celestial Purpose, guide it well! Send forth the charm, ye Deities! Let him consume with love of me.

verses.sa:
यद् धावसि त्रियोजनं पञ्चयोजनमाश्विनम्।
ततस्त्वं पुनरायसि पुत्राणां नो असः पिता॥
verses.tr: yad dhāvasi triyojanaṃ pañcayojanamāśvinam tatastvaṃ punarāyasi putrāṇāṃ no asaḥ pitā
verses.en: If thou shouldst run three leagues away, five leagues, a horse's daily stage, Thence thou shalt come to me again and be the father of our sons. A woman's love-charm.

sections.label: A woman's love-charm
sections.name: Hymn 132

verses.sa:
यं देवाः स्मरमसिञ्चन्नप्स्व१न्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: yaṃ devāḥ smaramasiñcannapsva1ntaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā
verses.en: The Philter, burning with the pangs of yearning love, which Gods have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

verses.sa:
यं विश्वे देवाः स्मरमसिञ्चन्नप्स्व१न्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: yaṃ viśve devāḥ smaramasiñcannapsva1ntaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā
verses.en: The charm which, burning with the pangs of love, the General Gods have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

verses.sa:
यमिन्द्राणी स्मरमसिञ्चदप्स्व१न्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: yamindrāṇī smaramasiñcadapsva1ntaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā
verses.en: The Philter, burning with the pangs of longing, which Indrani hath effused within the waters' depth, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree,

verses.sa:
