यमिन्द्राग्नी स्मरमसिञ्चतामप्स्व१न्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: yamindrāgnī smaramasiñcatāmapsva1ntaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā
verses.en: The charm, aglow with longing, which Indra and Agni have effused within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

verses.sa:
यं मित्रावरुणौ स्मरमसिञ्चतामप्स्व१न्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: yaṃ mitrāvaruṇau smaramasiñcatāmapsva1ntaḥ śośucānaṃ sahādhyā taṃ te tapāmi varuṇasya dharmaṇā
verses.en: The charm aglow with longing which Mitra and Varuna have poured within the bosom of the floods, That spell for thee I heat by Varuna's decree.

sections.label: A glorification of the sacred girdle
sections.name: Hymn 133

verses.sa:
य इमां देवो मेखलामाबबन्ध यः संननाह य उ नो युयोज ।
यस्य देवस्य प्रशिषा चरामः स पारमिच्छात् स स उ नो वि मुञ्चात्॥
verses.tr: ya imāṃ devo mekhalāmābabandha yaḥ saṃnanāha ya u no yuyoja yasya devasya praśiṣā carāmaḥ sa pāramicchāt sa sa u no vi muñcāt
verses.en: By the direction of that God we journey, he will seek means to save and he will free us; The God who hath engirt us with this Girdle, he who hath fastened it, and made us ready,

verses.sa:
आहुतास्यभिहुत ऋषीणामस्यायुधम्।
पूर्वा व्रतस्य प्राश्नती वीरघ्नी भव मेखले॥
verses.tr: āhutāsyabhihuta ṛṣīṇāmasyāyudham pūrvā vratasya prāśnatī vīraghnī bhava mekhale
verses.en: Thou, weapon of the Rishis, art adored and served with sacrifice. First tasting of the motive milk, Zone, be a hero-slayer thou! A woman's love-charm.

verses.sa:
मृत्योरहं ब्रह्मचारी यदस्मि निर्याचन् भूतात् पुरुषं यमाय ।
तमहं ब्रह्मणा तपसा श्रमेणानयैनं मेखलया सिनामि॥
verses.tr: mṛtyorahaṃ brahmacārī yadasmi niryācan bhūtāt puruṣaṃ yamāya tamahaṃ brahmaṇā tapasā śrameṇānayainaṃ mekhalayā sināmi
verses.en: As Iam now Death's Brahmachari claiming out of the living world a man for Yama, So with Austerity and Prayer and Fervour I bind this Girdle round the man before me.

verses.sa:
श्रद्धाया दुहिता तपसोऽधि जाता स्वस ऋषीणां भूतकृतां बभूव ।
सा नो मेखले मतिमा धेहि मेधामथो नो धेहि तप इन्द्रियं च॥
verses.tr: śraddhāyā duhitā tapaso'dhi jātā svasa ṛṣīṇāṃ bhūtakṛtāṃ babhūva sā no mekhale matimā dhehi medhāmatho no dhehi tapa indriyaṃ ca
verses.en: She hath become, Faith's daughter, sprung from Fervour, the sister of the world-creating Rishis; As such, O Girdle, give us thought and wisdom, give us religious zeal and mental vigour.

verses.sa:
यां त्वा पूर्वे भूतकृत ऋषयः परिबेधिरे।
सा त्वं परि ष्वजस्व मां दीर्घायुत्वाय मेखले॥
verses.tr: yāṃ tvā pūrve bhūtakṛta ṛṣayaḥ paribedhire sā tvaṃ pari ṣvajasva māṃ dīrghāyutvāya mekhale
verses.en: Thou whom primeval Rishis girt about them, they who made the world, As such do thou encircle me, O Girdle, for long days of life.

sections.label: A priest's prayer for power to punish wrong-doers
sections.name: Hymn 134

verses.sa:
अयं वज्रस्तर्पयतामृतस्यावास्य राष्ट्रमप हन्तु जीवितम्।
शृणातु ग्रीवाः प्र शृणातूष्णिहा वृत्रस्येव शचीपतिः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vajrastarpayatāmṛtasyāvāsya rāṣṭramapa hantu jīvitam śṛṇātu grīvāḥ pra śṛṇātūṣṇihā vṛtrasyeva śacīpatiḥ
verses.en: This Thunderbolt shall take its fill of Order, scare life away and overthrow the kingdom, Tear necks in pieces, rend the napes asunder, even as the Lord of Might the neck of Vritra.

verses.sa:
अधरोऽधर उत्तरेभ्यो गूढः पृथिव्या मोत् सृपत्।
वज्रेणावहतः शयाम्॥
verses.tr: adharo'dhara uttarebhyo gūḍhaḥ pṛthivyā mot sṛpat vajreṇāvahataḥ śayām
verses.en: Down, down beneath the conquerors, let him not rise, concealed in earth, but lie down-smitten with the bolt.

verses.sa:
यो जिनाति तमन्विच्छ यो जिनाति तमिज्जहि ।
जिनतो वज्र त्वं सीमन्तमन्वञ्चमनु पातय॥
verses.tr: yo jināti tamanviccha yo jināti tamijjahi jinato vajra tvaṃ sīmantamanvañcamanu pātaya
verses.en: Seek out the fierce oppressor, yea, strike only the oppressor dead. Down on the fierce oppressor's head strike at full length, O Thunderbolt!

sections.label: A priest's fulmination against an enemy
sections.name: Hymn 135

verses.sa:
यदश्नामि बलं कुर्व इत्थं वज्रमा ददे ।
स्कन्धानमुष्य शातयन् वृत्रस्येव शचीपतिः॥
verses.tr: yadaśnāmi balaṃ kurva itthaṃ vajramā dade skandhānamuṣya śātayan vṛtrasyeva śacīpatiḥ
verses.en: Whate'er I eat I turn to strength, and thus I grasp the Thunderbolt, Rending the shoulders of that man as Indra shattered Vritra's neck.

verses.sa:
यत् पिबामि सं पिबामि समुद्र इव संपिबः ।
प्राणानमुष्य संपाय सं पिबामो अमुं वयम्॥
verses.tr: yat pibāmi saṃ pibāmi samudra iva saṃpibaḥ prāṇānamuṣya saṃpāya saṃ pibāmo amuṃ vayam
verses.en: I drink together what I drink, even as the sea that swallows all. Drinking the life-breath of that men, we drink that man and swallow him.

verses.sa:
यद् गिरामि सं गिरामि समुद्र इव संगिरः ।
प्राणानमुष्य संगीर्य सं गिरामो अमुं वयम्॥
verses.tr: yad girāmi saṃ girāmi samudra iva saṃgiraḥ prāṇānamuṣya saṃgīrya saṃ girāmo amuṃ vayam
verses.en: Whate'er I eat I swallow up, even as the sea that swallows all. Swallowing that man's vital breath, we swallow him completely up.

sections.label: A charm to promote the growth of hair
sections.name: Hymn 136

verses.sa:
देवी देव्यामधि जाता पृथिव्यामस्योषधे ।
तां त्वा नितत्नि केशेभ्यो दृंहणाय खनामसि॥
verses.tr: devī devyāmadhi jātā pṛthivyāmasyoṣadhe tāṃ tvā nitatni keśebhyo dṛṃhaṇāya khanāmasi
verses.en: Born from the bosom of wide Earth the Goddess, godlike Plant, art thou: So we, Nitatni! dig thee up to strengthen and fix fast the hair.

verses.sa: दृंह प्रत्नान् जनयाजातान् जातानु वर्षीयसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: dṛṃha pratnān janayājātān jātānu varṣīyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: Make the old firm, make new hair spring, lengthen what has already grown.

verses.sa:
यस्ते केशोऽवपद्यते समूलो यश्च वृश्चते ।
इदं तं विश्वभेषज्याभि षिञ्चामि वीरुधा॥
verses.tr: yaste keśo'vapadyate samūlo yaśca vṛścate idaṃ taṃ viśvabheṣajyābhi ṣiñcāmi vīrudhā
verses.en: Thy hair where it is falling off, and with the roots is torn away, I wet and sprinkle with the Plant, the remedy for all disease.

sections.label: A charm to promote the growth of hair
sections.name: Hymn 137

verses.sa:
यां जमदग्निरखनद् दुहित्रे केशवर्धनीम्।
तां वीतहव्य आभरदसितस्य गृहेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: yāṃ jamadagnirakhanad duhitre keśavardhanīm tāṃ vītahavya ābharadasitasya gṛhebhyaḥ
verses.en: The Plant which Jamadagni dug to make his daughter's locks grow long, This same hath Vitahavya brought to us from Asita abode.

verses.sa:
अभीशुना मेया आसन् व्यामेनानुमेयाः ।
केशा नडा इव वर्धन्तां शीर्ष्णस्ते असिताः परि॥
verses.tr: abhīśunā meyā āsan vyāmenānumeyāḥ keśā naḍā iva vardhantāṃ śīrṣṇaste asitāḥ pari
verses.en: They might be measured with a rein, meted with both extended arms. Let the black locks spring thick and strong and grow like reeds upon thy head.

verses.sa:
दृंह मूलमाग्रं यच्छ वि मध्यं यामयौषधे ।
केशा नडा इव वर्धन्तां शीर्ष्णस्ते असिताः परि॥
verses.tr: dṛṃha mūlamāgraṃ yaccha vi madhyaṃ yāmayauṣadhe keśā naḍā iva vardhantāṃ śīrṣṇaste asitāḥ pari
verses.en: Strengthen the roots, prolong the points, lengthen the middle part, O Plant. Let the black locks spring thick and strong and grow like reeds upon thy head.

sections.label: A woman's imprecation on her unfaithful lover
sections.name: Hymn 138

verses.sa:
त्वं वीरुधां श्रेष्ठतमाभिश्रुतास्योषधे ।
इमं मे अद्य पुरुषं क्लीबमोपशिनं कृधि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ vīrudhāṃ śreṣṭhatamābhiśrutāsyoṣadhe imaṃ me adya puruṣaṃ klībamopaśinaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: O Prastara, thy fame is spread abroad as best of all the herbs that grow. Unman for me to-day this man that he may wear the horn of hair.

verses.sa:
क्लीबं कृध्योपशिनमथो कुरीरिणं कृधि ।
अथास्येन्द्रो ग्रावभ्यामुभे भिनत्त्वाण्ड्यौऽ॥
verses.tr: klībaṃ kṛdhyopaśinamatho kurīriṇaṃ kṛdhi athāsyendro grāvabhyāmubhe bhinattvāṇḍyau'
verses.en: Make him a eunuch with a horn, set thou the crest upon his head. Let Indra with two pressing-stones deprive him of his manly strength.

verses.sa:
क्लीब क्लीबं त्वाकरं वध्रे वध्रिं त्वाकरमरसारसं त्वाकरम्।
कुरीरमस्य शीर्षणि कुम्बं चाधिनिदध्मसि॥
verses.tr: klība klībaṃ tvākaraṃ vadhre vadhriṃ tvākaramarasārasaṃ tvākaram kurīramasya śīrṣaṇi kumbaṃ cādhinidadhmasi
verses.en: I have unmanned thee, eunuch! yea, impotent! made thee impotent, and robbed thee, weakling! of thy strength. Upon his head we set the horn, we set the branching ornament.

verses.sa:
ये ते नाड्यौऽदेवकृते ययोस्तिष्ठति वृष्ण्यम्।
ते ते भिनद्मि शम्ययामुष्या अधि मुष्कयोः॥
यथा नडं कशिपुने स्त्रियो भिन्दन्त्यश्मना ।
एवा भिनद्मि ते शेपोऽमुष्या अधि मुष्कयोः॥
verses.tr: ye te nāḍyau'devakṛte yayostiṣṭhati vṛṣṇyam te te bhinadmi śamyayāmuṣyā adhi muṣkayoḥ yathā naḍaṃ kaśipune striyo bhindantyaśmanā evā bhinadmi te śepo'muṣyā adhi muṣkayoḥ
verses.en: [Griffith gives stanzas 4 and 5 only in a Latin version, in the Appendix to his translation.]

sections.label: A woman's love-charm
sections.name: Hymn 139

verses.sa:
न्यस्तिका रुरोहिथ सुभगंकरणी मम ।
शतं तव प्रतानास्त्रयस्त्रिंशन्नितानाः ॥
तया सहस्रपर्ण्या हृदयं शोषयामि ते॥
verses.tr: nyastikā rurohitha subhagaṃkaraṇī mama śataṃ tava pratānāstrayastriṃśannitānāḥ tayā sahasraparṇyā hṛdayaṃ śoṣayāmi te
verses.en: Thou hast grown up, a source of joy to bless me with prosperity. l: A hundred are thy tendril three-and-thirty thy descending shoots. With this that bears a thousand leaves I dry thy heart and wither it,

verses.sa:
शुष्यतु मयि ते हृदयमथो शुष्यत्वास्यऽम्।
अथो नि शुष्य मां कामेनाथो शुष्कास्या चर॥
verses.tr: śuṣyatu mayi te hṛdayamatho śuṣyatvāsya'm atho ni śuṣya māṃ kāmenātho śuṣkāsyā cara
verses.en: Let thy heart wither for my love and let thy mouth be dry for me. Parch and dry up with longing, go with lips that love of me hath dried.

verses.sa:
संवननी समुष्पला बभ्रु कल्याणि सं नुद ।
अमूं च मां च सं नुद समानं हृदयं कृधि॥
verses.tr: saṃvananī samuṣpalā babhru kalyāṇi saṃ nuda amūṃ ca māṃ ca saṃ nuda samānaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Drive us together, tawny! fair! a go-between who wakens love. Drive us together, him and me, and give us both one heart and mind.

verses.sa:
यथोदकमपपुषोऽपशुष्यत्यास्यऽम्।
एवा नि शुष्य मां कामेनाथो शुष्कास्या चर॥
verses.tr: yathodakamapapuṣo'paśuṣyatyāsya'm evā ni śuṣya māṃ kāmenātho śuṣkāsyā cara
verses.en: Even as his mouth is parched who finds no water for his burning thirst, So parch and burn with longing, go with lips that love of me hath dried.

verses.sa:
यथा नकुलो विच्छिद्य संदधात्यहिं पुनः ।
एवा कामस्य विच्छिन्नं सं धेहि वीर्यावति॥
verses.tr: yathā nakulo vicchidya saṃdadhātyahiṃ punaḥ evā kāmasya vicchinnaṃ saṃ dhehi vīryāvati
verses.en: Even as the Mungoose bites and rends and then restores the wounded snake, So do thou, mighty one, restore the fracture of our severed love.

sections.label: A blessing on a child's first two teeth
sections.name: Hymn 140

verses.sa:
यौ व्याघ्रववरूढौ जिघत्सतः पितरं मातरं च ।
यौ दन्तौ ब्रह्मणस्पते शिवौ कृणु जातवेदः॥
verses.tr: yau vyāghravavarūḍhau jighatsataḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca yau dantau brahmaṇaspate śivau kṛṇu jātavedaḥ
verses.en: Two tigers have grown up who long to eat the mother and the sire: A woman's love-charm. Soothe, Brahmanaspati, and thou, O Jatavedas, both these teeth.

verses.sa:
व्रीहिमत्तं यवमत्तमथो माषमथो तिलम्।
एष वां भागो निहितो रत्नधेयाय दन्तौ मा हिंसिष्टं पितरं मातरं च॥
verses.tr: vrīhimattaṃ yavamattamatho māṣamatho tilam eṣa vāṃ bhāgo nihito ratnadheyāya dantau mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca
verses.en: Let rice and barley be your food, eat also beans and sesamum, This is the share allotted you, to be your portion, ye two Teeth. Harm not your mother and your sire.

verses.sa:
उपहूतौ सयुजौ स्योनौ दन्तौ सुमङ्गलौ ।
अन्यत्र वां घोरं तन्वः१ परैतु दन्तौ मा हिंसिष्टं पितरं मातरं च॥
verses.tr: upahūtau sayujau syonau dantau sumaṅgalau anyatra vāṃ ghoraṃ tanvaḥ1 paraitu dantau mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca
verses.en: Both fellow teeth have been invoked, gentle and bringing happiness. Else whither let the fierceness of your nature turn away, O Teeth! Harm not your mother or your sire,

sections.label: A blessing on cattle
sections.name: Hymn 141

verses.sa:
वायुरेनाः समाकरत् त्वष्टा पोषाय ध्रियताम्।
इन्द्र आभ्यो अधि ब्रवद् रुद्रो भूम्ने चिकित्सतु॥
verses.tr: vāyurenāḥ samākarat tvaṣṭā poṣāya dhriyatām indra ābhyo adhi bravad rudro bhūmne cikitsatu
verses.en: Vayu collected these: to find their sustenance be T tvashtar's care: May Indra bless and comfort them, and Rudra look that they increase.

verses.sa:
लोहितेन स्वधितिना मिथुनं कर्णयोः कृधि ।
अकर्तामश्विना लक्ष्म तदस्तु प्रजया बहु॥
verses.tr: lohitena svadhitinā mithunaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛdhi akartāmaśvinā lakṣma tadastu prajayā bahu
verses.en: Take thou the iron axe and make a pair by marks. upon their ears. This sign the Asvins have impressed: t let these increase and multiply.

verses.sa:
यथा चक्रुर्देवासुरा यथा मनुष्याऽउत।
एवा सहस्रपोषाय कृणुतं लक्ष्माश्विना॥
verses.tr: yathā cakrurdevāsurā yathā manuṣyā'uta evā sahasrapoṣāya kṛṇutaṃ lakṣmāśvinā
verses.en: Even as Gods and Asuras, even as mortal men have done, Do ye, that these may multiply in thousands, Asvins! make the mark.

sections.label: A prayer for a plentiful harvest
sections.name: Hymn 142

verses.sa:
उच्छ्रयस्व बहुर्भव स्वेन महसा यव ।
मृणीहि विश्वा पात्राणि मा त्वा दिव्याशनिर्वधीत्॥
verses.tr: ucchrayasva bahurbhava svena mahasā yava mṛṇīhi viśvā pātrāṇi mā tvā divyāśanirvadhīt
verses.en: Spring high, O Barley, and become much through thine own magnificence: A blessing on cattle. Burst all the vessels; let the bolt from heaven forbear to strike thee down.

verses.sa:
आशृण्वन्तं यवं देवं यत्र त्वाच्छावदामसि ।
तदुच्छ्रयस्व द्यौरिव समुद्र इवैध्यक्षितः॥
verses.tr: āśṛṇvantaṃ yavaṃ devaṃ yatra tvācchāvadāmasi taducchrayasva dyauriva samudra ivaidhyakṣitaḥ
verses.en: As we invite and call to thee, Barley, a God who heareth us, Raise thyself up like heaven on high and be exhaustless as the sea.

verses.sa:
अक्षितास्त उपसदोऽक्षिताः सन्तु राशयः ।
पृणन्तो अक्षिताः सन्त्वत्तारः सन्त्वक्षिताः॥
verses.tr: akṣitāsta upasado'kṣitāḥ santu rāśayaḥ pṛṇanto akṣitāḥ santvattāraḥ santvakṣitāḥ
verses.en: Exhaustless let thine out-turns be, exhaustless be thy gathered heaps, Exhaustless be thy givers, and exhaustless those who eat of thee.
